pages.name: 标准族裔专长
pages.expectedContent:
Every ancestry in Starfinder serves as a unique expression of both your character's themes and the setting's rich diversity and provides a slew of unique feats and features to mechanically reflect these aspects in your game. Many ancestries have similar cultural and physiological features, which in mechanical terms means they also share similar feats. Standardized ancestry feats serve as a universal template for shared abilities that can be taken by any character using the ancestries in this book. These ancestries can use feats from other products that work best across multiple ancestries instead of being tied to one. In some cases, these feats consolidate similar ancestry feats together.

When a character gains an ancestry feat, they can choose a feat from the standardized ancestry feats available to their ancestry instead of one of the feats that are regularly available to their ancestry. Each ancestry lists the standardized ancestry feats available to that ancestry prior to listing the specific feats available to the ancestry. Many of these feats have specific options listed in parenthesis, such as "Creature Speech (rat)," which indicates what options you can select from when you take the feat. If a feat has multiple options in parentheses, you can only choose one of the options each time you take the ancestry feat, and not all feats can be taken multiple times. Some of the feats have additional prerequisites that might be impossible to fulfill if you select certain lineages or heritages that remove default features from your ancestry.

Standardized Ancestry Feats In Your Campaign

GMs might want to customize their campaign even further by using standardized ancestry feats for other ancestries, or by modifying the scope of the standardized ancestry feats. These are optional suggestions for how GMs might adjust their games to include standardized ancestry feats in ways beyond their intended use. Players should always consult their GMs before making changes to their character options.

Standardizing Other Ancestries

You might want to use standardized ancestry feats for characters who select ancestries and heritages from other sources, including Pathfinder Second Edition. The easiest way to apply these feats to other sources is to examine those ancestries for similar feats and replace them with these standardized options. Comparing physiologically and thematically similar ancestries in this book to those found in other sources can also help you analyze which feats are most compatible.

This is especially helpful if you use the ancestry paragon variant rule (Starfinder GM Core 86) with a party that includes members of ancestries from sources that have fewer feat options than those in Galactic Ancestries.

Alien Ancestries

The selection of standardized ancestry feats and their specific options represent the ancestries and cultures of the Starfinder setting. With your GM's permission, you can adjust the feats and options for other settings or situations. For example, gnomes can normally select any burrowing animal for Ancestral Pest, but a settlement of gnomes on a forested moon who magically bond with squoxes could select Ancestral Pest (squox) instead; such gnomes would be unable to select a burrowing creature like a mole for Ancestral Pest.

Standardized Ancestry Feats

You can select a standardized ancestry feat in place of an ancestry feat whenever you gain an ancestry feat if you meet its prerequisites and if it's listed among the standardized ancestry feat options for your ancestry. The ancestry trait represents whatever ancestry your character is; if your novian character takes the Ancestral Skills feat, then the feat has the novian trait..

The options for standardized ancestry feats on each ancestry's journal page. If a list of standardized ancestry feats are not present then the ancestry may not have been given a set list by Paizo.
pages.content:
《寻星者》的每个族裔都独特地体现着角色主题与设定的丰富多样性，并提供许多独有的专长和特性，在游戏机制中反映这些方面。许多族裔有相似的文化与生理特征，换成机制语言，就是也有相似的专长。标准族裔专长为这些共通能力提供通用模板，使用本书族裔的任何角色均可选取。这些族裔可以使用其他产品中适合多个族裔、而非局限于单一族裔的专长。有些标准专长也整合了相似的族裔专长。

角色获得族裔专长时，可以从其族裔可用的标准族裔专长中选择一项，替代通常可选的族裔专长。每个族裔都会先列出可用的标准族裔专长，再列出该族裔独有的专长。许多专长在括号中列有具体选项，例如“生物交谈（老鼠）”，表示选取专长时可以选择的内容。如果括号中列有多个选项，每次选取该族裔专长时只能选择其中一个，而且并非所有专长都可多次选取。有些专长还有额外先决条件；若你选择了某些会移除族裔默认特性的血脉或传承，便可能无法满足这些条件。

在你的战役中使用标准族裔专长

GM可能希望将标准族裔专长用于其他族裔，或修改其适用范围，以进一步定制战役。以下是可选建议，帮助GM在预定用途之外，将标准族裔专长纳入自己的游戏。玩家修改角色选项前，始终应当先咨询GM。

将其他族裔标准化

你可能希望让选用其他来源族裔与传承的角色也能使用标准族裔专长，包括《开拓者第二版》的内容。最简单的方法，是检查这些族裔有无类似专长，再用标准选项替换。将本书中生理与主题相似的族裔，与其他来源的族裔作比较，也有助于分析哪些专长最兼容。

如果使用族裔典范变体规则（《寻星者主持人核心》第86页），而队伍中某些角色的族裔来自其他来源，其专长选项比《星系族裔》中的族裔少，这种做法尤其有用。

异域族裔

标准族裔专长及其具体选项，反映的是《寻星者》设定中的族裔与文化。获得GM许可后，你可以调整这些专长和选项，以适应其他设定或情况。例如，侏儒通常可以为族裔害兽选择任何掘地动物，但一处住在森林卫星上、与松鼠狐缔结魔法纽带的侏儒聚居地，可以改选族裔害兽（松鼠狐）；这样的侏儒便无法为族裔害兽选择鼹鼠之类的掘地生物。

标准族裔专长

每当获得族裔专长时，只要满足先决条件，且某项标准族裔专长列在你的族裔可选列表中，你就可以选择它来替代族裔专长。族裔特征代表你角色所属的族裔：如果你的新星族角色选择了族裔技能专长，该专长就具有新星族特征。

各族裔日志页列有可选的标准族裔专长。如果没有标准族裔专长列表，可能是Paizo尚未为该族裔指定固定列表。

pages.name: 矮人
pages.expectedContent:
When you want something done right, ask a dwarf. This sentiment Wresonates with many people all across the cosmos, and for good reason; dwarves are the heartiest of lost Golarion's children, proud of the exacting standards they apply to their work. A shoddy job is not a finished job, and this attitude can be seen in dwarven shipyards, weapon forges, and mining operations. It's a matter of honor and pride; to do something poorly is to fail to live up to your clan's traditions.

Even so, there is a tragic aspect to dwarven heritage. They came from lost Golarion's molten heart, called to the surface by the great god Torag. Now, both Golarion and Torag are missing, and the dwarves' stories of old are filled with yearning for a home long gone. In the face of this ineffable longing and sorrow, dwarves persevere with their unbending principles, pursuing a perfection they know to be unattainable. They create as a means to improve themselves and so that they can be looked upon by ancestors and descendants alike with pride.

If you want to play a proud and stubborn artisan with close familial bonds, you should play a dwarf.

You Might...

  • Take promises, contracts, and the matter of your honor very seriously.

  • Strive for absolute perfection in your own creations and hold others to the same standard.

  • Think back wistfully to a home world you never knew.

Others Probably...

  • Write you off as a stubborn or even backward traditionalist.

  • Assume you have worked in a mine or a forge at least once in your life.

  • Admire the deep love you have for your family and closest friends.

Physical Description

Dwarves typically stand around 4 feet tall, have wide and stocky frames, and generally weigh between 175 and 250 pounds. A dwarf's most noticeable physical feature is their hair. Dwarves of all genders take great pride in their haircare, weaving and braiding phenomenally intricate patterns into their beards and coifs, cleaning them with the finest products, and ensuring they only grow to a certain length (which is determined by their age). The older the dwarf, the longer their beard and hair, and the more respected they are by their clan.

Dwarves reach maturity at around age 25, but clans generally hold additional rites a dwarf must partake in before they're considered an adult. Dwarves typically live up to 350 years old.

Society

A dwarf's home is not a planet, but a clan—a family business that spans the stars and determines many of a dwarf's ideals and prospects. The clans of lost Golarion have spread across the cosmos: Clan Firecask is the premier ale producer in the Pact Worlds, Clan Vanderholl builds many of the finest kaiju-slaying mechs, and Clan Thodja designs exceptional starships inspired by cloud dragons. A dwarf can always rely on their clan to care for them, even if they've never met. For example, a wary member of Clan Minebrewer from Voxha could show up at the doors of a Minebrewer astroquarry in the Diaspora and be greeted as a long-lost sibling.

Most clans have a headquarters, or clanholding, on Absalom Station. They set up wherever resources are plentiful, like chemclans living on satellites near gas giants where compounds relevant to their trades can be harvested. Many dwarves live aboard city-sized ships called Star Citadels. These city-ships are hubs for dozens of clanholdings that rely on each other's production. The most famous Star Citadel, Ironstar, is a massive generation ship exploring the Vast as part of the New Quest for Sky.

During the Gap, dwarves began the practice of carving clan crystals from gems found within the heart of the nearest planet or asteroid to celebrate a new child's birth. Once carved, these crystals often resemble small statues depicting a notable family leader, and many dwarves strive to have their likeness rendered on a clan crystal someday. To lose or sell a clan crystal is deeply taboo. They're always crafted into a type of weapon valued by the individual clan.

Sample Names

Aode, Bongrun, Duravor, Gontun, Hondue, Karvak, Morakt, Nerlond, Ontz, Quarnot, Vog, Zormuid

Beliefs

At some point during the Gap, Torag disappeared without a trace. His vengeful brother Angradd has dutifully taken up the mantle in his stead, tempering his flames to light his people's way forward. Much has been done to heal the old wounds between dwarves and orcs, who in modern times are united peoples with deep cultural ties and strong alliances.

Some dwarves believe that Torag's disappearance isn't a setback, but that it's simply the next part of the Quest for Sky of old. Yes, dwarves reached the surface of Golarion and the heavens beyond it, but what if their destiny is some other alien sky, and Torag is on a quest to find it? These dwarves explore the universe in the hopes of finding their lost god in the Vast as well as a new home for their kind. The most famous expedition operates aboard Star Citadel Ironthrone, but far smaller crews regularly undertake this quest.

Popular Edicts

work hard at your trade, keep your clan's interests at heart, celebrate life with food and drink

Popular Anathema

betray your clan, put yourself before your loved ones, produce a flawed piece of work

Dwarf Mechanics

Hit Points 10

Size Medium

Speed 20 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Wisdom, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

Languages Common, Dwarven, and Orcish (or one regional language),

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • dwarf

  • humanoid

Senses Darkvision

Clan Crystal

pages.content:
想把事情做好，就找矮人。这种看法在宇宙各地引起共鸣，而且不无道理：矮人是失落格拉利昂的子嗣中最强健的一支，以工作上的严苛标准为傲。粗制滥造就不算完工，这种态度体现在矮人的造船厂、武器锻造厂与采矿作业中。这关乎荣誉与自豪，做得不好就是辜负氏族传统。

即便如此，矮人的传承也有悲剧的一面。他们来自失落格拉利昂熔融的地心，受伟大神祇托拉格召唤而登上地表。如今，格拉利昂与托拉格双双失踪，古老故事满是对早已消逝家园的思念。面对难以言说的渴望与悲伤，矮人坚持不屈的原则，追求明知无法企及的完美。他们通过创造完善自己，也为了让先祖与后人都能以他们为荣。

如果你想扮演骄傲固执、与家族联系紧密的工匠，就选择矮人。

你可能……

  • 极其认真地对待承诺、契约与自己的荣誉。

  • 力求自己的作品绝对完美，并以同样标准要求他人。

  • 怅然追忆自己从未认识的家园世界。

他人可能……

  • 将你视为固执甚至落后的传统主义者，不予重视。

  • 认为你这辈子至少在矿井或锻造厂工作过一次。

  • 钦佩你对家人与挚友的深厚感情。

外貌描述

矮人通常身高约4尺，身形宽阔敦实，体重一般175至250磅。最显眼的特征是须发。所有性别的矮人都以须发护理为荣，在胡须与发型中编出异常复杂的纹样，用最好的产品清洁，并确保须发只长到由年龄决定的特定长度。矮人年纪越大，须发越长，在氏族中也越受尊敬。

矮人约25岁成熟，但氏族通常另有必须参加的仪式，之后才视其为成年人。矮人通常能活到350岁。

社会

矮人的家并非行星，而是氏族：跨越群星的家族事业，决定着许多矮人的理想与前途。失落格拉利昂的氏族已散布宇宙各处：火桶氏族是协约世界首屈一指的麦酒生产商，范德霍尔氏族建造许多最优秀的怪兽歼灭机甲，索佳氏族则以云龙为灵感，设计杰出的星舰。矮人总能指望氏族照顾自己，即使素未谋面。例如，一名来自沃克斯哈、心怀戒备的矿酿氏族成员，来到流散带的矿酿天体采石场门前，也会被当作久别的兄弟姐妹欢迎。

大多数氏族在艾巴萨罗姆空间站设有总部或氏族据点。他们会落脚资源充足之处，例如化学氏族居住在气态巨行星附近的卫星上，采集行业所需的化合物。许多矮人住在称为星辰堡垒的城市级飞船上。这些城市舰是数十个氏族据点的枢纽，各氏族的生产彼此依赖。最著名的星辰堡垒铁星号是一艘庞大的世代飞船，正作为新寻天之旅的一部分，探索浩界。

大断层期间，矮人开始以最近的行星或小行星地心发现的宝石雕刻氏族水晶，庆祝新生儿诞生。雕好的水晶常像著名家族领袖的小雕像，许多矮人努力争取有朝一日让自己的形象刻在氏族水晶上。丢失或出售氏族水晶是严重禁忌。水晶总会被制成该氏族珍视的一类武器。

示例姓名

Aode, Bongrun, Duravor, Gontun, Hondue, Karvak, Morakt, Nerlond, Ontz, Quarnot, Vog, Zormuid

信仰

大断层中的某个时刻，托拉格消失得无影无踪。怀有复仇之志的兄弟安哥拉德尽责地接过其职责，收敛火焰，为族人照亮前路。人们付出诸多努力，弥合矮人与兽人之间的旧伤。如今，两个民族团结一致，拥有深厚文化纽带与牢固同盟。

有些矮人认为，托拉格失踪并非挫折，只是古老寻天之旅的下一阶段。不错，矮人已抵达格拉利昂地表及更远的天外，但如果他们的归宿是另一片异星天空，而托拉格正在寻找它呢？这些矮人探索宇宙，希望在浩界中寻回失落神祇，也为族人找到新家园。最著名的远征在星辰堡垒铁王座号（Ironthrone）上进行，但小得多的船员团队也常踏上这段旅程。

常见典范

勤勉从业，将氏族利益放在心上，用美食与饮品庆祝生命

常见禁忌

背叛氏族，将自己置于所爱之人之前，制作有缺陷的作品

矮人规则数据

生命值 10

体型 中型

速度 20尺

属性提升 体质、感知、自选

属性缺陷 魅力

语言 通用语、矮人语，以及兽人语（或一种地区语言），

额外语言 数量等于你的智力调整值（若为正值）。从常见语言列表和你有权获取的其他语言中选择（例如家园世界广泛使用的语言）。

特征

  • 矮人

  • 类人

感官 黑暗视觉

pages.name: 精灵
pages.expectedContent:
To be an elf is to be an explorer untethered by the confines of any single world. It's to look up at the sky and know nothing you see is beyond reach. Though their reputation in the Pact Worlds paints them as fading recluses obsessed with antiquated traditions, elves were among the first to look beyond the bounds of their own horizons. Extraordinarily long lifespans and ample patience have enabled elven civilizations to focus on long-term strategies and execute programs that required centuries of preparation, but their fundamentally different perspective on time also makes it challenging for the rest of the galaxy to understand elven history from an elven perspective.

Despite this long-lasting legacy of eternal horizons and galactic scholarship, none in the Pact Worlds were scarred as deeply or hurt more permanently by the Gap than the elves who survived it. While the several centuries that have passed since the Gap's end place it easily out of mind for those who don't have so much as a living ancestor who remembers a time when life was different, elves who lived through the Gap are still alive today, left to reckon with their broken memories, with unfamiliar or even unknown families, and with a sense of disconnection from their lost identities. Thanks to elven society's interconnectedness via starships and magical gates, nearly every elf who survived the disappearance of Golarion lost someone who was personally important to them when the planet vanished. Sovyrian still mourns many losses, from those known as well as those yet undiscovered.

In the wake of the Gap's devastation, elves withdrew from the galactic stage. Those in diaspora across the galaxy returned to the continent Sovyrian on Castrovel to close ranks, recover, and mourn. Sovyrian's population exploded with refugees for the second time in its history, though unlike Golarion's last apocalypse, this time there were no astronomers or seers with forewarnings of the Gap's arrival. Elven historians believe they were dealt a grave betrayal during the Gap, though they have yet to discern how or by whom. A lasting fear of deceit has fostered reclusion and xenophobia among the older generations of Sovyrian, which in turn has made elven perspectives more difficult for the rest of the galaxy to understand. Though a new generation of elves pushes to end such attitudes and open elven society to the wider galaxy, and though many elves travel beyond Castrovel and trade with other worlds, elven starships are almost exclusively crewed by elves, and Sovyrian rarely welcomes outsiders.

You Might...

  • Struggle to track the minute changes wrought by time on the world around you, such as referring to businesses by the names of old, defunct establishments that operated out of the same location decades or centuries past.

  • Mourn many losses, struck by the knowledge that your long life means you will always be mourning.

  • Fixate on a single hobby or skill without moving on to another until you've mastered it.

Others Probably...

  • Assume you have special insights into the Gap because you were alive for it.

  • Believe you're a powerful magician who disdains technology as unnatural.

  • Worry you look down on anyone less than a century old or treat non-elves like inexperienced children.

Physical Description

Elves are humanoids with angular features and pointed ears. Their wide, rounded eyes have large pupils of a single, solid vibrant color. Elves adapt to a planet's ecosystem rather than taming it, taking on traits that reflect their environment. For this reason, elves from Castrovel often have purple, green, or blue eyes and jewel-toned hair, while azrinaran elves on Apostae have lavender skin, light eyes, and keen darkvision.

Elves reach physical adulthood around the age of 20, though among other elves, the passing of an elf's first century is an especially important emotional milestone into adulthood. The reality of watching shorter-lived friends and neighbors grow old and die can't truly be prepared for—it can only be experienced.

When elven diplomats and travelers leave Castrovel, they often do so in full-face masks, concealing their features and personhood to better serve as a proxy for all elves and a united elven state.

Society

The history of elven civilization in the Pact Worlds began on Castrovel, which is believed by most elves to be their people's birthplace. Magical portals connected the isolated continent of Sovyrian to other planets, enabling interplanetary exploration and the colonization of Akiton, Triaxus, Verces, and eventually Golarion. While these aiudara let elves leap across the galaxy, the Signal and other innovations in interplanetary travel brought outsiders from across the galaxy to Castrovel, shifting galactic power and creating a new future where elves were forced to share the stars.

The High Families of El and a council of the families' leaders known as the Sova have governed Sovyrian for millennia, guiding choices from the ancient colonization of Golarion to the new Blood Right that granted Sovyrian citizenship to all elves in the aftermath of the Gap. The Sova concern themselves with the security and sovereignty of Sovyrian, leaving the nation's cities free to govern themselves.

On the other side of the Pact Worlds, standing in stark contrast to Castrovel, is Apostae, a synthetic planetoid and the home of azrinaran elves. Azrinarans emigrated to the hollow planet at some point during the Gap alongside orcs and xulgaths, and they claim Golarion as their ancestral home rather than Castrovel. This is but one of many disagreements fueling continued hostilities between the two elven groups.

Sample Names

Ailaura, Amdelial, Calderon, Divarial, Feldoran, Iedrlon, Jathadrel, Selsora, Taltharel, Vaeriel, Virunara, Zayandara

Beliefs

The elves of Sovyrian are at a crossroads. Deeply frightened by the Gap and everything they're unable to remember losing, most elves were left with nowhere safe to turn but inward, becoming yet more insular and withdrawn. Some elves worry that even Castrovel is no longer safe and push the Sova to lead them away into the stars in search of a new home far from the Pact Worlds—and far from the many tragedies they've suffered there.

Elven culture's love of artistry and beauty persists, though many elven artists decline to share their works outside of Sovyrian. They create readily for their own enjoyment and for their fellow elves, but rarely do so for outsiders and strangers.

The anger and dread among elves in the wake of the Gap bolstered worship of Calistria, and her devotees push Sovyrian to strike back against the galaxy and punish all who threaten elven sovereignty and safety. On Apostae, many azrinarans worship fiends or strange outer gods in exchange for boons that allow them to thrive on their bleak new home world.

Popular Edicts

avenge what was lost in the Gap, find beauty in undiscovered places, preserve elven art and history

Popular Anathema

abandon elf culture, allow a foe who harms you to go unpunished

Elf Mechanics

Hit Points 6

Size Medium

Speed 30 Feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Constitution

Languages Common, Elven

成为精灵，就是成为不受任何单一世界限制的探索者。仰望天空时，你知道所见的一切皆可抵达。虽然协约世界常将他们描绘为日渐衰落、痴迷陈旧传统的隐士，精灵其实是最早放眼自身地平线之外的族群之一。异常漫长的寿命与充足耐心，使精灵文明能专注于长期战略，执行需要数世纪准备的计划。但他们截然不同的时间观，也让星系其他族群难以从精灵自身的视角理解其历史。

尽管拥有探索无尽地平线、研究星系学问的悠久传承，协约世界中却无人比大断层幸存精灵受到更深、更持久的创伤。大断层结束后已过数世纪；对那些连一位记得旧日不同生活的在世先祖都没有的人，这件事很容易被淡忘。但亲历大断层的精灵如今仍活着，必须面对破碎记忆、陌生乃至不认识的家人，以及与失落身份脱节的感受。精灵社会经由星舰与魔法门紧密联系，因此，几乎每个在格拉利昂消失后幸存的精灵，都在行星消失时失去了对自己重要的人。索维瑞安仍在哀悼许多损失，有些已知，有些尚未发现。

大断层造成毁灭后，精灵退出星系舞台。散居各处的精灵返回卡斯卓韦的索维瑞安大陆，团结起来，恢复、哀悼。索维瑞安历史上第二次因难民涌入而人口激增；但与格拉利昂上次的末日不同，这次没有天文学家或先知预警大断层到来。精灵历史学家相信他们在大断层中遭到严重背叛，却尚未查明经过与背叛者。对欺骗的持久恐惧，令索维瑞安老一代趋向隐居与排外，也让星系其他族群更难理解精灵的看法。虽然新一代推动结束这些态度，向广阔星系开放社会，许多精灵也走出卡斯卓韦，与其他世界贸易，但精灵星舰几乎全由精灵担任船员，索维瑞安也很少欢迎外来者。

你可能……

  • 难以跟上时间给周围世界带来的细微变化，例如仍以数十年、数百年前曾在同一地点营业、如今早已停业的老店名，称呼现在的商家。

  • 哀悼众多损失，并震惊地意识到，漫长生命意味着自己将永远哀悼下去。

  • 专注一种爱好或技能，掌握之前绝不转向其他。

他人可能……

  • 认为你亲历过大断层，所以对其有特殊见解。

  • 相信你是强大的魔法师，鄙视科技，认为它不自然。

  • 担心你看不起不到百岁的人，或将非精灵当作缺乏经验的孩子。

外貌描述

精灵是五官棱角分明、耳朵尖长的类人生物。他们的眼睛宽大浑圆，硕大瞳孔呈单一而鲜亮的纯色。精灵适应行星生态系统，而非驯服它，身体呈现反映环境的特征。因此，卡斯卓韦精灵常有紫、绿或蓝色眼睛和宝石色调的头发；阿泼斯忒的亚兹里纳精灵则有淡紫色皮肤、浅色眼睛，以及敏锐的黑暗视觉。

精灵约20岁时身体成年，但在精灵之间，度过第一个百岁才是在情感上步入成年的重大里程碑。看着短寿朋友与邻居衰老、死去，这种现实无法真正预先准备，唯有亲自经历。

精灵外交官与旅行者离开卡斯卓韦时，常戴全覆面具，隐藏容貌与个人身份，以更好地代表所有精灵与统一的精灵国家。

社会

协约世界的精灵文明历史始于卡斯卓韦，大多数精灵认为那里是族人诞生之地。魔法门将孤立的索维瑞安大陆连向其他行星，让他们能够跨行星探索，殖民阿基顿、崔阿克斯、威瑟斯，最终到达格拉利昂。虽然这些艾厄达拉让精灵跳跃于星系之间，信标与其他星际旅行革新也把外来者从各处带到卡斯卓韦，改变星系力量格局，创造出精灵不得不与他人共享群星的新未来。

艾尔的至高家族，以及由家族领袖组成、称为索瓦的议会，统治索维瑞安已有数千年，主导从古代殖民格拉利昂，到大断层之后以新“血统权利”授予所有精灵索维瑞安公民身份等抉择。索瓦关注国家安全与主权，让各城市自由自治。

协约世界另一端，与卡斯卓韦鲜明对比的是阿泼斯忒。这颗人工小行星是亚兹里纳精灵的家园。亚兹里纳人在大断层的某个时点与兽人、地蜥人一同移居这颗空心行星，声称祖居家园是格拉利昂，而非卡斯卓韦。这只是两个精灵群体持续敌对的众多分歧之一。

示例姓名

Ailaura, Amdelial, Calderon, Divarial, Feldoran, Iedrlon, Jathadrel, Selsora, Taltharel, Vaeriel, Virunara, Zayandara

信仰

索维瑞安精灵正站在十字路口。大断层，以及那些连失去什么都无法回忆的损失，使他们深感恐惧；多数除了转向内部，无处可求安全，于是更加封闭、退缩。有些担心连卡斯卓韦也不安全，敦促索瓦带领他们进入群星，在远离协约世界、也远离当地诸多悲剧之处，寻找新家园。

精灵文化对艺术与美的热爱依旧延续，但许多艺术家拒绝向索维瑞安之外分享作品。他们乐于为自身的享受与精灵同胞创作，却很少为外来者和陌生人创作。

大断层之后，精灵的愤怒与恐惧助长了卡莉丝翠信仰。她的信徒敦促索维瑞安向星系反击，惩罚所有威胁精灵主权与安全的人。在阿泼斯忒，许多亚兹里纳人崇拜魔族或奇异外神，换取能在荒凉新家园繁荣生存的恩赐。

常见典范

为大断层中的损失复仇，在未发现之地寻找美，保存精灵艺术与历史

常见禁忌

放弃精灵文化，让伤害你的敌人逃脱惩罚

精灵规则数据

体型 中型

速度 30尺

属性提升 敏捷、智力、自选

属性缺陷 体质

pages.name: 侏儒
pages.expectedContent:
Gnomes are a vivacious and well-traveled people with ancient roots in the primal fey realm of the First World. While gnomes today lack their adopted home world of Golarion, their curiosity has led them across the Pact Worlds and all over the galaxy. Gnomes are either brightly colored feychildren who must stave off the color- and life-draining affliction known as the Bleaching with new ideas and experiences, or they're bleachlings who have an immunity to the malady but lack some of their compatriots' vivacity.

Full of insatiable curiosity and taken with esoteric obsessions, gnomes adapted and thrived as they followed their fey whimsies to the stars. Their self-reliance, single-minded focus, and eccentric mindsets make them intrepid adventurers ever in search of questions, mysteries, and fascinations wherever they might find them.

If you want a long-lived character with a strong quirk or esoteric obsession, play a gnome!

You Might...

  • Speak brilliant insight and absurd inanity in the same breath.

  • Accumulate an abundance of knowledge that is both stunningly broad and obsessively specific.

  • Possess a constant desire for change or novelty.

Others Probably...

  • Assume you're good at magic, engineering, or both.

  • Struggle to keep up with your complex thoughts and leaps of logic.

  • Expect you to be light-hearted and jovial.

Physical Description

People sometimes mistake gnomes for human children because of their high energy, naive curiosity, and smaller size. They grow to be around 3 and a half feet tall and often bear large, pronounced features. Bleachling gnomes are starkly monochromatic, with gray, white, or sepia tones, while feychild gnomes exhibit a kaleidoscopic array of vibrant colors in virtually endless variations.

It's not uncommon for gnomes to undergo augmentation surgery just for the experience, and the wide variety of gnome interests means many gnomes appreciate having a broader range of options at their disposal than the other inhabitants of the galaxy. You're just as likely to meet a Brethedan gnome with tentacles and a tail as you are to meet a cybernetic Veskarium gnome or a magically augmented Castrovelian gnome.

Gnomes typically reach physical maturity by the age of 18, but are not considered adults by their peers until they're 40, ostensibly because a gnome at 40 is marginally less reckless and impulsive than as a teenager. Feychildren can theoretically live forever, but the vast majority succumb to the Bleaching by 400 years of age, a fate that is always fatal for them. Bleachlings typically die of natural causes around 500 years old.

Society

Gnomes don't have a shared culture, instead individually adopting local customs and mores to fit their whims and desires. Most gnome families are temporary affairs for mutual benefit, prone to fluidity and communal arrangements that enable family members to pursue new interests as they wish. It's a common sight to see a gnome grow restless in their home culture and move frequently over the course of their lifetime, always living in new and wildly varied places. Gnomes sometimes congregate for a common cause that can be personally pursued, like deep-space construction projects or academic pursuits at Castrovel's storied institutions. Many gnomes live in the Drift and work in service to Brigh, one of Triune's aspects, at her dedicated clockwork museum and tavern in Alluvion. Curiously, gnomes are one of the very few peoples allowed to visit the guarded elven nation of Sovyrian, according to ancient and forgotten tradition.

Many ancestries find gnomes' bizarre senses of humor and eccentric thought processes difficult to follow, so gnomes usually don't bother explaining themselves, which has earned them a reputation for impatient brusqueness. This capacity for out-of-the-box conceptualization makes gnomes capable of a kind of hyper-focus that can often lead to deep understanding and surprising creativity, and gnomes tend to thrive at whatever they put at the forefront of their minds.

If there's one thing that unites gnomes, it's their individuality. As the saying goes, “When you've met a gnome, you've met one gnome.” A running joke making the rounds on the infosphere is that no matter how niche a subculture is, at least one gnome will be interested in it. Gnome fixations can be as mundane as button collecting or as world-changing as quantum entanglement, and the mercurial nature of a gnome's interests means that they might switch from pursuing art to surgical medicine as fast as a change of mind.

Many gnomes have a talent for magic and find the obscure symbolism of occult or religious rituals, the rhythm and balance of natural magics, and the theorems of technomancy equally fascinating. Gnome scholars at magic academies often strain tenure systems with their long lives and eccentric pursuits, courting scandalous subjects of study or simply abandoning their teaching responsibilities whenever a more interesting diversion arises.

Gnomes have a pragmatic relationship to names, frequently adopting new ones or adapting old ones in solidarity, practicality, or curiosity. This helps gnomes recall the times and places they met people based on the alias they used, though it can create confusion among gnomes' close contacts.

Sample Names

Ablenaffener, Brighi, Degleder, Gwict, Naiaj, Nivaz, Ripti, Vigg, Xouk, Zurladew

Beliefs

It's common for gnomes to become obsessed with specific pieces of religious literature and become disciples. Numerous faiths have gnomes among their followers. As the original bleachling gnome, Nivi Rhombodazzle holds a special place in the hearts of gnomes everywhere as a spiritual model for a life of chance and whimsy. Gnomes working mechanical trades and infosphere economy often revere different aspects of Triune, while those who feel the call of wanderlust that led the first gnomes to Golarion might revere gods of travel like Desna or Weydan. Other gnomes pursue multiple religions devoutly, following some vision of divinity broader than any one deity and treating gods like tools to be fitted to certain tasks.

Popular Edicts

follow your hunches, pursue your endless interests, seek new curiosities

Popular Anathema

show off your old work, stop experiencing new things

Gnome Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Small

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Strength

Languages Common, Fey, Gnomish

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

  • humanoid

侏儒活泼而见多识广，古老根源可追溯到第一世界的原始妖精领域。如今，他们失去了曾接纳自己的家园格拉利昂，好奇心却引领他们遍历协约世界与整个星系。侏儒或是色彩鲜艳的妖精之子，必须以新观念与新体验抵抗会抽干色彩和生命的苍白病；或是免疫这种疾病的苍白者，却少了同胞的几分活力。

侏儒有着永不满足的好奇心，也常痴迷冷僻事物。他们循着妖精般的奇思迈向群星，适应新环境并繁荣生息。自立、专注与古怪思维，让他们成为无畏的冒险者，无论走到哪里，都在寻找问题、谜团与令自己着迷之物。

如果你想扮演长寿，且有强烈怪癖或冷僻嗜好的角色，就选侏儒！

你可能……

  • 同一口气里既说出精辟洞见，又讲出荒诞傻话。

  • 积累大量知识，既广博得惊人，又偏执地专精。

  • 始终渴望改变或新鲜事物。

他人可能……

  • 认为你擅长魔法、工程，或两者都是。

  • 难以跟上你复杂的想法与跳跃的逻辑。

  • 期待你轻松愉快。

外貌描述

侏儒精力充沛、好奇天真、身材矮小，因此有时被误认为人类孩子。他们身高约3.5尺，五官往往大而突出。苍白者侏儒的色调鲜明地趋于单一，呈灰、白或棕褐色；妖精之子侏儒则拥有万花筒般的鲜艳色彩，变化几乎无穷。

只为体验而接受殖装手术，在侏儒中并不罕见。兴趣广泛，也让许多侏儒喜欢比星系其他居民拥有更多可用选择。你遇见长着触手与尾巴的布雷瑟达侏儒，与遇见电控机械化的维斯卡里姆侏儒，或魔法殖装的卡斯卓韦侏儒，一样平常。

侏儒通常18岁时身体成熟，但同族直到40岁才将其视为成年人，据说因为40岁的侏儒比青少年稍微少些鲁莽与冲动。妖精之子理论上能永生，但绝大多数在400岁前便死于苍白病，这对他们而言总是致命的。苍白者通常在500岁左右自然死亡。

社会

侏儒没有共同文化，而是各自按心意与愿望采纳当地习俗和道德规范。大多数侏儒家庭是互惠的临时组合，安排灵活，也常采用共同生活的形式，让成员自由追求新兴趣。侏儒厌倦家乡文化，一生频繁迁居，始终住在新奇而千差万别的地方，是很常见的事。有时他们会为能够各自投入的共同目标聚集，例如深空建设工程，或卡斯卓韦著名学府中的学术研究。许多侏儒住在漂流域，在阿鲁维恩专为布莱设置的发条博物馆与酒馆中，服务这位三贤一的面相。奇怪的是，按古老、早被遗忘的传统，侏儒是少数获准拜访戒备森严的精灵国家索维瑞安的族群之一。

许多族裔难以理解侏儒古怪的幽默与离奇思路，因此侏儒通常懒得解释自己，获得了急躁生硬的名声。这种跳出框架构想事物的能力，使他们能够进入高度专注的状态，往往获得深刻理解与惊人创造力。侏儒只要将某事放在心头首位，便常能在其中大展所长。

如果有一件事能团结侏儒，那就是个性。正如俗话说的：“认识一个侏儒，就只是认识了一个侏儒。”信息网络上流传着一个老笑话：无论一种亚文化多小众，至少会有一个侏儒感兴趣。侏儒的痴迷可以平凡如收集纽扣，也可以改变世界，如研究量子纠缠。兴趣变幻莫测，意味着他们可能一转念，就从追求艺术改行外科医学。

许多侏儒富有魔法天赋，觉得异能或宗教仪式的晦涩象征、自然魔法的节律与平衡，以及科技魔法的定理同样迷人。魔法学院里的侏儒学者，常以漫长寿命与古怪追求挑战终身教职制度的承受力。他们会研究引发丑闻的主题，或一有更有趣的消遣，就索性抛下教学职责。

侏儒务实地对待名字，常因认同、实用或好奇而换新名、改旧名。根据当时使用的化名，他们可以回想起与别人相遇的时间地点，但这也可能让熟人困惑。

示例姓名

Ablenaffener, Brighi, Degleder, Gwict, Naiaj, Nivaz, Ripti, Vigg, Xouk, Zurladew

信仰

侏儒常痴迷某篇宗教文献，进而成为信徒，许多信仰中都有他们的身影。作为首位苍白者侏儒，Nivi Rhombodazzle在各地侏儒心中有特殊地位，是在机运与奇思中生活的精神榜样。从事机械行业与信息网络经济的侏儒，常崇拜三贤一的不同面相；感受到当初引领最早侏儒前往格拉利昂的旅行欲望者，则可能敬奉黛丝娜或韦丹等旅行神祇。另一些虔诚地追随多种宗教，追求比任何单一神祇更广阔的神性图景，将诸神视为适合特定任务的工具。

pages.name: 地精
pages.expectedContent:
A long time ago, on lost Golarion, a particularly plucky group of goblin heroes went on some legendary adventures. Though the plot of this classic goblin yarn varies dramatically in each telling (such details are irrelevant, you see), the ending is always the same. To escape a mighty foe, the goblins snuck onto a strange boat made of metal. That boat was a starship, bringing important longshanks to the newly constructed Absalom Station.

The descendants of the goblin stowaways, who insist on the moniker of space goblins, are famous for both their ingenuity and ability to cause a ruckus. If you want to play a scrappy and excitable character with a penchant for trouble, you should play a goblin.

Physical Description

Goblins have scrawny bodies and oversized heads, pointy ears, bulging red eyes, and sharp fangs. Standing 3 feet tall, their skin is usually a froggy green or moldy blue, but dusty red or pale lavender goblins exist. Their hides grow warts or boils with little to no hair, and they can regrow teeth shockingly fast. Additionally, goblin digestive systems are like vats of boiling acid, able to break down practically anything with ease. To be a mutant is considered a huge social boon among goblins, and these special people are often conferred a heroic status by their peers.

Goblins reach adolescence at 3 years of age and are fully mature by 7. They can reach 50 years of age naturally, but the general life expectancy of a species known for such reckless behavior is unfortunately closer to 20.

Society

Goblins live practically anywhere, but many find comfort in dark, wet, and dirty places like the lower decks of ships and stations, abandoned factories, sewer systems, or junkyards. Goblins have no attachment to any home world. With short lifespans and quick gestation periods, a new generation of goblins can form in less than a decade. The past is easy to forget. Goblin tribes (which usually contain a “big boss” who acts as a leader and multiple families who communally raise whelps) prioritize exciting lives over setting down roots. It's common for space goblins to migrate planets when life becomes boring, whether by stowing away or by building their own starships.

The cultural touchstones of goblins from the Pre-Gap era still exist, though there have been noticeable evolutions. While goblins hate dogs and horses, the definition of both has expanded to any alien animal that frightens them. In goblin speak, big alien animals are horses, and small ones are dogs. Goblins' love of fire and music remains a core part of their cultural identity, especially the cacophonic (and iconic) picklecore genre. Longshanks became the name for any alien taller than them, and pickles are a goblin's favorite meal, though what constitutes a pickle is now anything green and lumpy, be it an alien toad or a sample of high-grade uranium ore. Uneasy superstitions about writing exist among goblin communities, but gobo-comix have exploded in popularity, famous for their crude and uncensored art styles and their anarchic subject matters.

Sample Names

Brakaboum, Drarg, Fleagreeb, Goog, Oilguzzul, Polbak, Snotpreest, Rattlesnarp, Ungervuk, Vishuss, Zarvaxo

Beliefs

Goblins generally operate on a take-as-needed philosophy. If they desperately need something, and someone else isn't using it, it's fine to take it.

Moreover, don't really care about traditional religion. At most, they'll follow the coolest deity they've heard of most recently. Despite this, many goblins across the stars enthusiastically worship Lambatuin. The god with the biggest goblin clergy, however, is Weydan. Goblin priests assert that he is a goblin hero-god, one of the heroes who stowed away on the strange metal boat to Absalom Station in the first place.

Popular Edicts

build your own equipment, relish big fires and tasty meals, create extraordinary art of any kind

Popular Anathema

trust a “dog” or a “horse,” read anything that isn't a comic, stay somewhere boring for too long

Goblin Mechanics

Hit Points 6

Size Small

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Wisdom

Languages Common, Goblin, One regional language of your choice

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • goblin

  • humanoid

Senses Darkvision

pages.content:
很久以前，在失落的格拉利昂，一群格外勇敢的地精英雄踏上了传奇冒险。虽然这出经典地精故事每讲一次，情节都截然不同，毕竟这些细节无关紧要嘛，结局却永远一样。为了逃避强敌，地精偷偷上了一艘奇怪的金属船。那其实是艘星舰，正载着重要的长腿佬前往刚建好的艾巴萨罗姆空间站。

这些偷渡地精的后裔坚持自称太空地精，以巧思与制造骚乱的本领闻名。如果你想扮演好斗、容易兴奋、爱惹麻烦的角色，就选择地精。

外貌描述

地精身体瘦削，脑袋硕大，长着尖耳、凸出的红眼与利牙。身高3尺，皮肤通常是蛙绿或霉蓝色，也有尘红或淡紫色个体。皮肤长着疣或疖子，几乎没有毛发，牙齿再生速度快得惊人。此外，他们的消化系统仿佛一桶沸腾酸液，几乎能轻松分解任何东西。在地精中，身为突变体被视为巨大的社交优势，这些特殊个体常被同伴奉为英雄。

地精3岁进入青春期，7岁完全成熟。自然寿命可达50岁，但这样鲁莽的物种，一般预期寿命不幸更接近20岁。

社会

地精几乎无处不住，但许多喜欢阴暗、潮湿、肮脏的地方，例如舰船与空间站底层甲板、废弃工厂、下水道或垃圾场。他们不依恋任何母星。寿命短、孕期也短，不到十年就能出现新一代。过去很容易被忘记。地精部落通常由领导者“大头目”和多个共同抚养幼崽的家庭组成，比起扎根定居，更重视刺激的生活。太空地精一旦觉得无聊，就常迁往其他行星，无论靠偷渡还是自造星舰。

大断层前地精的文化标志仍然存在，只是发生了明显演变。他们仍讨厌狗与马，但两者的定义已扩展至任何令自己害怕的外星动物。在地精口中，大外星动物叫马，小的叫狗。他们对火与音乐的热爱仍是文化认同的核心，尤其是嘈杂且独具标志性的腌菜核乐派。长腿佬成了任何比自己高的外星人的称呼，腌菜则是地精最爱的食物。不过，如今凡是绿色又疙疙瘩瘩的东西都算腌菜，不论外星蟾蜍还是高品位铀矿石。地精社区仍有对文字的不安迷信，地精漫画却大受欢迎，以粗犷、不加审查的画风和无政府主义题材闻名。

示例姓名

Brakaboum, Drarg, Fleagreeb, Goog, Oilguzzul, Polbak, Snotpreest, Rattlesnarp, Ungervuk, Vishuss, Zarvaxo

信仰

地精通常奉行按需取用：若急需某物，而别人眼下没在用，拿走就没关系。

此外，他们不太在意传统宗教。最多追随最近听说的最酷神祇。尽管如此，群星间许多地精仍热情地崇拜兰巴图因。不过，拥有最多地精教士的神祇是韦丹。地精祭司坚称他是一位地精英雄神，正是当初偷渡上奇怪金属船、前往艾巴萨罗姆空间站的英雄之一。

常见典范

打造自己的装备，享受烈火与美餐，创造任何形式的非凡艺术

常见禁忌

信任“狗”或“马”，阅读漫画之外的东西，在无聊的地方停留太久

地精规则数据

体型 小型

速度 25尺

属性提升 敏捷、魅力、自选

属性缺陷 感知

pages.name: 半身人
pages.expectedContent:
Driven by powerful wanderlust, halflings have become an ancestry ubiquitous with space travel. Their adaptability and persistence help them weather harsh conditions with optimism and willpower. Many halflings take great pride in making their abodes comfortable and enjoy unclasping their magboots after a long day.

If you want to play a brave optimist who faces challenges with luck, resilience, and an appreciation of small comforts, you should play a halfling.

You Might...

  • Trust that everything will work out even if you act impulsively.

  • Get along with many but trust a select few.

  • Often let your curiosity overcome your better judgment.

Others Probably...

  • Treat you like a child.

  • Expect you to be relentlessly chipper and humorous.

  • Admire your natural charm and grace.

Physical Description

Halflings are small humanoids that resemble humans with vaguely elfin ears and disproportionately large hands and feet. Rarely growing more than 3 feet tall, many people assume halflings are human children on first encountering them. They have much of the same variety of skin, hair, and eye pigmentation as humans.

Many halflings have a polite aversion to receiving augmentations or implants, with the most common reasoning being that they're comfortable with what they have. While there's no overt stigma in halfling cultures against those who receive augmentations, halflings who enhance themselves tend to pay extra to make the new body parts look as subtle as possible.

Society

Halflings are widespread due to the wanderlust common in many of their young adults. Halfling communities are integrated into most major Drift ports, usually in neighborhoods with other small-sized ancestries. Halflings' charm and garrulous natures make them natural spokespeople and celebrities, and their physical grace makes them popular athletes in sports that reward swift and agile competitors. Their folksy language and colorful aphorisms have produced a number of loanwords and phrases in long-haul spacer chatter, Diasporan pirate cant, and social media slang.

While technically without a home world in the absence of lost Golarion, many halflings are happy to settle down wherever they happen to find themselves. Utilizing small, forgotten spaces creatively and making modest functional apartments in maintenance hallways or cargo bay nooks are sources of great pride for many halflings. Those who travel often keep mementos of past homes or trophies of their victories with which they decorate their sleeping areas. Halfling cuisine varies from region to region, efficiently integrating local ingredients to their simple stews, roasts, and casseroles. Most households make foods in vast quantities, intended to feed visiting family members and fortunate neighbors.

Halfling caravans are an unmistakable sight on major transit lanes. Consisting of hundreds of mismatched ships that operate under a code of mutual defense, caravans contain a varied mix of freight haulers, tourist ships, and colony ships, plus gunships and fighters serving as scouts and guards. These ramshackle armadas run regular routes between major ports and far-flung colonies. In major ports, caravan arrivals usually shut down halfling neighborhoods, as most communities go out in droves to welcome the crew, throw a feast, share news, and conduct business.

Caravan ships rarely transport anyone other than halflings and their families, but bringing adopted family of other ancestries is permitted. To be an outsider allowed onto a halfling caravan ship is a sign of great trust and respect in the halfling community. On the rare occasion where someone betrays the trust of the caravan, halfling or not, these duplicitous people are made to disappear, almost always never to be seen again. Those who eventually resurface are found dead, branded with a mark that resembles a bell or a flower.

Due to a history riddled with oppression and subjugation, most halflings are often warm but private with other ancestries. Many ysoki and halflings maintain a friendly rivalry, often competing in salvage runs and trade negotiations. Halfling and human cultures remain inextricably intertwined, with humans being one of the main sources of the pervasive superstition that halflings bring luck to ships and colonies.

Sample Names

Basina, Belle, Brillan, Dale, Danforth, Hemford, Jarsten, Maisie, Mia, Penvo, Toressa

Beliefs

Many halflings believe firmly in hope and their ability to make a difference. Even in life-or-death situations, they bring an even temper and determination that can surprise people unfamiliar with their history. Halflings also have a dark side, knowing full well that evil suffered tends to grow, and they're unafraid of committing extreme acts in service to their beliefs.

Halflings believe Desna is the fount of their fabled luck, but some adopt the luck gods from other ancestries as well when making their homes among other cultures. Tradition has it that the halfling oral record stretches unbroken through the Gap, preserving the names and customs of Chaldira and Thamir, their ancestral gods of fortune and vengeance. Those who still worship these old gods treat their names as prized secrets, only whispering them in times of great need.

Popular Edicts

find home where you are, keep family first, trust yourself

Popular Anathema

settle for bad food, lodgings, or company

pages.content:
强烈的旅行欲使半身人成了太空旅行中无处不在的族裔。适应力与毅力帮助他们以乐观和意志熬过恶劣环境。许多半身人以打造舒适住所为荣，喜欢在漫长一天后解开磁力靴。

如果你想扮演勇敢乐观、凭幸运与坚韧迎接挑战，也珍视小小舒适享受的角色，就选择半身人。

你可能……

  • 相信即使冲动行事，一切也会顺利。

  • 与许多人相处融洽，却只信任少数人。

  • 常让好奇心胜过明智判断。

他人可能……

  • 把你当孩子对待。

  • 期待你永远活泼幽默。

  • 钦佩你天生的魅力与优雅。

外貌描述

半身人是小型类人生物，与人类相似，耳朵略像精灵，手脚却大得不成比例。他们很少高过3尺，许多人初遇时以为他们是人类孩子。他们的肤色、发色与眼睛颜色，和人类一样丰富多样。

许多半身人会委婉地抵触接受殖装或植入物，最常见理由是对现有身体很满意。虽然半身人文化不公开歧视接受殖装的人，但选择强化自己的半身人，往往额外付费，让新身体部位的外观尽可能不引人注意。

社会

许多年轻的成年半身人都渴望旅行，使这个族裔分布广泛。大多数主要漂流港都有半身人社区，通常与其他小型族裔住在同一街区。魅力与健谈使他们成为天生的代言人与名人，优雅身姿则让他们在重视速度与敏捷的体育项目中成为受欢迎的选手。朴实语言与生动格言，为长途宇航员闲谈、流散带海盗黑话和社交媒体俚语，贡献了许多借词与短语。

格拉利昂失落后，半身人严格说来已无母星，但许多人很乐意随遇而安。巧用狭小、被遗忘的空间，在维修通道或货舱角落建起简朴实用的公寓，是许多人的骄傲。经常旅行者会保留旧日家园的纪念品或胜利战利品，用来装饰睡眠区。半身人饮食因地区而异，善于将当地食材融入简单炖菜、烤食与焗菜。大多数家庭一次做很多食物，用来招待来访家人与幸运邻居。

在主要航道上，半身人商队是一眼就能认出的风景。数百艘各不相配的舰船遵循共同防御准则，混合了货船、观光船与殖民船，以及担任侦察和护卫的炮艇与战斗机。这些拼凑舰队在大港口与偏远殖民地间定期航行。在主要港口，商队抵达通常会让半身人街区停摆，因为大多数社区成员都会成群出迎，欢迎船员、举办盛宴、交换消息并开展生意。

商队舰船很少载运半身人及其家人之外的人，但允许带上其他族裔的收养家庭成员。外来者获准登船，意味着半身人社区对其极大的信任与尊重。偶尔有人背叛商队信任，不论是否半身人，这些两面三刀者都会被弄得人间蒸发，几乎从此再不现身。那些最终重现的人，已成尸体，身上烙着类似铃铛或花朵的标记。

由于历史充满压迫与奴役，大多数半身人对其他族裔通常热情，却保留私事。许多伊索奇鼠人与半身人维持友好竞争，常在打捞行动与贸易谈判中较量。半身人与人类文化仍密不可分，人类也是“半身人为舰船与殖民地带来好运”这一普遍迷信的主要传播来源之一。

示例姓名

Basina, Belle, Brillan, Dale, Danforth, Hemford, Jarsten, Maisie, Mia, Penvo, Toressa

信仰

许多半身人坚信希望，也相信自己能够带来改变。即使在生死关头，他们仍表现出平和与决心，让不了解其历史的人惊讶。半身人也有阴暗面，深知纵容的邪恶往往会滋长，因此不怕为了信念采取极端行动。

半身人相信，黛丝娜是他们传说中好运的源泉，但在其他文化中安家时，有些也会接受其他族裔的幸运神。传统认为，半身人的口述记录从未因大断层而中断，保存着祖传幸运与复仇神祇查尔迪菈和塔米尔的名号与习俗。仍崇拜这些古神的人，将神名视为珍贵秘密，只在极其需要时低声念出。

常见典范

随处安家，将家人置于首位，相信自己

常见禁忌

将就糟糕的食物、住所或伙伴

pages.name: 莱西
pages.expectedContent:
Most leshies spend much of their lives as caretakers of their local ecosystems, but some set out into the unknown. They might venture off to protect their homes or to answer a deep desire for exploration within their spirits whose cause is sealed away with the rest of their memories.

If you want to play a character with an ancient soul and an intrinsic connection to the flora of their home world, you should play a leshy.

You Might...

  • Seek to protect areas of natural beauty from pollution or excessive resource extraction.

  • Be curious about the way that living beings interact and the emerging cultures and ecosystems that result from interstellar travel.

  • Occasionally experience déjà vu or nostalgia tied to lost memories from your past incarnations.

Others Probably...

  • Assume that you prefer lush natural environments to manufactured ones like starships or supercities.

  • Believe you have supernatural insights into the forces of nature or mystical wisdom from your past lives.

  • Assume you are tied to the land of your home world and have limited experience with the cultures of other planets.

Physical Description

Leshy bodies are wildly diverse, with each having its own unique combination of substance and shape. They consist of organic material that can come from any plant or fungus and can potentially include material from multiple species. Their shapes tend to mimic those of humanoids or animals that are familiar to the person who performs their creation ritual. As a result, they're likely to superficially resemble creatures from their home world, though those created by intergalactic explorers might instead replicate fauna from faraway planets.

Society

Leshies consider families to be groups brought together by common ideals or goals rather than kinship. As spirits who have taken many physical bodies throughout their numerous lifetimes, they rarely pay heed to superficial features like physical appearance. As such, leshies form communities with people of all ancestries.

There are some correlations between the personalities of leshy spirits and the physical vessels they inhabit. It's impossible to know how much of this connection comes from an inherent tendency of certain vessels to be more hospitable to certain leshy spirits, however, and how much of it comes instead from how people's preconceptions influence both how they treat an individual leshy and how they perceive that leshy's actions. One correlation that seems to hold true is a connection between a leshy's vessel and their gender, with leshies whose bodies correspond to fungi or plants with complex reproduction strategies being more likely have nuanced gender identities. That said, leshies of all types are more likely to be agender or have multiple genders than most sapient species. Leshies with a single gender tend toward the genders that can be found among other sapient ancestries on their home worlds.

Leshies typically maintain a close connection with nature, but their attitudes toward technological development play a significant role in how they choose to live. The leshies who are most averse to technology typically form small settlements in pristine and remote wilderness areas. More tech-friendly leshies tend to live in places that combine modern innovations with flourishing wildlife, such as rural settlements or terraformed cities with ample green spaces. On the most extreme end of the spectrum, some leshies make their homes in personal gardens they plant inside of starships.

Sample Names

Cascading Rapids, Enduring Gleam of Three Moons, Ksarik's Tendrilsong, Petals in Starlight, Snowy Pine Branch, Verdant Taleweaver

Beliefs

Leshies typically follow primal faiths and philosophies connected to the life force of their planets rather than specific deities. They might also venerate natural forces, like the cycle of seasons or the twin stars that illuminate their home world.

Popular Edicts

protect nature, connect with all that lives around you, be present in the moment, remember there's a season for growth and a season for reflection

Popular Anathema

corrupt or despoil the environment, make snap judgments based on outward appearances

Leshy Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Small

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Wisdom, Free

Attribute Flaw Intelligence

Languages Common, Fey

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • leshy

  • plant

Senses Low-Light Vision

pages.content:
大多数莱西一生大半时间都在照料当地生态系统，但也有人踏入未知。他们或为保护家园外出，或响应灵魂深处探索的渴望，而这种渴望的起因已与其他记忆一起封存。

如果你想扮演拥有古老灵魂、与母星植物有内在联系的角色，就选择莱西。

你可能……

  • 努力保护自然美景，免遭污染或过度开采资源。

  • 好奇生命之间如何互动，以及星际旅行催生的新文化与生态系统。

  • 偶尔因过往化身中失落的记忆，体验既视感或怀旧之情。

他人可能……

  • 认为你比起星舰、超级城市等人造环境，更喜欢葱郁的自然环境。

  • 相信你对自然力量有超自然洞见，或拥有前世留下的神秘智慧。

  • 认为你依附母星土地，对其他行星文化了解有限。

外貌描述

莱西身体极其多样，每个个体的材质与形状都有独特组合。他们由有机物构成，可以来自任何植物或真菌，也可能包含多个物种的材料。外形通常模仿主持创造仪式者熟悉的类人生物或动物。因此，莱西大多外观近似母星生物，但由跨星系探索者创造的莱西，可能反而模仿遥远行星的动物。

社会

莱西认为，家庭是由共同理想或目标凝聚的群体，而非血缘关系。作为历经无数世、寄居过许多物质躯体的精魂，他们很少在意外貌等表面特征，因此会与各个族裔的人组成社区。

莱西精魂的性格与寄居的躯体之间，存在一些关联。但无法判断，这有多少源于某些躯体天生更适合某种莱西精魂，又有多少源于人们的成见，影响了他们如何对待个体，以及如何理解其行为。一种似乎确实存在的关联，是躯体与性别的联系：身体对应于具有复杂繁殖策略的真菌或植物的莱西，更可能拥有细致复杂的性别认同。不过，相较于多数智慧物种，各类莱西都更可能无性别或具有多重性别。单一性别的莱西，则倾向于母星其他智慧族裔中存在的性别。

莱西通常与自然紧密相连，但对技术发展的态度，大大影响着他们选择的生活。最排斥科技的莱西，通常在原始偏远的荒野建立小聚落。较接纳科技的莱西，倾向生活在现代创新与繁盛野生动植物并存之处，例如乡村聚落或绿地充足的环境改造城市。在这一光谱的最极端，有些莱西在星舰内种植私人花园，并在其中安家。

示例姓名

叠瀑奔流，三月恒辉，尸花兽之蔓歌，星光花瓣，覆雪松枝，翠绿织述者

信仰

莱西通常追随与行星生命力相连的原能信仰与哲学，而非特定神祇。他们也可能尊崇自然力量，例如四季循环，或照亮母星的双恒星。

常见典范

保护自然，与周围一切生命相连，活在当下，记住既有生长之季，也有反思之季

常见禁忌

污染或破坏环境，仅凭外貌便仓促判断

pages.name: 兽人
pages.expectedContent:
Orcs are a proud people known for their loyalty and ferocity. They tend to value principled and trustworthy allies, seek out great challenges, and choose their life paths without regret or hesitation.

You Might...

  • Not back down from a fight, even when facing a more powerful opponent.

  • Engage your companions in challenges of strength or skill to display your mastery.

  • Forge strong bonds of loyalty with your comrades, especially in times of strife.

Others Probably...

  • Admire your conviction but disapprove of your stubbornness.

  • Assume you might be violent or gruff.

  • Respect the skills and experience you've gained through hardship.

Physical Description

Orcs are brawny humanoids who stand around 7 feet tall on average. They tend to be large-boned and muscular, with thick limbs and wide shoulders. They have pointed ears and small eyes, and their lower canines grow into large tusks that jut from their mouths. Scars, tattoos, and piercings are all common adornments among orcs, as are augmentations that make no effort to hide the scars of the medical procedures that an orc underwent to receive them. Their skin color ranges over all shades of green, with the rare orc possessing a blue or even purple pigmentation. Orcs wear their augmentations and prosthetics proudly, especially if they were installed after an injury or illness.

Society

Though they once thrived in great numbers on lost Golarion, orcs are now a rare sight throughout the galaxy. Their diminished population has been the subject of scholarly debate for centuries, but the myth passed down from orc elders to their children is that their ancestors continue to walk alongside Torag in his trials somewhere in the distant stars.

Often feared and discriminated against due to their fearsome stature and gruff bearing, orcs tend to gather in small but close-knit holds. In these holds, internal battles—of personality, strength, or skill—establish a strict hierarchy of responsibility. While soldiers might fight to determine who gets the honor of charging first into battle, pilots perform stunts in competition to see who's the best equipped to lead a crew through a dangerous asteroid field, and miners challenge one another to delve the deepest and haul home the most ore.

Orc holds raise children communally. If there are enough children in a hold, they can be split up into any number of classes, with the belief that competition breeds champions. By the age of 10, orc children are apprenticed to a craft, and many will spend most of their lives perfecting that craft, as excellence in any discipline is viewed as a great virtue and as the path to self-actualization. This hierarchical and competitive societal structure can be alienating to some orcs, and those who don't wish to stay aren't obligated to. If an orc finds a calling outside their hold, they're free to pursue it, so long as they never waver from their path.

Many orcs live on Star Citadels and coexist as one people with dwarves, merging their customs and sharing their lives. Others find fame and fortune in the arenas of Arl on Akiton or chase riches as corporate bodyguards for powerful azrinaran dynasties.

Sample Names

Batta, Crag, Gower, Kella, Nakt, Rak, Siga, Uzah, Vikra, Zeek

Beliefs

he most prevalent belief held in orc societies throughout the Pact Worlds and beyond is that many orcs vanished when they were called upon by Torag to help him vanquish a terrible foe or complete a final trial. Orc worship of Torag, the dwarves' ancestral god, began on lost Golarion long before the Gap and has further united the dwarven and orc peoples into a shared culture.

Though less brutal and chaotic on the whole than depicted in history and folklore, most orcs believe the value of life comes from the glory that can be gained from overcoming significant obstacles. Increasing their strength or proving their skill in any craft earns an orc respect from their peers and hold.

Popular Edicts

persevere through hardship, live with no regrets, pursue greatness at any cost

Popular Anathema

abandon loyalties, follow a leader who hasn't proven themselves, give up

Orc Mechanics

Hit Points 10

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Two Free Attribute Boosts

pages.content:
兽人是自豪的族群，以忠诚与凶猛闻名。他们通常重视有原则、值得信任的盟友，寻求重大挑战，并毫不后悔或迟疑地选择人生道路。

你可能……

  • 即使面对更强大的对手，也不退出战斗。

  • 与同伴比拼力量或技艺，展示自己的本领。

  • 与伙伴建立牢固的忠诚纽带，尤其是在纷争之时。

他人可能……

  • 钦佩你的信念，却不赞同你的固执。

  • 认为你可能暴力或粗鲁。

  • 尊重你历经磨难获得的技能与经验。

外貌描述

兽人是强壮的类人生物，平均身高约7尺，骨架粗大，肌肉发达，四肢厚实，肩膀宽阔。他们有尖耳与小眼睛，下犬齿长成突出口外的巨大獠牙。伤疤、纹身与穿孔是常见装饰，殖装也一样，而且完全不掩饰安装手术留下的疤痕。肤色涵盖各种绿色，少数呈蓝色甚至紫色。兽人自豪地展示殖装与义肢，尤其是伤病后安装的部件。

社会

兽人曾在失落的格拉利昂大量繁衍，如今在整个星系中已很罕见。人口减少的原因数世纪以来一直是学者争论的主题，但长老向孩子传下的神话说，先祖仍在遥远群星的某处，伴随托拉格经历试炼。

骇人体形与粗犷举止常令兽人遭到畏惧、歧视，因此他们往往聚成规模小却紧密的聚落。在内部，以性格、力量或技艺的竞争，建立严格的责任层级。士兵可能比斗谁有率先冲锋的荣誉，驾驶员以特技竞赛决定谁最适合带领船员穿越危险小行星带，矿工则比谁挖得最深、运回最多矿石。

兽人聚落共同抚养儿童。若孩子足够多，就分成若干班级，相信竞争能造就强者。到10岁时，孩子已开始拜师学习一门手艺，许多人一生大半时间都在完善它，因为任何领域的卓越都是美德与自我实现的道路。这种等级分明、充满竞争的社会结构会让部分兽人疏离，不想留下的人没有留下的义务。若兽人在聚落之外找到使命，就可自由追求，只要始终不偏离自己的道路。

许多兽人住在星辰堡垒，与矮人作为同一族群共存，融合习俗，共享生活。另一些在阿基顿阿尔的竞技场追求名利，或为强大的亚兹里纳王朝担任企业保镖，追逐财富。

示例姓名

Batta, Crag, Gower, Kella, Nakt, Rak, Siga, Uzah, Vikra, Zeek

信仰

协约世界及更远处的兽人社会，最普遍的信念是：许多兽人因托拉格召唤他们协助击败可怕敌人，或完成最终试炼而消失。兽人对这位矮人先祖神的崇拜，早在大断层很久之前、失落格拉利昂上便已开始，让两族进一步融合为共享的文化。

虽然整体不如历史与传说描绘的残暴混乱，大多数兽人仍认为，生命的价值来自克服重大障碍所获得的荣耀。增强力量，或证明自己精于任何手艺，都能为兽人赢得同伴与聚落的尊重。

常见典范

在艰难中坚持，不留遗憾地生活，不惜代价追求伟大

常见禁忌

背弃忠诚，追随尚未证明自己的领袖，放弃

pages.expectedContent:
Many brenneris serve as ambassadors for their home world of Varturan. The planet hosts other sapient species, such the as crustacean grejonns, but a combination of a well-established pool of interested brenneris and diplomatic deployments lead brenneris to make up a majority of Varturans who leave the planet and explore other star systems. Both on their home world and beyond, most brenneris prefer to live in pairs or small groups, with larger communities being coalitions of such groupings. Often asked to serve as mediators and intermediaries, their ability to sense subtle shifts in emotions helps brenneris identify the underlying causes of a conflict. However, this empathetic nature has such sensitivity that a brenneri can feel physical pain when they are around others in distress. Ambassador schools' teachings include techniques on recognizing emotional dysregulation and mitigating its risks, but it remains the most common reason for early retirement from field work.

If you want to play a character who uses empathetic abilities to resolve conflict or aid their allies, you should play a brenneri.

You Might...

  • Want to weigh all sides of an argument before making a decision.

  • Take care to identify a peaceful solution to a conflict.

  • Maintain a collection of objects that comfort you.

Others Probably...

  • Expect you to lead negotiations.

  • Assume that your charms and cute looks can smooth over any social difficulty.

  • Tread gently around your emotions to avoid upsetting you.

Physical Description

Brenneris are bipedal otter-like humanoids who reach an average height of 5 feet, with typically slight builds. Their webbed claws and powerful tails make them excellent swimmers. While they can hold their breath for long periods of time, they're not truly amphibious creatures and can't breathe underwater. Their home world of Varturan is completely aquatic, which leaves them exposed to dangers from oceanic creatures such as the predatory angler of its deepest waters, the many-mouthed lumigorge.

Over millennia of evolutionary drift from their lutrine ancestors, brenneris retained their large, round, shining eyes. Their sensitive whiskers use electromagnetic signals and pheromones to sense emotions, particularly sudden shifts in mood or disposition. While these traits were originally only found in infants, almost all brenneris now retain these adaptions into adulthood. Though they react to all creatures, the intensity of the sensation they feel around emotions varies based on the strength of the feelings that they're exposed to. This sensation is especially powerful when a brenneri empathizes with creatures that they have a deep and profound relationship with, such as pets, old friends, family members, or partners.

Brenneris' hearing can detect both infrasound whale songs and ticks from the tidally migrating swillibird. Likewise, their sharp eyes help them identify danger in time to flee. With few natural defenses, their instincts are to avoid risk. When that fails, they often turn to emphasizing their more adorable features in order to disarm foes with their charm. Due to the combination of these impulses and the information from their empathetic whiskers, brenneris constantly monitor changes in their environment. In social circumstances, this can manifest as hypervigilance around changes in emotional states. When a brenneri can't immediately resolve a conflict or sense another's hidden emotions, they're likely to become quite anxious. Many carry objects that they find distracting or comforting, such as rocks or smooth shells. These are typically kept in their water-resistant armpit pouches, which aid in protecting the keepsakes from salt and moisture.

Society

Varturan brenneri communities exist in balance with the diverse range of life hosted by their home world. Water covers the planet, and what land exists drowns beneath the high tides that come every 6 hours. As one of the few semi-aquatic species, brenneris evolved to fit their niche: adapting to a constantly changing environment and surviving the cycle of submerging beneath the tide. Brenneri pods tend to establish homes on land, though each group's techniques to handle the constant ebb and flow depends on their specific environment. Some pods build their daily habits around the tide, while others build structures that stand tall above the tideline. The deep water Leundak pod invested in a technological solution and lives in a submerged dome that cycles breathable air for its inhabitants.

The brenneri pair is the keystone around which many brenneris build their lives. These partnerships vary based on what's needed. A pair can be romantic, professional, lifelong, or short-lived. Each community has its own traditions and expectations around forming pairs. Those outside of communities, such as solitary brenneris that find each other independently, typically discuss what their pairing will mean. Those that are paired up by a corporate matchmaker, such as those going offworld for work, typically undergo a 2-week trial period. This bond is dissolved whenever a member decides it is time to move on. While brenneris typically think of these small group relationships as two brenneris, pairs can include as many as six individuals. Non-brenneris also join pairs, though it does raise friendly but invasive questions.

Communities are structured around combining smaller groups into a larger one. Several pairs connect with others in a mesopod, focusing on shared goals for their community. Typically, fewer than 10 groups connect in this way, so that all individuals in a given mesopod can know each other well. These can either stay as an independent pod or can connect with other mesopods to form larger societies. The largest known pod involves five levels of organization and includes nearly 12,000 brenneris. Brenneri connections can last anywhere from a season to a lifetime, as shared goals drive the bond. An accomplished goal can be both a time of celebration and mourning, since bonds quickly fall apart when the work is finished. Outside of larger communities, independent pairs are somewhat common. Brenneris that choose a life of solitude face concern and scrutiny, particularly about the lack of alternative perspectives available to one without a partner.

Over their history, many brenneris played important roles as mediators to help bring about an end to conflicts. The first brenneri mediators assigned a member of their team to each group participating in a conflict, hoping to advocate fairly in multifaceted circumstances. More modern brenneri ambassador groups tend to prefer sending members of the same pair to the opposing parties. This method has proven to build bridges between the parties at odds, often beginning long-term diplomatic processes with the reassurance that all parties will be earnestly heard by the mediators. Ambassador pods require a minimum of two hired staff per contract (on penalty of immediate cancellation). This pressures the pairs to work through their differences and maintain strong working relationships.

Traditionally, brenneris begin their diplomatic training when they leave their family's pod as adolescents and join one composed of others around the same age. They're trained initially as mediators and sent to assist with minor conflicts. Those who prove successful enter into apprenticeships with seasoned diplomats; those who don't take to diplomatic work often find passions in other charismatic fields, such as entertainment, patient care, or marketing.

Sample Names

Algo, Dako “Bluepaw,” Krill, Ont, Preen “Cardsniff,” Seldi, Shine, Zinks

Beliefs

In times of stress, many brenneri communities focus on rafting, where individuals link arms to float as a group. When linked in a raft, their stomachs provide a dry space for babies, disabled adults, and other community members who struggle to swim to take shelter upon. Rafting also provides emergency docking points for small watercraft or for a rescue operation of tidal creatures washed out to the deep sea. A perfect microcosm for most brenneri communities, rafting embodies the collaborative social structure and practices of communal mutual aid. Brenneris often are asked to set aside their individual concerns for the betterment of the community and to center compromises while in conflict.

While worship of deities is a common practice within brenneri communities, individuals typically choose religious beliefs that mesh well with the beliefs of the community at large. Deities that emphasize connections, reconciliation, and stability have known worship within brenneri pods, such as Abadar, Hylax, and Talavet. Veneration of Zon-Shelyn has a curious practice among brenneris, with some pairs attempting to recreate their embrace.

Popular Edicts

listen to all sides of a conflict, protect the most vulnerable

Popular Anathema

force others into a community against their will, stoke conflict without purpose

Brenneri Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet, Swim 20 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Strength

Languages Brenneri, Common

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

  • humanoid

pages.content:
许多水獭人担任母星瓦图兰的大使。星球也有甲壳类格雷琼人等其他智慧物种，但愿意任职的水獭人储备充足，加上外交派遣，使离开母星、探索其他恒星系的瓦图兰居民大多是水獭人。无论在母星还是外界，他们大多喜欢结对或小群生活，较大社区则由这些群体联合组成。水獭人常受邀担任调解人与中间人，感知细微情绪变化的能力，有助于找出冲突根源。但共情过于敏锐，以致他人苦恼时，身旁的水獭人可能感到肉体疼痛。大使学校教授辨认情绪失调、降低风险的技巧，但这仍是外勤人员提前退休最常见的原因。

如果你想扮演以共情能力解决冲突、帮助盟友的角色，就选择水獭人。

你可能……

  • 决定之前，想先权衡争论的所有方面。

  • 用心寻找和平解决冲突的方法。

  • 收集能带来安慰的物件。

他人可能……

  • 期待你主导谈判。

  • 认为你的魅力与可爱外貌能摆平任何社交困境。

  • 小心对待你的情绪，避免令你不快。

外貌描述

水獭人是双足、外貌似水獭的类人生物，平均身高5尺，体格通常纤细。有蹼的爪与强壮尾巴使他们善泳。虽然能长时间屏息，他们却不是真正的两栖生物，无法水下呼吸。母星瓦图兰完全是水世界，因此他们面临海洋生物的危险，例如在最深水域引诱猎物、长着多张嘴的卢米戈雷。

经过数千年与水獭祖先的演化分化，水獭人仍保留着又大又圆、闪亮的眼睛。敏感的胡须凭电磁信号与信息素感知情绪，尤其是心情或态度的骤变。这些特征起初只存在于幼儿，如今几乎所有人都将这种适应保留到成年。虽然对所有生物都有反应，感受的强度却随所接触情绪的强弱变化。与宠物、老友、家人或伴侣等关系深厚的生物共情时，这种感受尤其强烈。

水獭人的听觉既能辨出次声波鲸歌，也能听见随潮汐迁徙的斯威利鸟的滴答鸣声。锐利眼睛同样让他们及时发现危险、逃离。他们几乎没有天然防御，本能是避开风险；若不奏效，便常突出更可爱的特征，以魅力化解敌意。这些本能加上共情胡须提供的信息，使他们持续留意环境变化。社交时，这可能表现为过度警惕情绪变化。无法立即解决冲突，或无法察觉他人隐藏的情绪时，水獭人容易相当焦虑。许多人携带能分散注意或安抚自己的物件，例如石头或光滑贝壳，通常存放在防水腋袋内，保护纪念品不受盐分与湿气侵害。

社会

瓦图兰水獭人社区与母星丰富多样的生命保持平衡。水覆盖整颗星球，已有陆地也会被每6小时一次的高潮淹没。作为少数半水生物种，水獭人演化出适合自身生态位的能力：适应不断变化的环境，熬过周期性的涨潮淹没。水獭人族群通常在陆地安家，应对潮汐的方法却随当地环境而异。有些围绕潮汐安排日常，有些建造高过潮线的建筑。深水中的勒恩达克族群投资技术方案，住在为居民循环提供可呼吸空气的水下穹顶中。

结对是许多水獭人生活的基石。这种伙伴关系因需求而异，可以关乎爱情或职业，可以终身，也可以短暂。每个社区对于结对有自己的传统与期待。社区之外，例如独自相遇的水獭人，通常会讨论这段关系的意义。由企业媒人配对的人，例如要去外星工作者，通常有两周试用期。任何成员决定离开时，关系便解除。虽然水獭人通常认为这种小群关系由两人组成，实际结对最多可包含六个个体。非水獭人也能加入，但会招来友善却侵犯隐私的询问。

社区的结构，是将小群结合成大群。数个结对组成中级族群，专注于社区的共同目标。这种连接通常少于十组，确保每人都能熟悉彼此。它们可维持独立族群，也能与其他中级族群联合，形成更大社会。已知最大族群有五层组织，包含近12000名水獭人。共同目标维持联系，因此关系短可一季，长可终身。目标达成既值得庆祝，也令人哀伤，因为工作结束，纽带便迅速散开。较大社区之外，独立结对颇常见。选择独居者会受到担忧与审视，尤其是没有伙伴，便缺少其他观点可供参考。

历史上，许多水獭人调解者对终结冲突起过重要作用。最早的调解者向每个冲突方各分派一名团队成员，希望在复杂多边局势中公平代言。现代大使团则更倾向于把同一结对的成员分别派给对立双方。这一方法被证明能在双方之间架桥，常让各方相信调解者会认真倾听自己，并由此开启长期外交进程。大使族群每份合约至少需雇用两名工作人员，否则立即取消合约。这促使伙伴化解分歧，维持牢固的工作关系。

传统上，水獭人在青少年时离开家庭族群，加入同龄人族群，开始外交训练。最初接受调解训练，被派去帮助处理小冲突。表现成功者成为资深外交官的学徒；不适合外交工作者，常在娱乐、病患照护或营销等其他注重魅力的领域找到热情。

示例姓名

Algo，Dako“蓝爪”，Krill，Ont，Preen“嗅卡”，Seldi，Shine，Zinks

信仰

遭遇压力时，许多水獭人社区重视结筏：彼此挽臂，成群漂浮。结成筏时，肚皮为婴儿、残疾成年人和其他游泳困难的社区成员提供干燥的庇护处。结筏也能为小水船提供紧急停靠点，或救援被潮水冲向深海的潮间带生物。对大多数水獭人社区而言，结筏是完美缩影，体现协作的社会结构与集体互助实践。他们常被要求暂放个人顾虑，为社区谋益，并在冲突中以妥协为重。

水獭人社区普遍崇拜神祇，个人通常选择与整体社区信念相合的宗教。族群中常见强调联系、和解与稳定的神祇信仰，例如阿巴达尔、海拉丝与塔拉维特。水獭人对宗-莎琳的崇拜有项奇特习俗，有些结对尝试重现两神的拥抱。

常见典范

倾听冲突各方，保护最脆弱者

常见禁忌

违背意愿强迫他人加入社区，无故煽动冲突

pages.expectedContent:
The planet Tabrid Minor in Near Space has spent several years petitioning to become a protectorate of the Pact Worlds. Copaxis, the most abundant sapient species from Tabrid Minor, once governed the planet from magical flying cities. They lived in prosperous hubs of discovery; their cities were majestic, filled with universities, magical monuments, and monasteries. Copaxis maintained an innate connection and shared an evolutionary history with copi, a coral-like substance containing powerful cosmic gravitational forces. Using this magical connection, copaxis created a thriving society.

Everything changed after the Gap, when copaxis realized they could harvest copi to be used as fuel and building materials for starships. This was the beginning of a destructive era of civil war, rapid industrialization, fear, suppression—and the severance of copaxis from their flying cities and ancient magical traditions.

If you want to play a member of a species who can adapt their coral-like body over time, from a planet being destroyed by rapid industrialization, and with an innate but slumbering connection to magical and cosmic gravitational forces, then you should play a copaxi.

You Might...

  • Be set in your ways despite your ancestry's inherent ability to evolve over time.

  • Be accustomed to living in unpredictable, unsafe environments.

  • Have an extremely positive or negative view of authority figures.

Others Probably...

  • Don't recognize you after you change your body over time.

  • Think your species once lived underwater, rather than in the skies.

  • Assume you're suspicious of androids, robots, and other tech creatures.

Physical Description

Copaxis are complex colonies of coral-like polyps who typically develop into anthropomorphic forms, though some copaxis grow additional limbs or other atypical anatomical features. A segmented exoskeleton of calcium-rich shell covers most of a copaxi's body, and they develop elaborate crests on their heads, often called antlers, that help outsiders identify individuals. Most copaxis recognize one another by scent and need not rely on these crests, except when spotting each other from a distance.

Copaxis can passively—almost subconsciously—control the growth of the polyps that form their bodies. These polyps also gradually replace each other over the course of a copaxi's life. As a result, copaxis can change and reshape their physical appearance over time.

Each individual polyp in a copaxi's body plays a specific role in their anatomy. Feeding polyps, which copaxis typically grow near the part of their face where other creatures might have a mouth, include a set of five tentacles about 2 inches long suitable for filter feeding or catching extremely small prey; these tentacles are usually retracted into the copaxi's body and pose little threat to larger targets beyond painful scratches. The individual polyps' bodies extend beneath a copaxi's exoskeleton, intertwining with the other polyps in the copaxi's body to create muscle fiber and specialized tissues and organs. Though each polyp is an individual creature in its own right, and a copaxi's body is a “colony” of such polyps, a copaxi is also an individual being; the polyps create tissues for thinking and processing information, sensing a copaxi's surroundings, processing and storing nutrients, eliminating toxins, and even reproducing, which copaxis do asexually.

Society

Copaxis once existed in a near-utopia of flying cities powered by their mystical connection to copi, an unintelligent, coral-like organism that once covered Tabrid Minor. Copi have a supernatural attunement to the cosmic forces of gravity, and ancient copaxis used this mystical connection to create their sky cities.

In 3 AG, Triune's Signal reached Tabrid Minor. Copaxi inventors learned they could refine copi into a semi-organic alloy suitable for constructing and fueling starships. While technological innovators drove copaxi society to construct a massive fleet to explore the stars, traditionalists clung to ancient mysticism and warned that the overly aggressive destruction of copi would spell the planet's doom.

War followed. This schism shattered copaxi mystical traditions, toppled the government, and eventually led copaxis to abandon their flying cities. They industrialized the surface of their planet and eradicated much of the planet's copi to fuel societal and technological progress. Part of the industrial revolution on Tabrid Minor involved the use of a robot labor force to expedite mining operations and construction, but the newly reformed copaxi government of the time ordered the eradication of the robots when their machines began to display signs of sapience.

Copaxis are only now beginning to realize that the rapid industrialization of Tabrid Minor inflicted catastrophic and irreversible damage to the planet's ecosystems. Tensions between the common people and wealthy elites are on the rise. In recent years, an anonymous corporate sponsor funded a massive starship project to revitalize copaxi space travel, hoping to save their society by finding new resources or new worlds to colonize. After learning of other, far more powerful threats in Near Space, Tabrid Minor's government applied for Pact Worlds protectorate status, seeking the assistance of the Starfinder Society to evaluate their planet for membership as a protectorate world; the petition remains pending.

Although copaxis reproduce asexually, they occasionally form long-term romantic bonds. They traditionally have no gender, though some have embraced more nuanced concepts of their personal gender identity after interacting with cultures beyond Tabrid Minor.

Names among copaxis consist of a “shell name” and a “flesh name,” each between one and three syllables in length. Copaxi communities grant flesh names to young clusters of polyps that have united to begin forming an adult copaxi. Once the exoskeleton is complete and a nascent crest is forming, the new adult selects a shell name to combine with their given flesh name.

Sample Names

Bryanisis, Gnaucara, Panacula, Therseis, Wherbai

Beliefs

The government of Tabrid Minor has spent decades suppressing knowledge of the planet's past, especially its history of civil war and ecological destruction. As a result, most modern copaxis have only recently begun uncovering their planet's history. Most admit that Tabrid Minor's rapid industrialization has caused serious damage to the planet, but only the most well-informed government agents know the extent of the damage or comprehend their species' faltering connection to copi. After Tabrid Minor first sought protectorate status in the Pact Worlds, the government cracked down even harder on any societal or historical introspection, believing Tabrid Minor's fraught history could undermine its chances of being accepted as a protectorate. Thanks to propaganda and manipulation by their ever- present government, most copaxis are content to go about their lives, play their part in society, and not ask too many questions about the past.

The government strictly monitors technological and magical advancements and has instilled superstitious fear of both sentient machines and mysticism in the populace; as a result, most copaxis know very little about the history of robotic life on the planet and are hesitant to study or rely on anything magical. Some copaxis must grapple with these beliefs even as they rediscover their own connection to magic.

Popular Edicts

doubt and question the statements of authority figures, embrace modern values, follow and respect authority figures, do your part for the greater community

Popular Anathema

ask too many questions, stay silent about the misdeeds of authority figures, step outside your assigned responsibilities, study forbidden subjects (especially magic)

Copaxi Mechanics

Hit Points 6

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Wisdom

Languages Common, Copaxi

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • copaxi

  • humanoid

pages.content:
近宇的小塔布里德星球已申请数年，希望成为协约世界保护领。珊瑚人是当地数量最多的智慧物种，曾从魔法浮空城统治行星。他们生活在繁荣的探索中心，城市宏伟，遍布大学、魔法纪念碑与修道院。他们与科皮珊瑚有天生联系和共同演化史；这种类珊瑚物质蕴含强大的宇宙引力。凭借魔法联结，珊瑚人创造了繁荣社会。

大断层之后，一切都变了。珊瑚人发现可以采收科皮，作为星舰燃料与建材。于是，内战、迅速工业化、恐惧与压迫的毁灭性时代开始，他们也与浮空城及古老魔法传统割裂。

如果你想扮演能随时间调整珊瑚般身体、来自遭快速工业化摧毁的星球，与魔法和宇宙引力有着天生却沉睡联系的物种成员，就选择珊瑚人。

你可能……

  • 尽管族裔天生能随时间演变，你仍固守习惯。

  • 习惯不可预测、不安全的环境。

  • 对权威人物抱持极其正面或负面的看法。

他人可能……

  • 你改变身体之后，认不出你。

  • 以为你的族人曾住在水下，而非天空。

  • 认为你怀疑仿生人、机器人与其他科技生物。

外貌描述

珊瑚人是由类似珊瑚的虫体组成的复杂群体，通常长成人形，但有些会长出额外肢体或其他不寻常的身体结构。富钙甲壳构成分节外骨骼，覆盖大部分身体，头部则生出精巧冠饰，常称为顶角，帮助外人辨认个体。大多数珊瑚人通过气味认识彼此，不必依赖冠饰，除非远远望见对方。

珊瑚人能被动地、几乎下意识地控制体内虫体的生长。这些虫体也会在其一生中逐渐相互更替，因此，他们能随时间改变、重塑外貌。

体内每个虫体都有特定生理职能。进食虫体通常长在其他生物生嘴的面部位置，带五条约2英寸长的触手，适于滤食或捕捉极小猎物。触手通常缩在体内，对较大目标除了造成痛苦划伤外，威胁甚微。单个虫体延伸到外骨骼下，彼此交织，形成肌肉纤维与特化组织、器官。虽然每个虫体都是独立生物，珊瑚人的身体是它们组成的“群落”，一名珊瑚人仍是独立个体：虫体构成思考、处理信息、感知周围、处理储存营养、排除毒素，甚至繁殖的组织。珊瑚人通过无性方式繁殖。

社会

珊瑚人曾生活在近乎乌托邦的浮空城中，以自身与科皮的神秘联系供能。科皮是没有智慧的类珊瑚生物，曾覆盖小塔布里德。它们与宇宙引力有超自然调谐，古代珊瑚人利用这种神秘联结构筑空中城市。

AG3年，三贤一的信标到达小塔布里德。珊瑚人发明家发现，可以把科皮提炼为半有机合金，用来建造星舰、提供燃料。技术创新者推动社会建造庞大舰队，探索群星，传统主义者则坚持古老神秘信仰，警告过度破坏科皮将招致行星毁灭。

随后爆发战争。分裂摧毁了神秘传统，推翻政府，最终令珊瑚人放弃浮空城。他们将行星表面工业化，铲除大部分科皮，为社会与技术进步供能。小塔布里德工业革命也使用机器人劳力，加快采矿与建设，但机器开始显现智慧后，当时刚改革的珊瑚人政府下令消灭它们。

直到如今，珊瑚人才开始意识到，迅速工业化已给行星生态带来灾难性、不可逆的损害。平民与富裕精英间的紧张加剧。近年，一位匿名企业赞助者资助大型星舰项目，振兴太空旅行，希望找到新资源或可殖民世界，拯救社会。得知近宇其他强大得多的威胁后，政府申请协约世界保护领地位，并寻求寻星者协会协助，评估行星能否加入；申请仍在等待处理。

珊瑚人虽无性繁殖，偶尔也建立长期爱情关系。传统上没有性别，但接触小塔布里德之外的文化后，有些接受了更细致复杂的个人性别认同。

珊瑚人的名字由“壳名”与“肉名”组成，各长一至三个音节。社区为已结合、开始长成成年珊瑚人的幼年虫体群取肉名。外骨骼完整、初生冠饰开始形成时，新成年人会自选壳名，与获授的肉名结合。

示例姓名

Bryanisis, Gnaucara, Panacula, Therseis, Wherbai

信仰

小塔布里德政府数十年来一直压制关于过去的知识，尤其是内战与生态破坏史。因此，大多数现代珊瑚人直到最近才开始发现母星历史。多数承认工业化造成严重损害，但只有消息最灵通的政府人员，才知道损害程度、理解本族与科皮联系的衰退。首次向协约世界寻求保护领地位后，政府更严厉打击社会与历史反思，担心坎坷历史损害获准机会。无处不在的政府宣传与操纵，让多数珊瑚人安于日常生活、尽社会职责，不对过去问太多。

政府严格监控科技与魔法进展，向公众灌输对智慧机器与神秘信仰的迷信恐惧。因此，多数人很不了解行星机器生命的历史，也犹豫是否研究或依赖魔法。有些珊瑚人即使重新发现自身与魔法的联系，也必须与这些信念搏斗。

常见典范

怀疑并质问权威人物的说法，接纳现代价值观，追随并尊重权威人物，为更大社区尽责

常见禁忌

问太多问题，对权威人物的不当行为保持沉默，超出分配的职责，研究禁忌主题，尤其是魔法

珊瑚人规则数据

体型 中型

速度 25尺

属性缺陷 感知

Entu symbiotes are created when an unintelligent animal consumes entu spores. If you want to play a friendly fungal colony and its host, you should play an entu.

You Might...

  • Say “we” and “us” when speaking about yourself.

  • Be fastidious about your personal space to prevent accidental contamination.

  • Enjoy cooperating with others.

Others Probably...

  • Are fascinated by your appearance.

  • Wonder if you're a parasitic host.

  • Fear contamination from your spores.

Physical Description

In their natural form, entu spores grow long mycelia and colorful fruiting bodies, weaving with other entu into vast, tapestry-like colonies. Most entu symbiotes appear as animals with uncannily expressive faces and gestures, covered in bright mushrooms sprouting from their fur, skin, feathers, or scales. The concentration of entu mycelia and fruiting bodies increases as the host ages.

Society

Entu spores fell on many worlds, but they thrived on Agillae-2's abandoned forests where they joined with bat-like neleks to become the first symbiote called nelentu.

Sample Names

Entus view all individuals as parts of the same whole and see no purpose in differentiating themselves from one another. Entu symbiotes tend to adopt simple names that identify them to outsiders, usually based on their societal role or physical appearance. Some entu symbiote names include Bright Eyes, Gardener, Fury, Moonsinger, Protector Gray, Red Wings, Silver Tufts, and Treat Maker.

Beliefs

Entu partnerships believe in reincarnation. Deceased hosts nourish generations of new spores, and entus never die as long as another of their kind exists.

Popular Edicts

help others grow, respect consent, thrive together

Popular Anathema

selfishly harm another

Size Small

Speed 20 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Wisdom, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

无智慧的动物吞食因图孢子，就会形成因图共生体。如果你想扮演友善的真菌群落与其宿主，就选择因图。

你可能……

  • 谈到自己时，用“我们”而非“我”。

  • 极其讲究个人空间，避免意外污染。

  • 喜欢与他人合作。

他人可能……

  • 对你的外貌着迷。

  • 怀疑你是否是寄生生物的宿主。

  • 害怕你的孢子造成污染。

外貌描述

自然形态下，因图孢子长出长菌丝与多彩子实体，与其他因图交织成巨大的挂毯般菌群。大多数共生体看似动物，却有异常丰富的表情与动作，毛发、皮肤、羽毛或鳞片上冒出鲜艳蘑菇。宿主越年长，菌丝与子实体就越密集。

社会

因图孢子曾落在许多世界，在阿吉拉2号废弃的森林中尤其繁盛，与蝙蝠般的内勒克蝠结合，成为最早的共生体，称为内勒因图。

示例姓名

因图将所有个体视为同一整体的一部分，觉得彼此区分毫无意义。共生体通常按社会角色或外貌取简单名字，方便外人辨认，例如明眸、园丁、狂怒、月歌者、灰护者、红翼、银簇和点心匠。

信仰

因图伙伴相信转世。死去的宿主滋养一代代新孢子，只要还有同类存在，因图就永远不会死。

常见典范

帮助他人成长，尊重同意，共同繁荣

常见禁忌

自私地伤害他人
