松鼠狐人原生于卡斯卓韦森林，后来不断追寻满足无尽好奇心的机会，散布到盟约诸界乃至更远的地方。他们是卡斯卓韦最先获赐三贤一信号的种族，信号刻在阿普罗科夸广阔的走廊上；那是规模最大、人口最多的松鼠狐人洞穴。虽然他们自己缺乏利用漂流域引擎的技术，强烈渴望见证语言力量的心情，仍促使他们与卡斯卓韦其他居民分享知识，确保没有单一种族或家族能囤积、滥用星际旅行知识。

建立联系后，松鼠狐人开始在第一批能够进行漂流域航行的飞船上工作。越来越多人带着壮阔的星际冒险故事归来，年轻的星际旅者便纷纷走出森林树冠的地平线，探索更远之处。这些早期银河旅者热爱语言学，迅速学会新语言，很快以翻译天赋闻名。有些行星有数百种方言需要解析，松鼠狐人能够捕捉、复述语言中的细微差别，因此依赖他们的大使、商人和异星考古学家，比依赖机器翻译的人更占优势。同样，接触异星科技，也让松鼠狐人对计算机科学的兴趣激增，专注于改进计算机语言，使不同世界的技术尽可能兼容。突然采纳先进科技并未损害他们与自然的纽带，反而拓展了对造化的理解：他们将新文化和工具视为奇妙的新事物，就如新发现的树木或松鼠狐种类，同样自然地属于其世界。

如今，松鼠狐人遍布宇宙，热情地在各个世界之间旅行。许多人经常造访卡斯卓韦，但艾巴萨罗姆空间站作为漂流域旅行枢纽，已成为族群的第二家园。

如果你希望扮演一个机巧、自由奔放，沉醉于宇宙隐喻叙事的奇思与语言之中的种族，就应该选择松鼠狐人。

你可能……

  • 十分看重语言与词语的力量。

  • 难以把握边界，无论是个体之间，还是概念之间。

  • 极度渴望了解新事物，又同样迅速地失去兴趣。

他人可能……

  • 误以为你是大号松鼠狐。

  • 觉得你一旦发誓，就非常值得信任。

  • 以为你能毫不费力地与任何事物交流。

外貌描述

松鼠狐人外貌像松鼠狐，一种仿佛松鼠与狐狸混合的动物，但体型约是这种小动物的两倍，通常双足行走。毛色从橘红到棕色或黄褐色不等，躯干常有白毛。冬季里，蓬松毛被往往变厚，寒冷地区出身者还能长出冬毛。以染料或全息皮肤给毛被上色十分常见；某些家族长期向特定神祇宣誓效忠，其后代出生时便有类似宗教符号的毛斑，虽罕见，却并非闻所未闻。

有些松鼠狐人有多条尾巴。这些额外尾巴通常随时间长出，常在重大人生事件后，一夜间冒出来。天生双尾的松鼠狐人十分少见，被认为有自然的魔法天赋；由于寻找优秀学生的施法者常会发掘双尾孩子，这往往成为自我实现的预言。历史上最强的松鼠狐人施法者，拥有多达九条浓密漂亮的尾巴，这支持了一种理论：额外尾巴即使不是魔力的储库，至少也是其标志。

社会

卡斯卓韦的松鼠狐人通常住在各片森林最大树木下的公共洞穴，在那里养育后代，躲避风雨。成年人结合树栖技艺与原能魔法，在社群树木的高枝上培育、编织活体球茎状居所，在其中经营对外业务、享受阳光。他们在艾巴萨罗姆空间站的贾特比公园，以及其他同样拥有茂密森林与丛林的遥远世界，也采用类似生活方式。

松鼠狐人是杂食的狩猎采集者，长久以来以自行种植、或与盟约诸界乃至广阔宇宙其他文化贸易所得的食物补充饮食。他们以叶片包裹发酵肉类与浆果的传统料理，是卡斯卓韦大都市的一道特色美食。总体而言，他们勇于尝试食物，总愿意实验、品尝新滋味。

许多松鼠狐人难以理解边界，无论物理还是哲学上的。若未接触其他文化的哲学，他们常难以理解文明与荒野、科技与魔法、个人与公共财产资源，甚至家人与朋友的区别。大多数人能学好正式定义，足以理解相关用语，却常在思索差异时，花上一段时间与自己口头辩论，让原本只问了个基本问题的人感到恼火。

见识广博的松鼠狐人会教孩子尊重其他种族的边界，但一旦产生情感纽带，无论正面或负面，便常忍不住用手、脸颊和尾巴进行触觉交流。这种非言语沟通是松鼠狐人语的重要部分。该语言是由无数其他语言混合而成、用于会话且不以词汇为基础的混杂语。任何松鼠狐人都能本能理解这种不断演变的语言，无论他们将何种传统融入其庞大词汇体系，因为他们会运用非言语与声调线索；要充分表达这些线索，需要两只空手和至少一条尾巴。

松鼠狐人的名字是银河中最丰富多样的之一。即使从未离开卡斯卓韦的家族，也喜欢为孩子融入外星名字、创造全新词语，就算命名方式毫无道理，例如无缘无故在名字后加数字。搬家时选取新名字的情况并不少见，尤其是新社群觉得原名难以发音，或因不巧的语言巧合，一说就忍不住发笑。

示例姓名

3een（“Threen”）、Axlyë、–ly（“Dashly”）、Gribbers、Jenpuh、Kinpopo、Lingua、Nin2、Pikamika、Skew、Tchlik XII、Vilawila、Zonnix

信仰

松鼠狐人的传统信仰，与其说将语言捧上神坛，不如说抱持一元论：万物都是包罗一切的叙事的一部分。创世并非某位造物主的圣歌，而是超越任何单一实体意志、无所不在的剧本。既然叙事涵盖万物，它便无法被单独分离或控制，因为任何修改故事的尝试，都只是在继续其自然进程。拥有自由意志，意味着能够理解、欣赏自己在宏大创世叙事中的角色；然而，自由意志究竟意味着什么，也正是这一传统常更适合归类为思想实验，而非严肃形而上学立场的原因。

想要理解叙事内部运作的松鼠狐人，往往最终成为伊洛里图的信徒，常致力于理解奥术或异能魔法；只是欣赏故事的人，则与卡拉邦或塔拉维特教会产生共鸣。经常旅行者接触大量语言，多数享受这种多样性，关注语言的广泛模式，而非深究少数语言的意义。这些旅者常崇拜黛丝娜、韦丹或三贤一。另一些人认为艺术是沟通的最高形式，开始崇拜宗-莎琳。

松鼠狐人相信，用松鼠狐人语确认誓言，会将话语与灵魂绑定；违约会令背誓者不可挽回地失去一部分自我，必须为此赎罪。他们从不轻视友谊、婚姻甚至派系效忠的纽带。同样，一旦受到宗教感召，松鼠狐人也会成为格外虔诚的信徒。他们最常侍奉狐狸的守护女神大狐女，相信她将一小部分实言能力，以松鼠狐人语的形式赐给族群。正如祖先庇护神的传说，他们相信语言的馈赠既是工具，也是武器。虽然背誓是严重禁忌，即使正直的松鼠狐人，也不会介意用巧妙措辞扭转契约来保护自己，甚至利用对手。

数量令人不安的松鼠狐人被束缚于魔族庇护者希瓦斯卡，她是求而不得的欲望与债务束缚的恶魔领主。据说，大断层期间，她的一名仆从——名为曲解、形似松鼠狐的神使——以一份被遗忘的契约，束缚了某个显赫松鼠狐人家族的灵魂。十二代后，这个家族已散布无数世界，人数达数千。

常见典范

拥抱整体，而非仅是各部分之和，保护与你建立纽带的人，尊重他人的话语

常见禁忌

背弃誓言，背叛伴侣，审查或以其他方式阻止交流

pages.name: 纺蛛人
pages.expectedContent:
Known as the crafters of the Szandite Collective, atraxids are cunning, spiderlike people from the planet Zulphan.

Atraxids are known first and foremost as crafters, and they highly value technology. When the Szandite Collective began to communicate with each other, atraxids were the first to build starships. They love puzzles and riddles, and they often compete with each other for who can develop the most devious brainteasers. Atraxids also enjoy altering their minds in other ways, and many psychedelic drugs are a popular pastime on Zulphan. They also enjoy dancing, and traditional atraxid dances are quite intricate; with so many legs involved, it takes a while to learn every step. If you want to play a spiderlike innovator with a penchant for dance and riddles, you should play an atraxid.

You Might...

  • Like solving problems.

  • Take comfort in formality and assigned roles.

  • Hold yourself to extremely high standards.

Others Probably...

  • Assume you are highly technical.

  • Are sometimes nervous around you.

  • Think they can get drugs from you.

Physical Description

Atraxids have four pairs of limbs, walking on six legs with two limbs they use as arms to accomplish delicate work. They have one large pair of eyes surrounded by three smaller pairs of eyes and have curved fangs protruding from their mouths. Atraxids are black or gray in color, though they have a penchant for brightly colored clothing and jewelry. Their bodies are covered in fine hair, and they find elaborate headpieces quite fashionable.

Society

Similar to their dancing, traditional atraxid society has complicated and formal etiquette, though missteps aren't held against visitors. This complexity sometimes makes outsiders perceive atraxids as more aloof or cold than they truly are.

Traditionally, atraxids trapped their prey, though they have embraced farming in the modern day. Their cities are built as high as possible: on cliffs, on trees, and even on artificial stilts. Visitors from species who can't climb are often fitted with safety gear in case of falls. The levels of atraxid cities closest to the ground are where visitors tend to stay, though these are also a hotbed for criminals.

Atraxids generally don't form lifelong romantic relationships, instead forming temporary partnerships to raise offspring and then moving along to other interests or a different partner. Close friendships are often viewed as more important than romantic pairings. While long-term romances are unusual, they aren't taboo.

Atraxid names are typically a combination of both of their parents' names, which leads to siblings having very similar names. They do not traditionally have surnames.

Sample Names Clirikiara, Karkicado, Aclidiakra

Beliefs

Atraxids value innovation and cunning. They traditionally are not religious, though some atraxids have taken to worshipping gods as other species have settled on Zulphan. Among this group, worship of Eloritu is most common. Atraxids think that szandite crystals are capable of advancing many kinds of technology if studied enough, though the Collective limits such uses.

Many atraxids are highly ambitious and often competitive. They sometimes look down on those who've accomplished less.

Popular Edicts

discover new things, achieve greatness, learn from others

Popular Anathema

deliberately break technology, give up on your goals, be rude to visitors from other places

Atraxid Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Medium

Speed 20 feet, climb 20 feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Wisdom

Languages Atraxid, Common, Szandite

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • atraxid

  • beast

  • humanoid

Senses Darkvision

Climbing Prowess

pages.content:
纺蛛人以桑迪特联合体的工匠闻名，是来自祖尔凡行星、机敏而形似蜘蛛的族群。

纺蛛人首先以工匠闻名，极为重视科技。桑迪特联合体各方开始相互交流时，纺蛛人最先建造星舰。他们喜爱谜题和谜语，常比赛谁能设计最刁钻的脑筋急转弯。他们也喜欢以其他方式改变心智，许多迷幻药物因此成为祖尔凡流行的消遣。他们还爱跳舞；传统纺蛛人舞蹈十分复杂，涉及如此多条腿，学会每一步都得花些时间。如果你希望扮演一个爱好舞蹈和谜语、形似蜘蛛的创新者，就应该选择纺蛛人。

你可能……

  • 喜欢解决问题。

  • 在正式礼仪和分派的职责中感到安心。

  • 对自己要求极高。

他人可能……

  • 以为你技术精湛。

  • 在你身边有时会紧张。

  • 以为能从你这里取得毒品。

外貌描述

纺蛛人有四对肢体，六条用作行走的腿，两条用作手臂，完成精细工作。他们有一对大眼睛，周围环绕三对小眼睛，嘴里伸出弯曲尖牙。身体是黑或灰色，却偏爱鲜艳衣物和珠宝。体表覆盖细毛，精巧的头饰在他们看来颇为时尚。

社会

与舞蹈相似，传统纺蛛人社会的礼仪复杂而正式，不过不会因外来者失误而责怪他们。这种复杂性有时让外人觉得纺蛛人比实际更加疏离冷淡。

纺蛛人传统上设陷阱捕猎，但现代已接受农耕。他们将城市尽量建高，建于悬崖、树上，甚至人造高架支柱上。不会攀爬的种族前来造访，常会配备安全装备，以防坠落。访客通常住在最接近地面的城市层级，不过那里也是罪犯的温床。

纺蛛人通常不缔结终生恋爱关系，而是暂时结伴抚育后代，随后转向其他兴趣或伴侣。亲密友谊往往比恋爱伴侣更重要。长期恋情虽少见，却并非禁忌。

纺蛛人的名字通常结合双亲的名字，因而手足的名字非常相似。传统上，他们没有姓氏。

范例名字 Clirikiara、Karkicado、Aclidiakra

信仰

纺蛛人重视创新与机敏。传统上他们不信宗教，但随着其他种族在祖尔凡定居，有些纺蛛人开始敬拜神祇，其中最常见的是伊洛里图。纺蛛人相信，只要研究足够深入，桑迪特水晶便能推进多种技术，不过联合体限制了这类用途。

许多纺蛛人野心勃勃，常有竞争心，有时会看不起成就较少的人。

常见典范

发现新事物，成就伟业，向他人学习

常见禁忌

蓄意破坏科技，放弃目标，对其他地方的访客无礼

纺蛛人规则数据

生命值 8

体型 中型

速度 20尺，攀爬20尺

属性提升 敏捷、智力、自选

属性缺陷 感知

语言 纺蛛人语、通用语、桑迪特语

额外语言 数量等于智力调整值（若为正值）。从常见语言列表及你拥有许可的其他语言中选择，例如母星通行的语言。

特征

  • 纺蛛人

  • 魔兽

  • 类人

pages.name: 沼栖族
pages.expectedContent:
Binnaquids are quiet swamp-dwellers from the planet Czelle, known for patience, stealth, and family loyalty.

Ancient binnaquids were ambush hunters who would lie in wait for their prey to get near, then attack. To this day, they are known for the strong bonds of kinship they form with their families and friends across the Szandite Collective.

You Might...

  • Wait for a long time before making up your mind.

  • Enjoy rest and relaxation.

  • Be close to your family.

Others Probably...

  • Think that you are less intelligent than you are.

  • Assume you are fully aquatic.

  • Respect your patience.

Physical Description

Binnaquids are well adapted for their swampy homelands. Their mottled bluegreen coloration blends in beautifully with the water, and a small protrusion atop their heads allows them to breathe while the rest of their body is submerged underwater. Their wide mouths are filled with sharp, spiny teeth. They don't have a protruding nose, just two small slits. They have two arms and two legs, and their hands and feet are both slightly webbed. Binnaquids on Czelle tend to dress in clothing that matches their skin tone, allowing them to easily hide in the murky water, though those who live off-planet often experiment with other colors.

Society

Binnaquids still build their homes in the swamp, and generally have at least part of their houses flooded. This is harsh on building materials, and binnaquid cities are noted for frequent construction as old buildings come down and new ones go up. Binnaquids generally expect visitors to adapt to the dampness rather than building on dry land for them. Spacefaring binnaquids tend to take frequent baths to avoid having their moist skin dry out.

Binnaquids have tight-knit family groups and usually live in multigenerational households, typically in multi-building compounds. They frequently have pets, both aquatic and terrestrial.

Binnaquids have a vibrant musical culture, with some instruments that can only be played aboveground and some that can only be played underwater. They additionally enjoy underwater sports, and many aquatic species have taken up traditional binnaquid sports. These include dakeshar, a game that involves two teams swimming in laps, trying to get a special baton around the loop the most times while the other team blocks, and sagrint, a sport that involves throwing javelins the furthest distance underwater.

The Binnaquid language, including names, uses softer sounds. Binnaquid surnames indicate their family. After marriage, the new binnaquid family uses the last name of whichever of their families of origin they live with. Binnaquids moving off-planet are developing new naming traditions, sometimes making up new last names. If a binnaquid is cast out by their family, rather than leaving on their own, they are forbidden from continuing to use their family's last name. Thus, a binnaquid who goes by only one name usually has a sad story to tell.

Sample First Names Mirassa, Arso, Ninosa

Sample Surnames Garalish, Dakashati, Assimsa

Beliefs

Patience is one of the biggest virtues in binnaquid society, along with loyalty to one’s family. They traditionally worshipped the great ocean spirit Aspalasch, but this spirit hasn’t been seen in centuries, and younger binnaquids often worship other deities, including Hylax, Yaresa, and ZonShelyn. Elder binnaquids generally hold true to their faith in Aspalasch and assume that their patience will be rewarded.

They generally consider szandite crystals to be holy, a gift from Aspalasch or another deity. They revere the ability of the crystals to create community over long distances.

Popular Edicts

think before you act, keep up traditions

Popular Anathema

betray your family, rush into danger, abuse animals

Binnaquid Mechanics

Hit Points 10

Size Medium

Speed 25 feet, swim 15 feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Wisdom, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

Languages Binnaquid, Common, Szandite

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • beast

  • binnaquid

  • humanoid

Senses darkvision

Breathing Underwater

pages.content:
沼栖族是泽勒星安静的沼泽居民，以耐心、隐匿和对家族的忠诚闻名。

古代沼栖族是伏击猎人，潜伏等待猎物靠近后发动攻击。直到今天，他们仍以在桑迪特联合体各处与亲友建立牢固的亲属纽带闻名。

你可能……

  • 决定之前先等上很久。

  • 享受休息与放松。

  • 与家人十分亲密。

他人可能……

  • 觉得你不如实际聪明。

  • 以为你完全水生。

  • 尊重你的耐心。

外貌描述

沼栖族极适应沼泽故乡，斑驳的蓝绿色皮肤与水色完美融合。头顶的小突起使他们能在身体其余部分浸没时呼吸，宽嘴里满是尖锐棘状牙齿。他们没有突出的鼻子，只有两条小缝，有两臂两腿，手脚略带蹼。泽勒星上的沼栖族常穿与肤色相配的衣物，便于藏在浑水中；离开母星生活的人则常尝试其他颜色。

社会

沼栖族仍在沼泽建家，房屋通常至少有一部分浸在水里。这很损耗建材，城市因而以经常拆旧建新的施工闻名。他们通常期望访客适应潮湿，而不是特地为其在旱地上建屋。太空旅行的沼栖族常洗澡，以免湿润的皮肤干燥。

沼栖族家庭关系紧密，通常多代同堂，住在多栋建筑组成的院落。他们常饲养宠物，水生陆生都有。

沼栖族音乐文化充满活力，有些乐器只能在地上演奏，有些则只能在水下。他们也喜欢水下运动，许多水生种族已开始参与其传统项目。其中有对抗接力泳：两队绕圈游泳，在对方阻拦下，争取让特殊接力棒绕行最多圈；还有水下标枪，比试谁能在水下把标枪投得最远。

沼栖族语，包括人名，发音较柔和。姓氏表明家族，婚后新家庭与哪方原生家庭同住，就使用哪一家的姓。移居外星的沼栖族正在发展新命名传统，有时会自创姓氏。如果不是主动离家，而是遭家族驱逐，便不得继续使用家族姓氏。因此，只用单名的沼栖族往往有段悲伤的故事。

范例名字 Mirassa、Arso、Ninosa

范例姓氏 Garalish、Dakashati、Assimsa

信仰

耐心是沼栖社会最重要的美德之一，对家族的忠诚亦然。他们传统上敬拜伟大海洋之灵阿斯帕拉什，但这位精魂已有数百年未现身，年轻人常改信其他神祇，包括海拉丝、亚莱纱与宗-莎琳。长者通常仍坚信阿斯帕拉什，相信耐心终有回报。

他们普遍认为桑迪特水晶神圣，是阿斯帕拉什或其他神祇的礼物，敬重其能跨遥远距离建立社群的能力。

常见典范

三思而后行，维持传统

常见禁忌

背叛家族，鲁莽涉险，虐待动物

pages.name: 坚叶族
pages.expectedContent:
Accustomed to a dangerous home world of sandstorms and swarms of microscopic predators, hardors have developed strong constitutions, thick skins, and natural defenses sufficient to meet most threats.

Hardors are the mouthless, plant-like residents of Dorjo, a barren world covered in crystal deserts dotted with deep salt seas. In joining the Szandite Collective, these stout engineers transitioned from a nomadic life, constantly moving from water source to water source across the planet's surface, to a society based in huge cities interconnected by massive water pipelines and mobile desalination units. Owing to their isolated planet, natural defenses, and generally cooperative society, they have never had to develop military technology beyond protective armor. If you want to play a dedicated, silent problem solver with a (literally) thick skin, you should play a hardor.

You Might...

  • Feel uncomfortable staying in one place for extended periods.

  • Seek the freedom of bright, open spaces.

  • Juggle a dozen projects at the same time.

Others Probably...

  • Struggle to understand your silent communication.

  • Trust you to fix almost anything, living or mechanical.

  • Consider you a great listener.

Physical Description

Hardors are bipedal plant creatures whose bodies are primarily made of gold-tinted, thick, liquid-retentive leaves that end in spiked ridges or long, sharp spines. They typically resemble dwarves in size and stature, standing under 5 feet tall on average with thick, stocky frames that weigh upwards of 200 pounds. Each hardor has a dense, woody core hidden within their torso, surrounded by an arrangement of leaves growing out from several stems that form their head, arms, and body. Whenever possible, hardors wear skirts or short pants, and eschew footwear, leaving their tough, root-like legs and feet exposed to the air. This enables them to more readily absorb ambient moisture and allows them to both send and receive chemical communication more easily.

Their dense skin provides protection from the heat, blowing sands, and the swarming, microscopic omnivores of Dorjo, and their ability to retain copious water stores within their bodies are perfectly adapted for life on a drought-ridden planet. Their head, which typically includes a single large, spined leaf hanging down over their neck and upper chest, hold their eyes and ears, but hardors do not have mouths, and their brains reside within their cores, safe inside their chests. They do not naturally use a spoken language, relying instead on a combination of telepathic communication and a complex language of chemical signals that other ancestries often find difficult to interpret.

Society

The hardor home world, Dorjo, is largely covered by vast, windswept crystal deserts. To support a growing population, hardors depend upon several extremely deep, high-salinity seas that dot their planet's surface. The enterprising people have constructed massive pipelines that run across Dorjo's surface, pumping water from these seas into the huge hardor cities on a rigid schedule. Managing the natural water supply is such a challenging logistical problem that hardors have turned to their fellow Szandite Collective planets to develop greater and greater technological solutions. Hardor desalination rigs, marvels of engineering in their own right, run back and forth along the pipelines like automated trains, extracting thousands of tons of salt from millions of gallons of water on a weekly basis.

Young hardors reach physical maturity after only four years of childhood and quickly find niches for work within their widely industrialized society. The population is concentrated in their dense cities and around space ports, providing a wide variety of opportunities for careers and specialties. Interplanetary commerce evolves around exporting mineral salts harvested by their desalination rigs in huge quantities. In addition, there is a growing demand for hardor engineers and medics in Near Space, leading more and more of these industrious people to find positions off-world, in colonies, on space stations, or as part of starship crews.

Sample Names: Hardor names are designed to be shared telepathically, or by chemical signals, and are difficult to translate into written language or audible words. When conversing with outsiders, hardors often take on descriptive nicknames to simplify communication. Hardor nicknames include Biggergreen, Hookbarb, Jumpoff, Noscars, Pinkroots, Quilleyes, Sandshorts, Scraper, Toolbox, Widewalker.

Beliefs

Hardor belief systems are widely varied, but Lambatuin remains one of the most popular deities among their numbers. Millennia of nomadic life on Dorjo have forged a strong antistagnation sentiment into these people, and the great strides their society has made thanks to the fellow members of the Collective are deeply appreciated at a cultural level. Groups of hardors work to constantly innovate, and to share the greatest and most advantageous of those innovations with the rest of the Collective, or whatever larger entity they join.

Popular Edicts

remain unmoored like roots in sand, use and innovate technology to help others

Popular Anathema

let machines fall into disrepair, exhaust a natural water supply

Hardor Mechanics

Hit Points 10

Size Medium

Speed 20 feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Wisdom, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

Languages Common, Dorjosh, Szandite

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • hardor

  • plant

Senses low-light vision

Limited Telepathy

pages.content:
坚叶族习惯了母星危险的沙尘暴与微型掠食者群，因此演化出强健体质、厚实皮肤，以及足以应对多数威胁的天生防御。

坚叶族是多尔乔没有嘴、形似植物的居民。这个贫瘠世界遍布水晶沙漠，点缀深邃盐海。加入桑迪特联合体后，这些敦实的工程师不再于地表水源间不断游牧，而是发展出以巨型城市为基础的社会，由庞大输水管与移动淡化装置彼此连接。母星隔绝、天生防御和普遍合作的社会，让他们从不需要发展防护装甲以外的军事科技。如果你希望扮演一个专注沉默、皮确实很厚的问题解决者，就应该选择坚叶族。

你可能……

  • 长时间停在一处会感到不适。

  • 追寻明亮开阔空间中的自由。

  • 同时应付十二个项目。

他人可能……

  • 难以理解你的无声交流。

  • 相信你能修好几乎任何东西，无论活物还是机械。

  • 认为你是很好的倾听者。

外貌描述

坚叶族是双足植物生物，身体主要由带金色色泽、厚实保水的叶片构成，末端呈带刺脊线或修长利刺。体形通常类似矮人，平均不足5尺高，敦实粗壮，体重逾200磅。躯干内藏有致密木质核心，周围是由数根茎长出的叶片，形成头、臂与身体。只要可能，他们就穿裙或短裤，不穿鞋，让坚韧、似根的腿脚露在空气里，以便吸取周围水分，更轻易收发化学讯息。

致密皮肤防护高热、飞沙，以及多尔乔成群的微型杂食生物；体内大量储水的能力，完美适应干旱行星。头部通常有一片带刺大叶垂在颈部和上胸前，眼与耳位于头上。他们没有嘴，大脑却在核心中，安全藏于胸内。坚叶族天生不用口语，而以心灵感应和复杂的化学信号语言沟通，其他族裔常难以解读。

社会

母星多尔乔大多被风吹拂的广阔水晶沙漠覆盖。为养活日益增长的人口，坚叶族依赖地表散布的数个极深、高盐度的海洋。他们富于进取，建起横跨地表的庞大管道，严格按表将海水泵入巨城。管理天然供水是巨大的后勤挑战，因此他们向桑迪特联合体的伙伴行星求助，发展越来越先进的技术方案。坚叶族淡化设备本身就是工程奇迹，如自动列车般沿管道往返，每周从数百万加仑的水中提取数千吨盐。

坚叶族童年只有四年，身体便已成熟，很快在高度工业化的社会中找到工作定位。人口集中于密集城市与太空港附近，职业和专长机会丰富。行星际贸易以大量出口淡化设备提取的矿物盐为主。此外，近宇对坚叶族工程师和医护人员的需求日增，越来越多勤劳族人前往外星，在殖民地、空间站任职，或加入星舰船员。

范例名字：坚叶族名字本用于心灵感应或化学信号，难以转成文字或可听见的词语。与外族交流时，他们常取描述性绰号，简化沟通。例如大绿（Biggergreen）、钩刺（Hookbarb）、跳下（Jumpoff）、无疤（Noscars）、粉根（Pinkroots）、棘眼（Quilleyes）、沙裤（Sandshorts）、刮刀（Scraper）、工具箱（Toolbox）、阔步（Widewalker）。

信仰

坚叶族信仰多种多样，兰巴图因仍是其中最受欢迎的神祇之一。多尔乔数千年的游牧生活，使他们强烈反对停滞，文化上也十分感激联合体伙伴让社会获得的巨大进步。坚叶族团体不断创新，将最伟大、最有益的成果，分享给联合体其余成员，或自己加入的任何更大实体。

常见典范

如沙中根系般不受拘束，运用并创新科技以帮助他人

常见禁忌

让机器失修，耗尽天然水源

pages.name: 四臂蜗族
pages.expectedContent:
Knowing the exact dates of their deaths from the day they’re born has given these psychic, mollusk-like aberrations a nearuniversal urgency to their actions.

The diminutive and stoic residents of Xofirth, the only habitable planet in the Oukrux Major System, live for exactly 101 years—assuming their lives aren't cut short by any of the numerous predators that share their world. Though scholars have dedicated their lives to solving the mystery of their set lifespans, the answer has thus far eluded them all. Some theorize that mecenaics were genetically or magically engineered by some ancient, now-extinct ancestor, possibly as a food source, a theory supported by the enthusiasm of many of Xofirth's predators for mecenaic meat.

Mecenaics have developed a highly regimented life schedule, managing their training, work, and even recreation time carefully to use their century with maximum efficiency. If you want to play a serious intellectual with an eye for efficiency and self-preservation, you should play a mecenaic.

You Might...

  • Devise complex strategies to hide from predators or other threats.

  • Operate under a rigid schedule.

  • Complain about wasting precious time.

Others Probably...

  • Speculate about your rigid lifespan.

  • Consider you a bit cowardly.

  • Wonder at your flexible, malleable physique.

Physical Description

Mecenaics are tiny, mollusk-like aberrations that use a single muscular foot for locomotion, standing between one and two feet tall on average and weighing between 25 and 40 pounds. Their bodies are wrapped in two flexible, mineralized dome-like shells, with their four arms, along with a single leg, two eyestalks, and one mouthstalk emerging from the soft gap between the two plates. Most of their bodies are formed from a single, flexible muscle that allows them to wield great physical strength despite their small stature. Mecenaics tend to tattoo their shell domes with personally identifiable information, including their names, birth dates, and projected death dates, in order to make themselves easier to identify and protect their natural defenses in the event their shells are separated from their owner.

Mecenaic brains reside near the tops of their torsos, well within the protective confines of their shells. Other than this fairly fixed position, as well as the location of their foot, their anatomies are quite fluid. Individual mecenaics have been known to rearrange their arms, eyes, and mouths often, sometimes multiple times within a single day, to better meet the practical challenges they face. When sleeping, they generally pull the entirety of their bodies within their shells. It's not that they don't trust their surroundings or companions, it's just that they'd rather not be eaten.

Society

he life of a mecenaic is divided into four distinct phases. Their first 25 years are called the formative phase, during which they develop physically but also work to expand their psychic mastery, determine what (if any) scholarly pursuits interest them, and develop other specialized skills. Formative mecenaics often pursue several apprenticeships over this early part of their lives while their material needs are handled by the greater society, in order to determine the best use of their talents.

For their second quarter-century, mecenaics are expected to pursue a career or specialization of sorts. The bulk of the Xofirthian workforce is made up of these young adult mecenaics, as is their military. Upon their 50th birthday, each mecenaic either enters governmental service, becomes a mentor to formative mecenaics, or leaves Xofirth as a sort of diplomat, student, or missionary in search of people they can help or skills they can bring back to their home world. These fully adult mecenaics manage the rigid structure of their society and work tirelessly to develop contingencies to protect against the many enormous, roving predators that dominate Xofirth.

Most importantly, the longest portion of a mecenaic's life, the final 26 years, is reserved for leisure. The leisure stage of a mecenaic's century begins with a retirement party; these events tend to be the largest, most festive social events in Xofirthian society. The retired mecenaic is, finally, free of all requirements and structures of society, and from then on, they can use their remaining time in any way they deem fit. Mecenaics tend to return to their places of birth in anticipation of their 101st birthdays so that they can spend their final days in quiet companionship with close family and friends.

Sample Names: Mecenaic names expand over the course of their lives to reflect their age and life stage, gaining a new syllable with each of life's transitions. Typical mecenaic names include Chifix, Hansha, Juchuul, Lixechu, Othax, Roxicho, Shurlirt, Thoarshix, Tsolo, Xiliojotarish

Beliefs

Belief in the all-controlling power of time, and study of the way their mortality is so rigidly affected by it, dominates the spiritual lives of mecenaics. Being a largely intellectual people, these studies have taken them in many different directions and led their spiritual types to answers in many different churches. Pharasma, Talavet, and Yaraesa are among the most popular deities in mecenaic society, but religious worship is one of the few aspects of life on Xofirth that isn't rigidly managed by any governing body.

Szandite crystals are utilized heavily as stores of ancestral knowledge. Retired mecenaics often spend long hours recording their memories and expertise into the crystals, embellishing them with stories of their life and words of wisdom to share with the rest of their people. While not strictly a religious activity, making or listening to these recordings is a practice treated with great reverence.

Popular Edicts

protect your life, take your time

Popular Anathema

run thoughtlessly into danger, spend your years waiting

Mecenaic Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Tiny

Speed 20 feet

Attribute Boosts Strength, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Dexterity

Languages Common, Szandite, Xofirthian

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • mecenaic

pages.content:
这些具有心灵能力、形似软体动物的异怪，从出生之日起便知道确切死期，因此几乎个个行事都带有紧迫感。

索菲斯是大欧克鲁克斯星系唯一宜居行星，其居民身材矮小、坚忍克己，寿命恰好101年，前提是未被同在这颗行星上的众多掠食者提前夺命。虽有学者终生研究固定寿命之谜，至今却无人解答。有人推测，四臂蜗族是某种已灭绝的古老祖先以基因或魔法工程创造，甚至可能原是食物来源；索菲斯许多掠食者对四臂蜗族血肉的热衷，也支持了这种理论。

四臂蜗族制定高度规律的生活日程，仔细安排训练、工作甚至娱乐，以最高效率运用一世纪时光。如果你希望扮演一个严肃、重效率和自保的知识分子，就应该选择四臂蜗族。

你可能……

  • 设计复杂策略，躲避掠食者或其他威胁。

  • 按严格日程行动。

  • 抱怨宝贵时间被浪费。

他人可能……

  • 猜测你固定寿命的缘由。

  • 觉得你有些胆小。

  • 惊叹你灵活可塑的体格。

外貌描述

四臂蜗族是超小型、形似软体动物的异怪，以一只肌肉发达的足移动，平均高1至2尺，重25至40磅。身体被两片柔韧、矿化的穹顶状壳包裹，四臂、一腿、两根眼柄与一根口柄，从两片壳间的柔软缝隙伸出。身体大部由一块柔韧肌肉形成，即使个头小也能发挥强大力量。他们常在壳顶纹上姓名、出生日期和预计死期等个人资料，以便识别自己，也能在壳与主人分离时保护这份天生防御。

四臂蜗族的大脑位于躯干顶部附近，安稳处于外壳保护内。除了大脑和足部位置相对固定，其他身体构造颇为灵活。他们常重排手臂、眼和嘴的位置，有时一天多次，以应对实际挑战。睡觉时，他们通常全身缩进壳内，并非不信周围环境或同伴，只是不想被吃掉。

社会

四臂蜗族一生分为四个不同阶段。最初25年称为成长期，身体发育之余，也增强心灵掌控，探寻是否有感兴趣的学术方向，并发展其他专门技能。成长期常尝试数种学徒工作，以找出最适合发挥才能的方向，物质需求则由整个社会照顾。

第二个25年，四臂蜗族应从事某项职业或专长。索菲斯大多数劳动力与军人，都由这些年轻成人组成。50岁生日时，每位族人要么进入政府工作，要么成为成长期同族的导师，要么以外交官、学生或传教士身份离开索菲斯，寻找可帮助的人，或能带回母星的技能。这些完全成年的四臂蜗族管理严密的社会结构，不懈制定应急方案，抵御主宰索菲斯、四处游荡的众多巨型掠食者。

最重要的是，人生最长的阶段，即最后26年，留作退休期。这一世纪人生的休闲阶段，以退休派对开始，往往是索菲斯规模最大、最欢庆的社交活动。退休者终于摆脱社会的一切要求与制度，可以随意使用剩余时光。他们通常在101岁生日将至时返乡，与亲密家人和朋友安静相伴，度过最后时日。

范例名字：四臂蜗族的名字会随人生扩展，反映年龄和生命阶段，每次阶段转变便多一个音节。典型名字包括Chifix、Hansha、Juchuul、Lixechu、Othax、Roxicho、Shurlirt、Thoarshix、Tsolo、Xiliojotarish。

信仰

四臂蜗族的精神生活，主要围绕对时间掌控一切之力的信念，以及自身寿命为何如此严格受其影响的研究。这个族群大多重视思考，因此研究导向各异，有灵性追求的人便在不同教会找到答案。法莱斯玛、塔拉维特和亚莱纱，是社会中最受欢迎的神祇之一；宗教崇拜却是索菲斯少数不由任何治理机构严密管理的生活方面。

桑迪特水晶大量用于储存祖先知识。退休四臂蜗族常花很久将记忆与专长存入水晶，再点缀人生故事和智慧之言，与其他族人分享。虽然并非严格的宗教活动，制作或聆听这类记录仍受到极大尊崇。

常见典范

保护生命，从容行事

常见禁忌

不经思索便冲向危险，将岁月浪费于等待

pages.name: 奥德
pages.expectedContent:
The subterranean residents of the meteorscarred planet of Lazel have developed a rich, musical culture while living in massive, interconnected cave complexes.

Driven underground early in their existence by a thin atmosphere and dangerous stellar activity, ords evolved along hundreds of underground rivers in total darkness without any need for eyes. Their hyper-precise hearing, unique anatomy, and the echoing, resonant nature of their home world's acoustics have led them to create some of the most haunting musical compositions in all of Near Space. The advent of space travel has dramatically changed life for these people, who spent so much of their history able to travel only the directions the tunnels would allow.

If you want to play an artist who can find light in a world of unbroken darkness, you should play an ord.

You Might...

  • Move slowly and deliberately.

  • Surprise your companions with beautiful, resonant songs.

  • Wonder at the freedom of wide-open spaces.

Others Probably...

  • Try to protect you from physical obstacles in your path.

  • Fear your intimidating stature.

  • Ask you to eavesdrop on whispered conversations.

Physical Description

Ords are tall, bipedal humanoids with relatively small heads and torsos, extremely long limbs, and short, thick tails. Used to a lightless, underground existence, ords evolved without eyes and instead navigate the world around them using a network of eight earlike canals arranged in circles in raised, cartilaginous protrusions that sit atop their shoulders. Air and vibrations pass through these ultrasensitive tubes, giving ords a precise understanding of their surroundings and the movements of creatures around them. Standing upright, ords average 13 to 15 feet tall, but they normally walk with their legs bent at dramatic angles, leaving them closer to 7 feet tall for practical purposes. They tend to walk hunched forward with their heads held below their shoulders, occasionally relying on their long arms to maintain balance and ward off obstacles; their thick, muscular tails trail behind them for balance.

Ord skin is covered in fine, scalelike flakes that are shed and replaced every few months. Those who have had only limited exposure to sunlight tend to be extremely pale in color, their scales varying from pale yellows to grays and blues, often with subtly variegated patterns. Ords who journey outside the tunnels of their native Lazel find their scales grow more vibrant, and the contrast of their natural variegation increases dramatically. The anatomy of ord mouths is rather unique—these oversized orifices contain multiple opposable joints on the top and bottom, allowing ords to form multiple openings of different shapes and sizes. This strange quirk of anatomy is instrumental in ord singing, as a single ord can sound as if they have two or more voices at once.

Society

Ord society is made of a loose network of small towns clustered around underground water sources and naturally occurring patches of edible fungus. Though they've long since developed industrialized agriculture, their hyperlocal, ancient towns have persisted. Given the limited space within the tunnels, vehicles are rare beneath Lazel's surface. Young ords often set off on walk tours through the tunnels, leaving their homes and meandering their way through the mazelike underground, often along waterways that have eroded their own tunnels, until they find a new place to call home. Ords have constructed large, shielded space ports in several places where their tunnels meet the planet's dangerous surface. Few visitors ever come to the strange, dark world—it's not exactly inviting to outsiders—but more and more ord youths find their wanderings leading them out into the stars, where a frighteningly nonlinear existence awaits them.

Because of the difficulty of travel from point to point within the tunnels, ord society has come to rely on the instantaneous communication the szandite crystals afford them. Thanks to the crystal network, news, innovations, and artistic creations have proliferated across the world much faster than ords themselves since long before Lazel had an infosphere. Even now, many ords prefer to communicate with the crystals rather than using datapads or other computers.

Sample Names: Ords have at least two surnames, one from each parent, and one given name. Other ancestries sometimes say ord given names sound like howling. Ord names include Arlafi, Fahlahn, Hoosh, Jothu, Owacha, Puuchen, Uthush, Vowolo, Wheesha, Zenole

Beliefs

Ord society widely embraces the interconnection of music and darkness, making Zon-Shelyn one of the most popular deities among them. Others, especially those who have embraced life on the surface, have adopted Meyel's love of music for similar reasons. In more recent years, as the galaxy has opened to them, many ords have become enamored with the freedom of space travel and turned to Weydan and the Endless Horizon.

Popular Edicts

find the harmonies that underpin the universe, the darkness is nothing to fear

Popular Anathema

destroy a passage, hide behind silence

Ord Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Large

Speed 25 feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Intelligence

Languages Common, Lazelan, Szandite

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

拉泽尔星遍布陨石创痕，地下居民住在庞大且彼此相连的洞穴群中，发展出丰富的音乐文化。

在族群早期，稀薄大气和危险恒星活动便迫使奥德转入地下。他们沿数百条地下河，在全黑环境中演化，无需眼睛。超精确的听觉、独特的身体结构，以及母星声学环境的回声与共鸣，使他们创作的音乐跻身近宇最萦绕人心的作品之列。历史上，他们大多只能沿隧道容许的方向行走，太空旅行的出现因此大幅改变了他们的生活。

如果你希望扮演一位在无尽黑暗中找到光的艺术家，就应该选择奥德。

你可能……

  • 行动缓慢而审慎。

  • 以优美共鸣的歌曲令同伴惊喜。

  • 惊叹开阔空间的自由。

他人可能……

  • 试图保护你免受沿路实体障碍影响。

  • 畏惧你威严的身形。

  • 请你窃听低声交谈。

外貌描述

奥德是高大双足类人生物，头与躯干相对小，四肢极长，尾巴短粗。适应无光地下生活的他们并未演化出眼睛，而以八条耳状管道组成的网络感知世界。这些管道在肩部隆起的软骨突起上呈环形排列，极其敏锐，空气与振动流经其中，让奥德精确掌握周围环境与生物活动。直立时，他们平均高13至15尺，但通常大幅弯腿行走，实际高度更接近7尺。他们常弓身前倾，头低于肩，偶尔用长臂维持平衡、挡开障碍；粗壮肌肉尾巴拖在后方，辅助平衡。

奥德皮肤覆盖细小鳞状薄片，每几个月脱换一次。少见阳光者颜色极淡，鳞片从淡黄到灰、蓝，常有隐约杂色纹路。走出母星拉泽尔星隧道后，鳞片便更鲜艳，天然杂色的对比也显著增强。奥德口部构造独特，硕大口腔上下有多个可相对活动的关节，能形成不同形状、大小的多个开口。这项特征对歌唱至关重要，让单个奥德听起来仿佛同时有两种或更多声音。

社会

奥德社会是围绕地下水源与天然可食真菌群落形成的松散小镇网络。虽早已发展工业化农业，这些高度本地化的古镇仍延续至今。隧道空间有限，拉泽尔星地下少有载具。年轻奥德常离乡徒步游历隧道，沿自行冲蚀出通道的水路，在迷宫般地下漫游，直到找到新家。他们在数处隧道通往危险地表的地方，建起大型防护太空港。很少有访客来这奇异黑暗的世界，它并不怎么吸引外人；但越来越多年轻奥德漫游至群星，那里等着令人畏惧的非线性生活。

隧道中两地往来困难，奥德社会因此依赖桑迪特水晶的即时通信。早在拉泽尔星有信息圈之前，水晶网络便让新闻、创新与艺术作品传播得远快于奥德自己。即使如今，许多人仍偏好水晶，不用数据板或其他计算机交流。

范例名字：奥德有至少两个姓，分别来自双亲，还有一个名。其他族裔有时说，奥德的名听起来像嚎叫。例子包括Arlafi、Fahlahn、Hoosh、Jothu、Owacha、Puuchen、Uthush、Vowolo、Wheesha、Zenole。

信仰

奥德社会普遍拥抱音乐与黑暗的关联，因此宗-莎琳成为最受欢迎的神祇之一。其他人，尤其已接受地表生活者，出于类似原因，认同梅耶尔对音乐的热爱。近年银河向他们敞开，许多人迷恋太空旅行的自由，转而追随韦丹和无垠境界线。

常见典范

寻找支撑宇宙的和声，黑暗不值得恐惧

常见禁忌

摧毁通道，躲在沉默背后

pages.name: 双相人
pages.expectedContent:
Alternating between years-long phases of sleep and wakefulness, phasorqs must rely on their boundless energy and their two heads' intellectual curiosity to stay up to date with current events, scientific breakthroughs, and popular culture.

The two-headed sleeping scholars of Kuxor, as phasorqs are often known, have unique circadian rhythms that are inexorably tied to the slow rotation of their home world: they remain awake for exactly half of Kuxor's standard day, about 11 Pact World years, and fall into a deep hibernation for the next 11. Experiments are underway to determine an underlying cause for their strict sleeping schedules and to find any external means of influencing the cycle, which follows even phasorqs who are born far from their home world, but answers have proved elusive.

These boisterous, excitable people tend to punctuate their long study sessions with even longer festivals and parties, and they sometimes combine intellectual pursuits and celebrations into loud, educational, incomprehensible events.

If you want to play two dueling intellectuals who study hard and party even harder, you should play a phasorq.

You Might...

  • Worry about everything you miss when you're asleep.

  • Stay up all night reading. And talking to yourself.

  • Have two distinct, incompatible sets of interests.

Others Probably...

  • Treat your heads as two different people.

  • Avoid mentioning events that happened while you were asleep.

  • Struggle to keep up with your thought process.

Physical Description

Phasorqs are strange humanoids whose most prominent features are their two narrow, elongated heads. Each head is a conscious, independent being with their own name, thoughts, and skills. One member of this pair tends to assert primary control of their body, while the other can assert their control only on occasion.

Their bodies are generally thin, lightweight, somewhat frail, and roughly triangular in shape, with broad shoulders tapering down to long, thin legs, all standing upon oversized feet. Averaging just over 6 feet tall, phasorq weights vary dramatically depending on their stage in the sleeping/waking cycle. Phasorqs often gain weight as they near the end of their waking cycles in anticipation of more than a decade of dormancy.

Waking phasorqs often dress and decorate themselves garishly, in internally conflicting styles, as their two separate minds have different tastes in colors, clothing, and accessories. Some manage to negotiate schedules among themselves, resulting in a more subdued aesthetic that changes dramatically from day to day. Phasorqs generally ignore popular fashion trends or try to set trends of their own, rather than trying to keep up with stylistic changes that develop while they sleep. Still, they seldom speak ill of their sleeping cousins, whom they'll never properly meet and thus have to trust to watch over half of their lives.

Society

Every 11 standard Pact World years—a single day and night on the planet Kuxor—half of the phasorq population goes to sleep, while the other half awakens, having slept for 11 years. This cycle has created unique logistical challenges for phasorqs—how to keep a planet running until the waking half of the population can assess the situations and challenges facing them and resume management. For a people who are, fundamentally, more interested in study and recreation than practicalities, the solution has become an elaborate interplay between automation and the remarkable data- and communication-storage capacity of szandite crystals.

With most day-to-day tasks managed automatically, phasorqs have become a distinctly academic people, establishing numerous universities and other schools across the surface of Kuxor and taking up prominent positions at institutes of higher learning across Near Space. Visiting phasorq experts carefully time their projects and classes to allow themselves to retreat to a safe, stable place when it's finally time to sleep. Despite their studious habits, phasorqs tend to be an extremely festive, boisterous people, especially in the months immediately following the awakening. Phasorq college parties have become notorious throughout Near Space, both for their volume, and the fact that they seem to go on far longer than is advisable.

Sample Names: Phasorqs have a given name for each of their heads and are typically referred to as a matched pair. Which name comes first in the pair is often a source of consternation. Phasorq names include Brorer and Phinch, Glauro and Bastin, Matton and Quashi, Plirck and Camilian, and Zoufee and Hrash.

Beliefs

Kuxor has very little in the way of large, organized religious communities—studies of the divine tend to be contained within colleges, where a wide variety of deities, edicts, and anathemas are debated and dissected endlessly. Many phasorqs are privately religious, however, or have established small centers of worship; Ibra, Eloritu, and Lambatuin are particularly popular amongst these sects. A nontrivial faction of phasorqs have shunned the perceived seriousness of intellectual pursuits, however, and adopted Besmara's freewheeling edicts as their own.

Popular Edicts

always take time to double check, sunset won't wait for you

Popular Anathema

be so quiet that others forget you, waste a chance to learn

pages.content:
双相人在长达数年的沉睡期与清醒期之间交替，必须依靠无穷的精力和两颗头脑的求知欲，跟上时事、科学突破与流行文化。

双相人常被称为库索尔的双头沉睡学者。他们有着独特的昼夜节律，与家园世界缓慢的自转密不可分：他们恰好在库索尔标准日的一半时间内保持清醒，约合11个协约世界年，随后深度冬眠11年。研究者正通过实验探究这种严格睡眠作息的根本原因，并寻找能从外部影响这一周期的手段。即便出生在远离家园世界的地方，双相人也遵循这一周期，但研究始终未能找到答案。

这些喧闹而容易兴奋的人，常以更为漫长的节庆和派对点缀长时间的学习。他们有时还会把求知与庆祝结合起来，举办喧闹、有教育意义却令人费解的活动。

如果你想扮演两个相互较劲的知识分子，刻苦学习而狂欢更甚，那么就选择双相人吧。

你可能……

  • 担心自己在沉睡时错过的一切。

  • 通宵阅读，还会自言自语。

  • 拥有两套截然不同、互不相容的兴趣。

他人可能……

  • 把你的两颗头当作两个不同的人。

  • 避免提及你沉睡期间发生的事情。

  • 难以跟上你的思路。

外貌描述

双相人是奇特的类人生物，最显著的特征是两颗狭长的头。每颗头都是有意识的独立个体，拥有自己的名字、思想和技能。其中一个通常主导身体的控制权，另一个则只能偶尔掌控身体。

他们的身体通常瘦削、轻盈而略显脆弱，大致呈三角形：宽阔的肩膀向下收窄，接着是细长的双腿，由一双硕大的脚支撑。双相人平均身高略超6尺，体重却会随睡眠与清醒周期的阶段大幅变化。临近清醒期结束时，他们往往会增重，为超过十年的休眠做准备。

清醒的双相人常把自己打扮得花哨醒目，风格却相互冲突，因为两个独立的心智对颜色、服装和配饰各有所好。有些双相人能协商出轮流安排，整体审美较为内敛，却每天都会大变样。双相人通常无视时尚潮流，或试图开创自己的风格，而不去追赶沉睡期间兴起的风尚。不过，他们很少说沉睡同胞的坏话：他们永远无法真正结识彼此，只能信任这些同胞，让对方照管自己一半的人生。

社会

每隔11个标准协约世界年——即库索尔星上的一昼一夜——一半双相人入睡，另一半则在沉睡11年后醒来。这个循环带来了独特的后勤难题：如何让整颗星球维持运转，直到醒来的那半数人口能评估面临的情况与挑战，重新接手管理？这个族群从根本上更关心学习与娱乐，而非实际事务，因此他们的解决方案是让自动化系统与桑迪特水晶非凡的数据及通信存储能力精密配合。

由于多数日常事务都由自动化系统处理，双相人成了学术气息浓厚的族群。他们在库索尔各地建立了大量大学和其他学校，也在近宇各地的高等学府担任要职。出访的双相人专家会仔细安排项目与授课时间，确保必须睡眠时能退往安全、稳定的地方。尽管勤于学习，双相人也极其热衷庆祝，喜爱喧闹，尤其是在刚醒来的几个月里。他们的大学派对在近宇臭名昭著，既因为声音响亮，也因为派对似乎总会持续到远超合理限度的时候。

范例名字：双相人的每颗头都有一个名，通常成对称呼。哪一个名字排在前面，往往会引发争执。双相人的名字包括Brorer和Phinch、Glauro和Bastin、Matton和Quashi、Plirck和Camilian，以及Zoufee和Hrash。

信仰

库索尔很少有大型、有组织的宗教团体。神学研究通常局限于学院内，学者们对众多神祇、典范和禁忌展开无休止的辩论与剖析。不过，许多双相人私下笃信宗教，或设立小型崇拜中心；伊布拉、伊洛里图和兰巴图因在这些教派中特别受欢迎。也有为数不少的双相人摒弃了他们眼中求知活动的严肃性，转而奉行贝斯玛拉自由奔放的典范。

常见典范

总要花时间复核，日落不会等你

常见禁忌

安静到让别人忘记你，浪费学习的机会

双相人规则

生命值 6

体型 中型

速度 25尺

属性提升 智力、感知、自选

属性缺陷 体质

语言 通用语、库索尔语、桑迪特语

额外语言 数量等于智力调整值（若为正值）。从常见语言列表及你拥有许可的其他语言中选择，例如母星通行的语言。

pages.name: 鼠人
pages.expectedContent:
Ysoki populations thrived on Akiton, lost Golarion, and several other worlds for millennia before spaceflight accelerated cultural exchange in the Pact System. The question of whether these ethnicities share common ancestors or were examples of convergent evolution isn't important to most ysoki. Often gregarious, ysoki embrace far-flung “cousins” regardless of differences in appearance and heredity.

Most ysoki love technology and travel, even gravitating toward professions that others find unpleasant. Ysoki often work as junkers, long-haul starship crew members, or mechanics squeezing through cramped station corridors, so sure of their own worth that living and working in subpar conditions is often a source of pride rather than shame.

If you want a character who's adventurous, confident, and curious, you should play a ysoki.

You Might...

  • Keep in touch with a large extended family scattered throughout the stars, with a cousin to visit in every port.
  • Collect and tinker with gadgets encountered in your travels, even your own cybernetic augmentations.
  • Adopt your coworkers and friends into your family.

Others Probably...

  • Assume you're disorganized and messy until they learn your habits.
  • Value your skills with technology but wish you reassembled things as often as you took them apart.
  • Depend on you to stick up for others and always get the job done.

Physical Description

Ysoki have whiskered snouts, large ears, and hairless tails, with red or black eyes and fur colors typically in shades of black, brown, gray, and white. Ysoki appearances vary considerably, even within a family unit. Many ysoki have prehensile tails that help balance and maneuvering in zero gravity as well as keen noses that can identify complex chemicals by smell.

Ysoki instinctually maintain cleanliness through personal grooming and reinforce these habits throughout their strong social structures. Many ysoki use cosmetics to spice up their looks and favor cybernetic augmentations, often installed at a cousin's bustling street clinic. Ysoki enjoy expressing their personality through fashion, layering clothing items and accessories into a jumbled fusion. Regardless of attire or profession, ysoki value preparedness and ingenuity, rarely leaving home without a few useful tools and supplies stuffed into a backpack, purse, tool belt, or cheek pouch.

Society

Ysoki culture values life over credits, framing work as another communal activity to enjoy. Ysoki communities are tight-knit and welcoming, always eager to share a meal or swap spare parts with strangers who don't look down on them. Many ysoki adults enjoy distance correspondences with dozens of friends and relatives, reuniting for rowdy celebrations whenever circumstance brings them back together. Others never leave their homes, serving as pillars of their community and curating collections of junk and stories for generations of grandchildren.

Nicknames are often as important to ysoki as their given names, and they enjoy giving their friends and family monikers based on their appearance or personality, such as “Snack,” “Dot,” “Sparks,” or “Boom-Boom.” Many ysoki family names incorporate their ships or home settlements.

Sample Names

Bena, Coponisa, Cors, Datch, Fitch, Goba, Kib, Lolo, Niknak, Quig, Resk, Sim, Twik

Beliefs

Ysoki care more about their family than abstract moral concepts, and most ysoki follow their community's strict social codes even if they break civil laws. Community is important to all ysoki, and they're likely to respect other cultures' social expectations even when they don't agree.

Popular Edicts

maintain good personal hygiene, put your community's needs above your own, stay in touch with friends, take care of your family

Popular Anathema

throw away something that might be useful later

Ysoki Mechanics

Hit Points 6

Size Small

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Strength

Languages Akitonian, Common, Ysoki

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • humanoid
  • ysoki

Senses Low-Light Vision

Sharp Teeth

pages.content:
早在太空飞行技术加速协约星系的文化交流之前，鼠人就已在阿基顿、失落的格拉利昂和其他几个世界兴盛了数千年。对大多数鼠人而言，这些族群是拥有共同祖先，还是趋同进化的结果，并不重要。鼠人通常合群，无论外貌与遗传上存在怎样的差异，都会欣然接纳远方的“表亲”。

大多数鼠人热爱科技与旅行，甚至愿意从事他人认为不愉快的职业。他们经常担任废品回收者、长途星舰船员，或挤过狭窄空间站走廊的机械师。鼠人对自身价值充满信心，在欠佳的条件下生活和工作，往往令他们自豪，而非感到羞耻。

如果你想扮演富有冒险精神、自信且好奇的角色，就选择鼠人。

你可能……

  • 与散布群星间的庞大亲族保持联系，在每个港口都有可以拜访的表亲。
  • 收集并摆弄旅途中遇到的小装置，甚至包括自己的电控机械殖装。
  • 将同事和朋友接纳为家人。

他人可能……

  • 在了解你的习惯之前，认为你杂乱无章、不爱整洁。
  • 珍视你的科技才能，却希望你把东西装回去的次数能和拆开它们一样多。
  • 依靠你为他人挺身而出，并总能完成工作。

外貌描述

鼠人拥有带胡须的吻部、大耳朵和无毛的尾巴，眼睛呈红色或黑色，毛色通常是深浅不同的黑、棕、灰或白。即使同一家族内部，个体外貌也可能差异很大。许多鼠人拥有能够抓握的尾巴，帮助他们在零重力中保持平衡并机动；他们还有灵敏的鼻子，可以通过气味辨识复杂的化学物质。

鼠人本能地通过梳理身体保持清洁，并在稳固的社会结构中进一步强化这些习惯。许多鼠人用化妆品增添风采，喜爱电控机械殖装，常在某位表亲生意兴隆的街头诊所安装。鼠人喜欢通过时尚表达个性，将衣物与配饰层叠混搭。不论穿着或职业如何，他们都重视充分准备与机智创造，几乎不会空手出门，总要在背包、手提包、工具腰带或颊囊中塞入几件实用工具与补给。

社会

鼠人文化认为生活比信用点更重要，将工作视为另一种可以享受的集体活动。鼠人社区关系紧密、热情好客，总是乐于与不轻视他们的陌生人分享饭食或交换备用零件。许多成年鼠人喜欢与数十名亲友保持远程通信，情况允许重聚时便举行喧闹的庆祝。另一些从未离开家园，成为社区的支柱，为一代又一代孙辈整理收藏废品与故事。

对鼠人而言，绰号常与名字同样重要。他们喜欢根据外貌或性格，为亲友取“点心”“小点”“火花”或“嘭嘭”之类的绰号。许多鼠人的姓氏包含所乘飞船或家乡聚居地的名字。

示例姓名

Bena, Coponisa, Cors, Datch, Fitch, Goba, Kib, Lolo, Niknak, Quig, Resk, Sim, Twik

信仰

鼠人比起抽象的道德观念，更关心自己的家庭。大多数鼠人遵守社区严格的社会准则，即使因此违反当地法律。社区对所有鼠人都很重要，他们很可能尊重其他文化的社会期望，哪怕自己并不认同。

常见典范

保持良好的个人卫生，将社区的需要置于自身之上，与朋友保持联系，照顾家人

常见禁忌

丢弃日后可能有用的东西

鼠人规则数据

体型 小型

速度 25尺

属性缺陷 力量

pages.name: 班特里德人
pages.expectedContent:
Bantrids are a curious and innovative species who awoke from stasis only a few years ago and emerged from the mysterious towers at the core of one of Liavara's moons with no memories of their past. Stranded in a time still reeling from the effects of the Gap, they were quick to accept their amnesiac state and looked to the future to roll out a civilization on par with those of their galactic peers in the Pact Worlds.

Bantrid mentality and culture are heavily shaped by the inability of most members of the species to stay still for long periods of time, often manifesting as a desire to move forward toward a brighter future. Whether and how this mindset manifests can vary from individual to individual. One bantrid might be a restless pop star who refuses to perform the same dance routine twice, another a shrewd bureaucrat whose plots incorporate a dozen pieces all moving in tandem. While this bottomless motivation to move forward is often characterized as optimism, just as often bantrids are the first to prepare for impending disaster. This mindset has lead to many bantrids becoming advisors, system administrators, and Starfinder explorers who enjoy indulging in their desire to constantly adapt to an ever-shifting environment of potential pitfalls and hazards.

While plenty of bantrids seek personal fame and fortune, their lack of memories and desire for social cohesion have led many others on a more community-minded path of curious gregariousness. That said, they tend to break off relationships at the first sign of trouble and have little patience for those who violate their sovereignty or insult their unique physiology. They are eager to learn new traditions from different cultures they encounter on their journeys, incorporating what they enjoy into their own personal lives as they seek to forge their own identities. This habit is often viewed with suspicion from outsiders, as one year a bantrid will claim the most important holiday of the year is on Hibb's solar eclipse, when Liavara passes in front of the Sun and blocks its light, only for the same bantrid to completely drop the celebration from their repertoire the next time they encounter an astronomical event that piques their interest. This is no mere flight of fancy, but rather a desire to see which celebrations resonate with their communities and friends and how they can be improved.

If you want to play a highly motivated go- getter who doesn't like staying still, physically or otherwise, you should play a bantrid.

You Might...

  • Develop some habitual routines or technology to keep yourself moving within a confined space.

  • Rush forward into interesting situations knowing you can always dump them and keep moving if they don't suit you.

  • Search for or develop new traditions and folklore to incorporate into your unique cultural identity amid a dearth of collective customs.

Others Probably...

  • Find your seemingly endless energy and desire to move around distracting, frustrating, or even exhausting.

  • Wonder if you have a short attention span that makes it challenging to complete large-scale projects.

  • Assume you easily break off bad relationships out of boredom rather than self-preservation.

Physical Description

Bantrids have an unusual anatomy compared to the other species that inhabit the Pact Worlds. They appear to be stout columns with two tiny eyes and a pair of appendages midway up their torsos that resemble large, flat hands with several thin fingers. Small mouths above their eyes and ears open to reveal compact, flat teeth they use to chew fibrous food and nuts. Their gray-blue skin often bears striped coloration along the length of their torsos, widening at the base to their most distinctive feature: a dense organic sphere that makes up roughly half their bodies. Bantrids move by spinning these spheres using hundreds of thousands of tiny cilia on the underside of partial sheaths.

Bantrids have no gender and reproduce asexually by budding their offspring off their bodies. Newborn bantrids have their growing foot orbs attached to their bodies with an umbilical-like structure for roughly 5 months before they detach and roll on their own, growing over time using organic material from their own bodies and the debris collected as they move. When foot orbs fail to properly develop, either due to injury or malnutrition, a bantrid can make do with a prosthetic that has to be refitted as they mature.

Many bantrids have taken to intentionally replacing or augmenting their foot orb both for practical reasons and as a method of self-expression. Others will even take the foot orb of a deceased bantrid in a solemn ritual combining bioengineering and necromancy that most bantrids find gruesome and unsettling, even when they are following the traditions and wishes of the deceased.

Society

Five years ago, offworld adventurers discovered that long before the Gap, bantrids rebelled against their brutal masters, the Sivv Dominion, and fled in an enormous colony ship that would become Hibb, one of Liavara's many moons. Awakening eons later in an unfamiliar time and galaxy, bantrids gradually began the arduous task of building both a new society and a new identity on the desolate moon.

Since awakening from stasis 10 years ago, bantrids have made significant progress despite the dearth of resources on the artificial moon. They managed to secure lucrative trade agreements with AbadarCorp contractors eager to reverse engineer the ancient pre-Gap technology from the mysterious vault towers that cropped up all around Hibb. At first, bantrids were eager to see offworld corps setting up shop on Hibb, but many became wary of trusting a profit-driven corporation that would have no interest in the moon once the towers' technology and history were completely documented. This conflict was largely resolved once the truth behind bantrids' origins became public and the interior of the ancient colony ship became the property of the Unending Cycle, a trust designed to oversee both the study and subsequent profits of Hibb's interior. This ensures that most of the proceeds will go toward improving Hibb's infrastructure and ensuring the bantrid home world remains relevant to the Pact Worlds' economy.

Bantrids live about as long as humans, but the similarities start and end there. Bantrids reproduce asexually by budding and raise their children in communal environments, resulting in most bantrids treating their parents as they would any other member of the community. This mindset rarely causes problems for offworld bantrids, as they are uncommon enough that most bantrids in the same settlement often live in the same home and treat one another the same way as one would treat a family member. That doesn't mean all bantrids get along, as the population growth across even a planetoid as small as Hibb naturally fosters philosophical and political differences that cause communities to form with other like-minded individuals who raise their children with similar values.

One such splinter faction still active on Hibb, the Unbroken Sphere, believes bantrids are a superior species who created the colony ship that would become Hibb—and who were also once the rulers of a multi-galactic empire that included in its territories the region of space now widely known as the Pact Worlds. While Spherites claim to be a peaceful organization who publicly believe that bantrids will simply express their superiority through their unparalleled accomplishments, they secretly believe that cleansing Hibb of offworlder influence is the first of many steps toward bantrids conquering the rest of the galaxy. They are in staunch opposition to the Unending Cycle and believe historical records about their cultural relationship to the Sivv Dominion were falsified, preferring theories with little basis in reality.

Bantrids tend to prefer short names with few syllables that one can call out quickly without having to stop whomever you are hailing. Most bantrids have only a single name, which is given to them when they are old enough to move on their own.

Sample Names

Buo, Hin, Izu, Jui, Norna, Ofi, Uso, Zio

Beliefs

Free from the burdens of collective tradition, many bantrids welcome faiths and philosophies from across the galaxy as readily as they reject them in the pursuit of a pure bantrid philosophy. This is especially true for the bantrid supremacists of the Unbroken Sphere and the faith of the Church of Sleep. The Church of Sleep believes that ancient bantrids entered stasis to avoid an apocalypse called the Awakened Nightmare, and that they urged other bantrids to return to stasis. These extremists went as far as kidnapping others and forcing them into stasis, and though they prioritized bantrid children, they also included non- bantrid visitors to Hibb. Amid dropping membership, given the challenge of recruiting new members following the revelation of Hibb's origins, the Church of Sleep has taken to repurposing and preparing to reactivate a sizable contingent of robots they illegally smuggled from the depths of Hibb to continue their “rescue efforts.”

Bantrids worship a diverse retinue of deities, and often form personal pantheons incorporating those gods that resonate with their developing philosophies. For example, after their successful contact with AbadarCorp, many bantrids took to the Master of the First Vault's church with the belief that Abadar will help them cultivate an economy and civilization on the surface of Hibb. Other financially focused followers fled Hibb to find their fortunes with the Prophets of Kalistrade, believing the destiny of their species is to buy another planet rather than fester on a mere moon. Many of these bantrids are drawn to the wanderer Weydan, whose teachings promote freedom and exploration. Learning of their extragalactic origins, more nomadically inclined bantrids began venerating Accelsys, the god of Infinite Movement. And after connecting with other worshippers of Accelsys on the Idari, other bantrids learned of and became disciples of the Cycle, drawn by the ideals of balance within an ever-flowing system.

Popular Edicts

boast of your accomplishments and accolades, compete against challenging opponents, surpass yourself, witness significant stellar events

Popular Anathema

back down from a challenge, fail to give your best effort, give up when faced with a setback, interfere with natural stellar processes, lie about yourself

pages.content:
班特里德人是好奇、善于创新的物种，几年前才从静滞中苏醒，从利亚瓦拉某颗卫星地心的神秘高塔中出现，对过去毫无记忆。置身于仍受大断层余波困扰的时代，他们很快接受了失忆的现状，面向未来，准备滚动着建设一个能与协约世界其他族群比肩的文明。

大多数班特里德人无法长时间保持静止，这一特点深刻塑造了其心态与文化，常表现为不断向更光明未来前进的欲望。这种心态是否表现、如何表现，因人而异。一个可能是坐不住的流行明星，拒绝跳两次相同舞步；另一个则是精明官僚，计划中十几个环节同时运转。这种无穷的前进动力常被称为乐观，但班特里德人也同样经常率先为迫近灾难作准备。这使许多人成为顾问、系统管理员与寻星者探索者，乐于满足自己的愿望，不断适应变幻莫测、潜伏陷阱与危险的环境。

许多班特里德人追逐个人名利，但缺少记忆、渴求社会凝聚，也让许多人走上更关心社区、好奇又合群的道路。话虽如此，关系稍现问题，他们便常立刻中断，也很少容忍侵犯自主权、侮辱独特生理构造的人。他们热衷学习旅途中遇见的不同文化传统，将喜爱的内容融入个人生活，打造自己的身份。这常引起外人怀疑：某年，一名班特里德人宣称最重要的节日是希布日食，即利亚瓦拉经过太阳前方、遮住阳光之时；可下次遇到吸引兴趣的天文现象，同一个人便完全抛弃此前庆典。这并非一时异想，而是想看看哪些庆典能与社区和朋友共鸣，以及如何改进。

如果你想扮演动力十足、积极进取，无论身体还是其他方面都不喜欢停滞的角色，就选择班特里德人。

你可能……

  • 培养某些日常习惯或开发技术，让自己在有限空间中也能不断移动。

  • 一头冲进有趣局面，明知不适合自己时，总能将其抛下继续前进。

  • 在缺少共同习俗时，寻找或创造新传统与民间故事，融入自己独特的文化身份。

他人可能……

  • 觉得你似乎无穷的精力与活动欲让人分心、烦躁，甚至筋疲力尽。

  • 怀疑你是否难以长时间专注，以致难以完成大型项目。

  • 认为你轻易结束糟糕关系，是出于无聊，而非自保。

外貌描述

与协约世界其他物种相比，班特里德人的身体构造很特别。他们像粗壮的柱子，有两只小眼睛，躯干中部有一对附肢，像大而扁平、带几根细指的手。眼睛与耳朵上方的小嘴张开时，露出紧密平整的牙齿，用来咀嚼纤维食物与坚果。灰蓝色皮肤常沿躯干带有条纹，底部拓宽，连着最独特的部位：占身体约一半的致密有机球体。班特里德人利用部分包覆球体的鞘膜底侧数十万根细纤毛，令球体旋转来移动。

班特里德人没有性别，通过身体出芽进行无性繁殖。新生儿发育中的足部滚珠，以脐带状结构连接身体约5个月，随后脱离，自行滚动。滚珠逐渐利用其自身身体的有机物，以及移动中收集的碎屑生长。若足部滚珠因受伤或营养不良未能正常发育，可以改用义体，但成长过程中必须不断重新调整。

许多班特里德人开始主动更换或强化足部滚珠，既为实用，也为自我表达。另一些甚至通过结合生物工程与死灵术的庄严仪式，取用亡者的足部滚珠；即使遵循死者传统与遗愿，多数班特里德人仍觉得骇人而不安。

社会

五年前，外星冒险者发现，早在大断层之前，班特里德人便反抗残暴主子西弗领国（Sivv Dominion），乘坐巨型殖民船逃亡；这艘船后来成为利亚瓦拉众多卫星之一的希布。历经无数岁月，在陌生时代与星系中醒来后，他们逐渐在荒凉卫星上开始建设新社会、确立新身份的艰巨任务。

自十年前从静滞中醒来，班特里德人虽面临人工卫星资源稀少的困境，仍取得巨大进展。他们与阿巴达尔集团承包商达成利润丰厚的贸易协议，对方急于逆向研究希布各地神秘宝库高塔中的古老断层前技术。起初，他们很高兴外星公司前来开业，但许多人渐渐警惕：逐利公司一旦完整记录高塔技术与历史，就不会再对卫星感兴趣。起源真相公开，古老殖民船内部归属名为无尽轮回的信托后，冲突大致解决。该信托监督希布内部的研究及后续收益，确保大部分所得用于改善基础设施，让班特里德母星在协约世界经济中保持一席之地。

班特里德人的寿命与人类大致相同，但相似之处仅此而已。他们以出芽无性繁殖，在集体环境中抚养孩子，使大多数人对待父母如同对待其他社区成员。这种心态很少给移居外星者带来问题，因为他们足够少见，同一聚居地的班特里德人通常共居一处，彼此视如家人。但这不代表所有人都合得来：即使希布这样小的天体，人口增长也自然滋生哲学与政治分歧，让志同道合者另组社区，以相近价值观抚养孩子。

仍活跃于希布的分支派系“不破之球”便是一例。他们相信班特里德人是优越物种，创造了后来变成希布的殖民船，还曾统治横跨多个星系的帝国，其领土包括如今广称为协约世界的宙域。球派声称自己和平，公开表示班特里德人只需以无与伦比的成就展现优越；暗地却相信，清除希布的外星影响，是征服其余星系的许多步骤之首。他们坚决反对无尽轮回，认为有关本族文化与西弗领国关系的历史记录系伪造，更愿相信缺乏现实依据的理论。

班特里德人倾向于音节少的短名字，能快速喊出，而不必让被叫的人停下。大多数只有一个名字，在长大到能够自行移动时获名。

示例姓名

Buo, Hin, Izu, Jui, Norna, Ofi, Uso, Zio

信仰

没有共同传统的负担，许多班特里德人追求纯粹的本族哲学，对各地信仰与思想既乐于接纳，也同样容易抛弃。不破之球的至上主义者与沉睡教会尤其如此。沉睡教会相信：古代班特里德人为逃避名为“苏醒梦魇”的末日而进入静滞，并敦促其他人重回静滞。这些极端分子甚至绑架他人，强迫其进入静滞；虽然优先针对本族儿童，也不放过希布的非本族访客。希布起源公开后，招募新成员日益困难，教会人数下滑，于是转而改装、准备重新启动一大批从希布深处非法走私出的机器人，以继续“救援行动”。

班特里德人崇拜许多神祇，常将与自身日渐成形的哲学共鸣的诸神，组成个人神系。例如，与阿巴达尔集团成功接触后，许多人加入第一宝库之主的教会，相信阿巴达尔会帮助他们在希布表面发展经济与文明。另一些重视财富的信徒离开希布，追随卡利斯拉德先知寻找财运，相信本族的命运是买下一颗行星，而非在区区卫星上腐朽。许多人也被流浪者韦丹吸引，其教义提倡自由与探索。得知自己源自其他星系后，更倾向游牧的班特里德人，开始敬奉无限运动之神Accelsys。而在伊达里号上接触Accelsys的其他信徒之后，另一些班特里德人了解并成为轮回的追随者，被不断流动系统内的平衡理想吸引。

常见典范

夸耀成就与荣誉，与强劲对手较量，超越自己，见证重要星辰事件

常见禁忌

退避挑战，未尽全力，遇挫便放弃，干涉恒星的自然过程，谎报自身情况

pages.expectedContent:
Even though they were the most intelligent and developed species on the planet now known as Vesk-2, ijtikris had mastered only rudimentary technologies by the time vesk starships arrived and claimed the planet for their growing empire. After millennia of integration, ijtikris have become respected and content members of the Veskarium, their old cultures practically erased and replaced with technologies they and their vesk partners have mastered together. Despite having inscrutable expressions hidden by their shells and tentacles, ijtikris are affectionate and loyal toward their adoptive families.

If you want to play a resilient explorer with unique adaptations to their home world's waters, you should play an ijtikri.

You Might...

  • Emotionally latch onto a mentor or community, endeavoring to be accepted.

  • Adopt stray creatures into your own community, serving as a stern yet affectionate teacher.

  • Explore a new object with all your senses, including passing it before your various eyes and crawling atop it for a taste.

Others Probably...

  • Believe you're fully amphibious and require immersion in water for good health.

  • Make assumptions about your personality and abilities based on your shell's appearance.

  • Struggle to understand where you're looking or what you're thinking.

Physical Description

Resembling terrestrial squids, ijtikris are intelligent invertebrates native to the warm, shallow seas of Vesk-2. Like a squid, an ijtikri has numerous, short arms and two longer tentacles, using the former like legs for locomotion and the latter to manipulate tools. Both sets of appendages have suckers that provide additional grip, allowing an ijtikri to stand up quickly or even lean almost parallel to the ground and scuttle rapidly without tipping over. Each ijtikri has seven eyes: one on either side of the lower portion of the head, another pair similarly situated on the top of their long head, and three eyes drawing a line between the two sets on the forehead.

Outsiders might be shocked to realize ijtikri settlements consist wholly of adults. That's no mistake; ijtikris undergo holometabolous metamorphosis, taking five different forms over the course of their life. They begin their life as a free-floating, acorn-sized egg that hatches into a wriggling larva that feeds on zooplankton. After roughly quadrupling in size, the larva migrates into shallow water and adheres to a solid surface, spending several years as a sessile filter feeder as they build up reserves of fat and trace minerals. Once ready, the larva hunkers down and pupates, emerging in their adult form with a pristine shell, lungs yearning for air, and barely functioning external gills that fall away shortly after the ijtikri reaches land.

Understandably, these metamorphoses leave little opportunity for childhood education. A newly metamorphosed ijtikri adult must navigate the surface world almost entirely by instinct—and those instincts prioritize finding a community as soon as possible. Guided by a cluster of ganglia called a skenoseen organ, the adult tracks the nearest ijtikri community by smell and other signs. Once welcomed, the newcomer's brain rapidly develops, absorbing every cultural, linguistic, and professional nuance they can from their adoptive family.

Upon maturity, an average ijtikri stands about 5 feet tall and weighs around 120 pounds, with their shell making up roughly a fifth of their mass. Unfortunately, as with the cephalopods they resemble, ijtikris' evolution didn't favor longevity. Ijtikri reproduction is— under natural circumstances—a once-in-a-lifetime event. Ijtikris couple periodically throughout their lives, swapping inert sex cells that they store in their bodies. These cells don't fertilize until the end of the ijtikri's life, when the creature wills their shell to fracture and their body to undergo one last metamorphosis. After several days of absorbing gases and stretching skin, the ijtikri becomes a leviathan—a blimp-like form that drifts with the winds until they're over open water, at which point they burst and scatter fertilized eggs across the ocean. Of course, this act ends the ijtikri's life. Self-sacrifice for future generations is a prominent theme in ijtikri art and literature. That said, by the time the Gap ended, ijtikri scientists had found ways to extract and fertilize eggs safely, allowing parents to procreate, carefully control their young's water quality, and even meet their children. However, these procedures remain uncommon, with most preferring the leviathan's pomp and finality.

Society

Adoption is a core pillar of ijtikri society. The community that adopts a young ijtikri becomes that individual's source of morality, instruction, and belonging. Even if they later leave their community in search of other opportunities, the adoption mindset remains strong; an experienced ijtikri can be quick to take a vulnerable creature under their wing, almost to a fault—anything from signing on a hapless apprentice in the middle of a military campaign to adopting a gaggle of orphaned animals. Socially, ijtikris are just raised to pay it forward to the next generation of whatever wanders their way. Neurologically, the natives of Vesk- 2 seem wired to feel guilty for abandoning orphans and exalt in the dopamine from expanding their own family.

For most day-to-day behaviors, ijtikri society resembles a wet, tropical variant of vesk culture. The community expects hard work until a job is done, followed by extended rest and contemplation. Left to their own devices, ijtikri communities are fairly egalitarian and look to temporary leaders based on seniority and expertise, though the Veskarium's influence has instituted slightly more rigid and predictable hierarchies.

Very few traces of any pre-Veskarium ijtikri culture have survived the millennia since conquest and integration into the vesk empire. Most ijtikris don't seem to mind, as they've become integral and trusted partners in vesk society, and they often don't view themselves as a demographic separate from their vesk neighbors. That said, Drift travel and outside perspectives have awoken some ijtikris' curiosity in their forgotten past. A handful of archaeological projects dot Vesk- 2, dredging up waterlogged ruins, rusting tools, and occasional inscriptions written in forgotten scripts. Each dig includes at least one Veskarium attaché, always wary that archaeologists might unearth something controversial; Vesk Prime can ill afford another Pulonis incident. That said, the finds thus far are innocuous, and ijtikris seem eager to reincorporate these lost traditions and symbols into their predominantly vesk-driven culture. If any harbor more rebellious, archaeology-driven ambitions, they've remained hidden.

In general, ijtikris adopt names from whatever culture they attach themselves to upon becoming adults. Thus, many ijtikris favor vesk names. Ijtikris nevertheless enjoy adding flourishes to their names in the form of siphon-boosted vowels— exaggerated long vowel sounds aspirated by an exhalation from their siphon, giving the name an almost musical quality that most species struggle to replicate.

Sample Names

Bozamn Zorbolo, Clyp Cryndo, Fodan Fano, Ojeni Boga, Selko Gra, Uroubituun, Vodo Zan

Beliefs

Ijtikris greatly value their adoptive communities. This manifests as protectiveness toward their neighbors and the group's social identity and also as whatever internalized values their community considers virtuous. On Vesk-2, where most ijtikris mature, that means respect for authority, appreciation of structured societies, and a love of contact sports (often extending to military service) that befits their place in the Veskarium. However, those who grow up beyond the Veskarium's reach are cultural sponges ready to absorb any other society's values.

Naturally, their home planet also shapes their worship. On Vesk-2, many ijtikris revere the Veskarium's patron, Damoritosh, as well as other paragons of social order like Abadar or even Lissala. Hylax and Talavet resonate with their communal mindset, whereas those who crave novelty beyond their home often rely on Weydan to guide their paths. Four other deities boast noteworthy ijtikri followings that worry the Veskarium. Oras and the Newborn both embody metamorphosis, driving an ijtikri to change, challenge tradition, and become something wholly unique. Meanwhile, Meyel and Besmara fulfill an ijtikri's need for belonging, albeit in a rebellious way.

Popular Edicts

honor your adoptive family (or families), shelter and adopt those without a family of their own

Popular Anathema

break another's figurative shell without offering a fix, undermine your adoptive family's interests

Ijtikri Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet, Swim 10 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Wisdom, Free

石面鱿族虽是如今称为维斯克二号的行星上最智慧、最发达的物种，在维斯克星舰抵达、将行星划入扩张中的帝国时，也只掌握基础技术。数千年融合后，他们已是维斯卡里姆受尊重、心满意足的成员，旧文化几乎被抹去，代之以与维斯克伙伴共同掌握的科技。虽然外壳与触手遮住表情，令人难以捉摸，他们却深爱并忠于收养家庭。

如果你想扮演坚韧的探索者，具有适应母星水域的独特特征，就选择石面鱿族。

你可能……

  • 情感上依恋导师或社区，努力争取接纳。

  • 将流浪生物收养进社区，做严厉而慈爱的老师。

  • 动用一切感官探索新物件，包括从各只眼睛前移过，爬上去尝尝味道。

他人可能……

  • 认为你完全两栖，必须浸水才能保持健康。

  • 根据外壳外观，推测你的性格与能力。

  • 难以判断你在看哪里，或想些什么。

外貌描述

石面鱿族外形如地球上的鱿鱼，是维斯克二号温暖浅海中的智慧无脊椎动物。他们有许多短腕与两条长触腕，以前者如腿般移动，后者操纵工具。两种附肢都有吸盘加强抓握，使他们能迅速站起，甚至几乎平行地面倾身疾行而不翻倒。每个个体有七只眼：头部下端两侧各一只，长头顶端类似位置另有一对，额头上三只眼在两对之间排成直线。

外人可能惊讶于聚居地全是成年人，这并非误会：石面鱿族经历完全变态，一生有五种形态。生命起初是自由漂浮、橡子大的卵，孵出蠕动幼体，以浮游动物为食。体形长到原来约四倍后，幼体迁入浅水，附着固体表面，固着滤食数年，储备脂肪与微量矿物质。准备好后，幼体蜷伏化蛹，破蛹成为成体，带着崭新外壳、渴望空气的肺，以及几乎不能工作的外鳃；上岸不久，外鳃便脱落。

不难理解，这些变态过程几乎不给童年教育机会。刚完成变态的成体，几乎全凭本能探索地表世界，而本能的首要任务是尽快找到社区。被称为镜视器官的神经节簇，引导成体凭气味与其他迹象追踪最近社区。获欢迎之后，脑部迅速发育，尽力从收养家庭吸收文化、语言与职业的一切细节。

成年的石面鱿族平均身高约5尺，重约120磅，外壳占约五分之一。不幸的是，和相似的头足类一样，演化没有赋予他们长寿。自然条件下，繁殖是一生一次的事。他们一生定期交配，交换、储存惰性生殖细胞。直到生命终点，细胞才受精，此时个体凭意志令壳破裂，身体经历最后一次变态。吸收气体、伸展皮肤数日后，成为海怪（leviathan）：飞艇般的形态，随风飘至开阔水域上方，爆裂后将受精卵洒向海洋。这自然结束其生命，为后代自我牺牲遂成为艺术与文学的重要主题。不过，在大断层结束时，科学家已能安全提取卵并使其受精，让父母繁殖、仔细控制后代水质，甚至见到孩子。但这些繁殖手段仍少见，多数人偏好海怪形态的盛大与终结性。

社会

收养是社会的核心支柱。接纳年轻石面鱿族的社区，成为其道德、教育与归属来源。即使日后离开寻求机会，这种收养心态仍强烈。经验丰富者会迅速庇护弱小生物，有时几乎过头，从战役中途收个倒霉学徒，到收养一群孤儿动物，无所不包。社会教导他们将善意传给身边遇到的任何下一代。神经层面，维斯克二号原住民似乎天生会因遗弃孤儿而愧疚，并在扩大家庭时因多巴胺而欢欣。

日常行为大多像维斯克文化的潮湿热带变体。社区期望努力工作直至完成，再长久休息、沉思。自主发展时，社区相当平等，按资历与专长推举临时领袖，维斯卡里姆的影响则带来稍严格、更可预测的等级。

被征服、融入维斯克帝国数千年后，旧文化几无痕迹。多数不介意，因为已成为维斯克社会不可或缺、受信任的伙伴，常不将自己视为与维斯克邻居分立的群体。但漂流旅行与外界视角，唤起部分人对被遗忘过去的好奇。维斯克二号零星的考古项目，打捞浸水遗迹、锈蚀工具，偶得失传文字的铭文。每处至少有一位维斯卡里姆随员，警惕挖出争议之物：维斯克主星经不起又一次普洛尼斯事件。然而目前发现均无害，石面鱿族也乐于将失落传统、符号融回以维斯克为主导的文化。若有人怀着更叛逆、由考古激发的野心，也仍隐藏着。

通常，他们取名沿用成年后所加入的文化，因此许多偏爱维斯克名字。但他们喜欢以漏斗增强元音来装饰名字：从漏斗呼气，送出夸张长元音，让名字近似音乐，多数物种难以模仿。

示例姓名

Bozamn Zorbolo, Clyp Cryndo, Fodan Fano, Ojeni Boga, Selko Gra, Uroubituun, Vodo Zan

信仰

石面鱿族极重视收养社区，保护邻居与群体社会身份，也内化社区崇尚的价值。多数人在维斯克二号成熟，意味着尊重权威、欣赏有秩序的社会、热爱身体接触运动，常进而投身军旅，符合维斯卡里姆成员的身份。但在帝国影响范围外长大者，像文化海绵，随时可吸收任何社会的价值。

母星自然也塑造信仰。维斯克二号许多人崇拜帝国守护神戴莫力图斯，以及阿巴达尔乃至璃殇等社会秩序典范。海拉丝与塔拉维特呼应集体心态，渴望外界新奇者则常依赖韦丹指路。另有四位神祇拥有显著的石面鱿族信徒，让维斯卡里姆担忧。奥拉斯与新诞者体现蜕变，推动改变、挑战传统，成为完全独特的存在。梅耶尔与贝斯玛拉则以叛逆的方式，满足归属感需要。

常见典范

尊重收养你的家庭或多个家庭，庇护并收养没有家的人

常见禁忌

打破他人的心理外壳却不提供修补办法，损害收养家庭的利益

石面鱿族规则数据

体型 中型

速度 25尺，游泳10尺

属性提升 体质、感知、自选

属性缺陷 魅力

pages.expectedContent:
Izalguuns, a secretive species originally from the Scoured Stars System, have had a troubled past. A long time ago, most izalguuns left their trinary solar system to escape the influence of their god Kadrical. These large, six-limbed people focus on community and survival, and they don't like to talk about their history.

You Might...

  • Deflect questions about your background, your home planet, and your capabilities.

  • Prefer one posture over the other, depending on your needs.

  • Fear what powerful entities might be coming for you.

Others Probably...

  • Wonder about you are and where you're from.

  • Admire your physicality and underestimate your technical aptitude.

  • Trust you to keep their secrets.

Physical Description

Izalguuns are physically imposing, standing at around 7 feet tall and weighing 900 pounds, give or take. They have four arms and two legs, with the lower set of arms being bulkier and elongated. Izalguuns' unique physiology allows them to stand bipedal and benefit from having four arms, and to drop on all fours in a quadrupedal posture if the moment calls for speed. White mottling on their joints contrasts with their gray-green skin. Their vertically oriented mouths are lined with sharp teeth on each side. Izalguuns' two eyes rest on bony protrusions that extend horizontally from their skulls, giving them a very wide field of view.

Society

Izalguun societies vary substantially between those on the adopted planet of Izalraan and those on their original planet of Agillae-4. While the diaspora groups on Izalraan brought some traditions with them, they valued the opportunity to create a new societal structure. They fled the Scoured Stars to get away from the deity Kadrical and so wanted to remove his influence from their lives entirely.

Upon arriving on Izalraan, izalguuns secreted away the starships that brought them out of the Scoured Stars deep within subterranean complexes, eschewing technology to reconnect with nature. Their society is very structured, with each of its members taking a role as either a hunter, a gatherer, a farmer, or a leader. Having hidden away the industrial technology that carried them between stars, these izalguuns endure an immense amount of manual labor to keep their communities fed, clothed, and housed. Along with the elders who lead their communities and provide wisdom, healers and scientists are also venerated as leaders, making use of the secret technology of their buried starships to do their jobs. Izalraan izalguuns aren't bound to remain in one role for their whole lives. Many an izalguun alternates between the hunting grounds and the fields, spending years mastering a craft before pursuing a new endeavor to contribute to their society. No matter what an individual's role is, the izalguun societies on Izalraan take a community-based approach to caring for children and the elderly, with everyone who's able to pitch in doing so to make sure that no one lacks the basic necessities of life. Leaders choose their successors and apprentices depending on their areas of expertise and the leader-to-be's temperament, reputation within the society, and skills. Once someone has become a leader and is charged with keeping the society's technology a secret, they're bound to that role from then on, at least for so long as they stay on Izalraan.

The societal structures of the izalguuns who remained on Agillae-4 differ greatly from both those of the izalguuns on Izalraan and those of the ancient izalguuns who built their cities. While they embrace technology, Agillaean izalguuns had to leave their cities while seeking safety and became largely nomadic. They scavenged technology from the ruins of their own civilization. These izalguuns don't have defined roles as those on Izalraan do, but they've inherited the same sense of community. They tend to form small groups that travel together but might not all be related. They forage for food and set traps to catch small wildlife to eat.

The izalguuns of Agillae-4 are slowly moving back into their ancestral cities, such as Izadamar. This city is largely in ruins, but with immigration and involvement from external groups, a large push is underway to rebuild and repopulate Izadamar due to its importance as a port of call on a Drift Lane. Izalguuns now share their world with many other species, inviting newcomers to participate in economic and political matters as equals to native residents. However, izalguuns certainly benefit from the city being originally designed with their physiology in mind, as everything is already at scale for such large beings. A substantial contingent of izalguuns from Izalraan have even returned to their ancestral home of Agillae-4, and they're learning to cultivate the native vegetation and generate crops to feed the booming city.

Izalguuns are omnivores to the extreme with the ability to digest a wide variety of food sources, which helps in both their settled and nomadic societies. Traditional izalguun dishes tend to be flexible with their ingredients, such as thick stews and warm salads, and are often served in a wide, shallow bowl made of bread to reduce mess, given the vertical orientation of their mouths. They use plentiful herbs as substitutions for ingredients that have gone stale.

Izalguun names are typically two syllables and often use repeated vowels. They don't have a family name, though parents will often implement letters or syllables from their own names into their child's name.

Sample Names

Famaani, Friil, Maraan, Naarma, Numuur, Prima, Ralveen, Sarmak, Videel

Beliefs

While various izalguun societies have developed in different ways, certain through lines appear common to all izalguun cultures. A strong sense of community is one such commonality, with a focus on putting the group's needs ahead of one's own. Acts like abandoning your people to danger are major taboos. Izalguuns have a reputation for being incredibly trustworthy and honorable, being willing to give up even their lives instead of revealing a secret entrusted to them. They are often secretive even when it isn't truly necessary and don't like to reveal personal information about themselves.

Izalguuns haven't been religious ever since their trouble with the deity Kadrical, and they prefer to put their faith in each other rather than a divine being. Worship of Kadrical is horrifying to most izalguuns, though sects that engage in such worship do exist. Resettled izalguuns are much more likely to serve a god than their kin and commonly worship gods like Talavet, Yaraesa, and Zon-Shelyn. Talavet and Yaraesa have values similar to most izalguuns, while Zon-Shelyn's story resonates for many.

Izalguuns on Izalraan specifically opted to eschew technology to form an agrarian society in harmony with nature, though their leaders continue to retain access to that technology in case it's needed once more. They value hard work and providing for the community.

Popular Edicts

keep your secrets and those of others, stay connected to the natural world, support your community

Popular Anathema

abandoning your community to danger, discussing your background and where you're from, worship of Kadrical

Izalguun Mechanics

Size Large

Speed See Posture
