pages.content:
伊扎尔贡人是源自荡劫星域的隐秘物种，有着坎坷过去。很久以前，大多数族人为逃脱神祇卡德瑞卡的影响，离开三星系统。这些六肢的大型生物重视社区与生存，不喜欢谈论历史。

你可能……

  • 回避关于背景、母星和能力的问题。

  • 按需求偏爱其中一种姿态。

  • 担忧会有什么强大存在追索自己。

他人可能……

  • 好奇你是谁、从哪里来。

  • 钦佩你的体魄，却低估你的科技才能。

  • 相信你会保守他们的秘密。

外貌描述

伊扎尔贡人体格威武，身高约7尺，体重约900磅。他们四臂双腿，下方一对手臂更粗大、修长。独特生理结构使他们能双足站立，享有四臂优势；需要速度时，也可俯身以四足姿态行动。关节的白色斑纹与灰绿皮肤形成反差。嘴竖向排列，两边长满利齿。两眼位于从头骨向侧方伸出的骨质突起上，视野极广。

社会

定居伊扎尔兰与留在原生行星阿吉拉4号的社会差异很大。迁居伊扎尔兰者虽带去一些传统，却珍视另建社会结构的机会。他们为逃避卡德瑞卡而离开荡劫星域，希望彻底清除这位神祇对生活的影响。

抵达伊扎尔兰后，他们将逃离荡劫星域的星舰藏入地下设施深处，放弃科技，重新亲近自然。社会组织严密，每人担任猎人、采集者、农夫或领袖。工业技术既已深藏，就要以大量手工劳动满足社区衣食住需求。除领导、传授智慧的长老，治疗者与科学家也作为领袖受敬重，利用埋藏星舰的秘密科技工作。伊扎尔兰居民不必终生固定一职，许多人往返猎场与农田，花数年精通手艺，再投身新事业贡献社会。无论个人职责如何，社区共同照顾儿童与老人，所有力所能及者都参与，确保人人获得基本生活所需。领袖选择继承者与学徒，会考虑专业领域，以及后继者的性情、声誉与技能。一旦成为领袖、受托保守科技秘密，从此必须承担这一职责，至少在留居伊扎尔兰期间如此。

留在阿吉拉4号者的社会结构，既不同于伊扎尔兰，也不同于建造城市的古代族人。他们虽接纳科技，却为寻求安全离城，大体成为游牧者，从自身文明废墟中搜寻技术。他们没有伊扎尔兰式固定职责，却继承同样的社区精神，常组成不一定全有亲属关系的小群共同旅行，采集食物、设陷阱捕捉小型野生动物为食。

阿吉拉4号的伊扎尔贡人正缓慢返回伊扎达玛等祖传城市。这座城大部分仍是废墟，但因位于漂流航道、是重要停靠港，外来移民与团体大力参与重建和重新定居。他们如今与许多物种共享母星，欢迎新人平等参与经济政治事务。不过，城市最初依其生理结构设计，设施尺度早已适合这种大型生物，原住民确实因此受益。甚至有许多伊扎尔兰族人返回祖居阿吉拉4号，学习栽培本地植物，种粮供应蓬勃发展的城市。

伊扎尔贡人极其杂食，能消化广泛食物，便利定居与游牧社会。传统菜肴用料灵活，例如浓炖菜和温沙拉。由于嘴竖向排列，常以面包制成宽浅碗盛食，减少洒落。他们大量用香草替代已不新鲜的食材。

名字通常有两个音节，常重复元音。他们没有姓氏，但父母往往将自己名字中的字母或音节用于孩子名字。

示例姓名

Famaani, Friil, Maraan, Naarma, Numuur, Prima, Ralveen, Sarmak, Videel

信仰

不同社会发展各异，文化中仍有共同脉络。强烈社区意识是其一，强调集体需要高于自身。抛弃族人于险境等行为是大忌。伊扎尔贡人以极可靠、重荣誉闻名，宁愿舍命也不泄露受托秘密。即使无必要，他们也常守口如瓶，不愿透露个人信息。

经历与卡德瑞卡的纠葛后，伊扎尔贡人不再热衷宗教，宁可相信彼此，而非神明。多数人视崇拜卡德瑞卡为可怕之事，虽然这样的教派确实存在。重新定居者比其他同胞更可能侍奉神祇，常崇拜塔拉维特、亚莱纱与宗-莎琳。前两者价值观与多数伊扎尔贡人相近，后者的故事则令许多人共鸣。

伊扎尔兰居民特意放弃科技，建立与自然和谐的农业社会，但领袖仍保留科技使用权，以备再次需要。他们重视辛勤劳动与供养社区。

常见典范

保守自己与他人的秘密，与自然世界相连，支持社区

常见禁忌

抛弃社区于险境，谈论背景与来历，崇拜卡德瑞卡

伊扎尔贡人规则数据

生命值 8

体型 大型

速度 见姿态

属性提升 力量、智力、自选

属性缺陷 敏捷

语言 通用语、伊扎尔贡语，以及自选一种地区语言

额外语言 数量等于你的智力调整值（若为正值）。从常见语言列表和你有权获取的其他语言中选择（例如家园世界广泛使用的语言）。

pages.expectedContent:
Originally native to the First World, moyishuus emerged into the Vast on the sensestone-rich planet Veyvilla-6. Many moyishuus have an insatiable hunger for adventure and meeting new faces. Those among them who struck out into the galaxy at large to experience the lives and emotions of its inhabitants earned their people a reputation for being an affable, charismatic, and adventurous bunch. Many moyishuus embark on such journeys as soon as they reach maturity, returning to Veyvilla-6 only when they've satiated their appetites for observing the emotions of other species.

If you want to play a character who's supernaturally in tune with their own emotions, and even with those of others, you should play a moyishuu.

You Might...

  • Invoke your passion at any time, even when it's inappropriate.

  • Evoke emotions from those around you, lifting or dampening their spirits.

  • Live your life as if each moment was your last.

Others Probably...

  • Distrust you, thinking that you have the ability to manipulate their emotions.

  • See you as less capable because your emotions direct you.

  • Question your ability to plan ahead.

Physical Description

Moyishuus are humanoid fey with brightly colored skin and crystalline hair in any shade of the spectrum. Most have natural darker markings across their limbs that often resemble vines, and they have long, pointed ears. They average between 4 to 6 feet in height and live up to 200 years of age.

Moyishuus often express their passions through their physical appearance, sporting piercings, tattoos, and permanent aesthetic implants that run the gamut of expressions. Even their “hair,” actually an ancient symbiotic fungus that creates crystalline protrusions, is expressive and can be changed at will by a moyishuu to suit their current desires.

Nearly all moyishuus have some form of expressive nature, even though not every moyishuu lives their entire life in a chaotic artist's adventure. Many settle into a routine and find their deepest and most profound expressions in one place, whether it be some complex and novel form of painting or the most mundane task one can think of. The moyishuu mechanic who can somehow make an engine purr is no less an artist than the banjo-forward hopepunk band playing at the local bar.

Moyishuu gender expression is a highly individual choice that they modify not just by their clothing style, but wholly change at their whim. While many settle into a favorite gender expression, some change daily. Some go so far as to actively modify the fungus that creates their hair, using it to create novel expressions.

Moyishuus know emotion as a sense that pervades their every experience, and they can emulate and harness these feelings both overtly and subtly. Every moyishuu, regardless of station, begins their day by developing a dominant emotion, known as their “soulfeel.” This soulfeel shapes much of their interactions for the rest of the day, buoying or even dragging out the feelings of those around them.

Society

Moyishuus are a people of infinite passion, ready to express their feelings at the drop of a hat. Spontaneous singing and even musical bands that dissolve in a few days are commonplace in the cities of Veyvilla-6, and many find long and satisfying careers in entertainment throughout the planet. Originally natives of the First World and found there in vastly larger numbers, moyishuus build their communities to often echo the chaotic appearances of fey cities.

Most of moyishuu society in the Vast revolves around Veyvilla-6, but in a society of self-expressive, near-anarchical fey, organization in any facet of life is a rarity. Ballyhome, the largest city on Veyvilla-6, expresses this spirit in its chaotic street layout, winding natural paths along the topography where buildings of different architectural styles stand next to each other. In more than one instance, two buildings have been known to rise in an intricate dance around each other with starkly contrasting architectural styles inspired by opposite ends of the galaxy.

Moyishuu society isn't entirely chaotic in practice. Every moyishuu chooses their emotive nature for the day, every day, upon their waking, wherever they are. From this emotive choice has a system of clans developed based upon the method in which this choice is made. Though their names are esoteric in nature, the reality is simply that Those Who Dance choose their emotive path for the day by expressing themselves physically, while Those Who Sing tend to rise and vocalize almost immediately. The less literal Those Who Burn tend to instead choose an objective for the day and unleash immediate effort to accomplish a task, while Those Who Sow meditate for periods to begin their day.

This societal separation has, in the modern era, caused the aforementioned architectural interplay, as moyishuus sometimes see their homes as one of the most important places to express their long-term goals.

Moyishuu musical and entertainment culture have also caused a massive exodus of young moyishuus who seek attention from Pact Worlds audiences, and the concert halls and bars of Veyvilla-6 feature some of the most passionate and entertaining acts in the Vast. It's often said in the entertainment business that “nary a star can outshine the brilliance of a Veyvillian stage.”

Being experimental and mutable by nature, moyishuus often consider their gender as a fluid spectrum, sometimes rejecting the concept entirely and referring to their desires in terms of time. A common moyishuu term for a partner is “the moment,” regardless of how long their relationship has lasted or, in many cases, is planned to last. Thus, moyishuu partnerships can be short-lived but are just as often lifelong affairs between multiple individuals.

Many moyishuus enter into civil bonds, but due to their sometimes-chaotic tendencies, these relationships are legally binding for a set amount of time and must be argued before a court. While this court is largely a formality akin to a marriage ceremony, occasionally some moyishuus have been known to make a show of it, leading to an entire distinct subgenre of live-action court love drama emerging on Veyvilla-6. Featuring rock-ballad duels between three lovers who can't agree to a marriage contract, a lengthy cross-promotional series with The Applecake Adventures of Space Fortress Z is one of the most widely known examples.

The government on Veyvilla-6 still maintains a relationship with the First World in the form of trade missions and diplomatic overtures, as both sides bristle at the other's involvement in their affairs. Most politically active moyishuus involved in their communities see themselves as a neutral party between the First World and the Vast and refuse to bow to either's powers. As such, a magical barrier has been erected around Veyvilla-6 that prevents most, but not all, travel between planes. Similar to the blooms of Kalo-Mahoi, there are ritual paths that open portals between the powers. These blooms are, however, closely monitored through a magical sensor network on Veyvilla-6 by using its density of sensestone to tap actively into the Drift.

This magical sensor network bears the reality of Veyvilla- 6's capabilities should it ever need to defend itself. That there aren't constant incursions of First World fey into the Veyvilla System speaks volumes to the efficiency of the monitoring system and the deadly nature of whatever response teams the fey of Veyvilla-6 field. No records of whatever conflict first severed moyishuus from the First World remain, but it's known to have been a pre-Gap situation, speaking to the depth of the rift. A common phrase states that “Veyvilla will have its independence, and the First World will have only itself to blame.”

The Veyvilla-6 government is largely an expanded union formed into an ad-hoc parliament through which direct voting is offered should any individual moyishuu show a desire to interact with the political landscape. For many, statecraft is an expression just as passionate as any song, and many laws have been written in rhyming scheme. Ballyhome is both the largest settlement on Veyvilla-6 and its de facto capital, with all other settlements on the planet's three continents put together making up roughly two thirds of the population. Perhaps the most important department of the government, the Department of Stone Sense and Sensestone—a watchdog organization that both surveys and protects the rights of any sensestone deposits—employs a full quarter of governmental personnel on Veyvilla-6.

Sensestone has been a boon to Veyvilla-6, and to moyishuus in general. Magical, technological, and biotech modifications with sensestone allow for unique ways to restore and augment sensations, and many who are magically inclined prefer the feel and feedback of sensestone when interacting with rituals, even if it's exorbitantly priced.

Just as most moyishuus have a fluid relationship with the concept of gender, they each have unique methods for how they interact with their emotive senses. At a young age, each moyishuu finds their connective action to their ability. These connective actions fall into four primary categories, known as Those who Burn, Dance, Sing, and Sow.

Sample Names

Ayul, Dealo, Kissarim, Pearl, Wild(wood), ZZZZZZZ

Beliefs

Moyishuu belief systems run the gamut of pantheons, from the First World to the Pact Worlds, and more than a few profess to be active members in the so-called church of Zo!. (Zo! officially denies all connection to these cults.) There are very few organized religious buildings on Veyvilla-6, with the remaining fey Eldest worship occurring in groves or in random outdoor spaces. Even the church of Triune maintains only a tiny chapel devoted to the care of local Drift beacons, while the church of Ibra is housed in a small bar southwest of Ballyhome, run by a bartending priest who wears an oversized cowboy hat and worships the universe by telling inscrutable tales of supposed frontier wisdom.

Popular Edicts

express yourself, wear your heart on your sleeve

Popular Anathema

downplay others' feelings, ruin someone's fun

Moyishuu Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Wisdom

Languages Common, Fey

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • fey

  • humanoid

  • moyishuu

Senses Emotionsense

莫伊舒人最初生息于第一世界，后来现身于浩界中富含感知石的维维拉6号行星上。许多莫伊舒人对冒险和结识新朋友有着永不满足的渴望。他们之中远赴银河各处、体验当地居民生活与情绪的人，为族群赢得了和蔼可亲、富有魅力、热爱冒险的名声。许多莫伊舒人一成年就踏上这样的旅程，只有在观察其他种族情绪的欲望得到满足之后，才会返回维维拉6号。

如果你希望扮演一个能以超自然的方式与自身情绪，乃至他人情绪产生共鸣的角色，就应该选择莫伊舒人。

你可能……

  • 随时释放激情，即便场合并不合适。

  • 激发周围人的情绪，让他们振奋或消沉。

  • 将每一刻都当作生命的最后一刻来度过。

他人可能……

  • 不信任你，认为你有能力操纵他们的情绪。

  • 因为你受情绪支配而觉得你能力不足。

  • 质疑你能否提前规划。

外貌描述

莫伊舒人是人形的妖精，皮肤色泽鲜艳，晶体般的头发可以呈现光谱中的任何颜色。大多数人的四肢上有天然的深色斑纹，往往形似藤蔓，耳朵则长而尖。他们平均身高4至6尺，寿命可达200年。

莫伊舒人常以外表表达激情，通过穿孔、文身和永久性的美容植入物，展现各式各样的表达方式。就连他们的“头发”也富有表现力——那其实是一种古老的共生真菌，会生长出晶状突起；莫伊舒人可以随心改变它，以契合当下的愿望。

几乎所有莫伊舒人都有某种善于表达的天性，但并非每个人都将一生过成混乱艺术家的冒险。许多人会安定于日常生活，在一处找到最深刻、最真切的表达，无论那是某种复杂新颖的绘画方式，还是最平凡不过的任务。能让引擎发出满足般低鸣的莫伊舒机械师，与在当地酒吧演出、以班卓琴为主奏的希望朋克乐队一样，都是艺术家。

莫伊舒人的性别表达完全取决于个人选择。他们不仅通过服装风格加以调整，还会随心彻底改变。尽管许多人会固定在自己偏爱的性别表达上，有些人却每天都会改变。有些人甚至主动改造形成头发的真菌，借此创造新颖的表达。

对莫伊舒人而言，情绪是一种贯穿一切体验的感官，他们可以或明显、或微妙地模仿并运用这些感受。每位莫伊舒人，无论地位高低，都会在一天开始时培养一种主导情绪，称为“魂感”。这种魂感会塑造他们当天余下的大部分人际互动，激励周围人的情绪，甚至将其引发出来。

社会

莫伊舒人拥有无穷的激情，随时准备表达感受。在维维拉6号的城市里，即兴歌唱十分常见，就连组建后几天便解散的乐队也不稀奇；许多人在这颗行星各处的娱乐行业中找到了长久而令人满足的事业。莫伊舒人原本来自第一世界，那里至今仍有远比这里庞大得多的族群；他们建造的社群，外观也常呼应妖精城市的混乱风貌。

浩界中的莫伊舒社会大多围绕维维拉6号展开，但在这个强调自我表达、近乎无政府状态的妖精社会里，生活的任何方面都很少井然有序。维维拉6号最大的城市巴利霍姆，以混乱的街道布局体现了这种精神：天然路径顺着地势蜿蜒，不同建筑风格的房屋彼此紧邻。甚至不止一次出现过这样的景象：两座建筑仿佛跳着复杂的舞蹈，彼此交错盘旋而上，其风格却截然不同，灵感分别源自银河系相反的两端。

莫伊舒社会在实际运作中并非全然混乱。每天醒来时，无论身处何地，每位莫伊舒人都会选择当天的情感本性。围绕做出这种选择的方法，逐渐形成了一套氏族体系。这些称呼虽然玄奥，实际却很简单：“舞者”通过身体表达，选择当天的情感道路；“歌者”往往一起床就开始发声。不那么字面化的“燃者”通常会先选定当天的目标，再立刻倾注心力完成任务；“播种者”则会先冥想一段时间，以此开启新的一天。

在现代，这种社会划分催生了前述建筑风格的交相呼应，因为莫伊舒人有时会将家园视为表达长期目标最重要的场所之一。

莫伊舒人的音乐和娱乐文化，也促使大量渴望吸引盟约诸界观众目光的年轻莫伊舒人离乡。维维拉6号的音乐厅与酒吧则上演着浩界中最富激情、最具娱乐性的演出。娱乐业常有一句话：“群星也难掩维维拉舞台的光芒。”

莫伊舒人天性喜好尝试、善于变化，常将性别视为流动的光谱，有时甚至完全拒绝这一概念，转而以时间来描述自己的欲望。莫伊舒人常称伴侣为“此刻”，无论关系已持续多久，或在许多情况下，预计还将持续多久。因此，莫伊舒人的伴侣关系可能短暂即逝，但也同样常见多人相伴终生的情形。

许多莫伊舒人会缔结民事结合关系，但考虑到他们有时混乱多变的倾向，这些关系只在规定时限内具有法律约束力，而且必须在法庭上辩论。虽然这种审理大多只是类似婚礼的形式，偶尔仍有莫伊舒人将其办成一场表演，令维维拉6号诞生了一个独立的真人法庭爱情剧子类型。其中最著名的例子之一，是一部长篇跨界宣传系列，与《太空要塞Z的苹果蛋糕大冒险》联动，讲述三个无法就婚姻契约达成一致的恋人以摇滚情歌展开对决。

维维拉6号的政府仍通过贸易使团和外交接触，与第一世界维持关系，不过双方都对彼此干预自身事务感到恼火。多数积极参与社群政治的莫伊舒人，将自己视为第一世界与浩界之间的中立一方，拒绝向任何一方的势力低头。因此，维维拉6号周围竖起了一道魔法屏障，阻挡大多数但并非全部的位面旅行。与卡洛-马霍伊的盛放现象类似，某些仪式路径会在两方之间开启传送门。不过，维维拉6号利用当地丰富的感知石主动接入漂流域，通过魔法传感器网络，严密监视这些盛放现象。

这套魔法传感器网络，体现了维维拉6号在必要时保卫自身的真实能力。第一世界的妖精并未不断侵入维维拉星系，这充分说明监控系统的效率，以及维维拉6号妖精派出的应对队伍何等致命。没有任何记录留存下来，能解释最初是什么冲突令莫伊舒人与第一世界分离；但人们知道，那发生在大断层之前，可见裂痕之深。有句俗话说：“维维拉终将独立，第一世界只能怪自己。”

维维拉6号的政府大体上是一个扩大的联合体，组成了临时议会。任何莫伊舒人只要愿意参与政治，就能直接投票。对许多人而言，治国也是一种与歌唱同样充满激情的表达，因此许多法律都以押韵的形式写成。巴利霍姆既是维维拉6号最大的聚居地，也是其事实上的首都；行星三块大陆上的其他聚居地加在一起，人口约占总数的三分之二。政府中或许最重要的部门，是石感与感知石部——这个监督机构既勘查感知石矿藏，也保护其相关权利，雇用了维维拉6号四分之一的政府人员。

感知石为维维拉6号乃至整个莫伊舒族群带来了福祉。利用感知石进行的魔法、科技与生物工程改造，提供了独特的感官恢复与强化方式。许多擅长魔法的人在施行仪式时，格外偏爱感知石带来的感受与反馈，即便其价格极为昂贵。

正如大多数莫伊舒人对性别概念的态度流动多变，他们与情感感官互动的方法也各有不同。每位莫伊舒人在年幼时都会找到将自身与能力相连的行动方式。这些行动大致分为四类，称为燃者、舞者、歌者和播种者。

示例姓名

Ayul、Dealo、Kissarim、Pearl、Wild(wood)、ZZZZZZZ

信仰

莫伊舒人的信仰涵盖从第一世界到盟约诸界的各个神系，不少人还宣称自己是所谓丧教会的活跃成员。（丧正式否认与这些教派有任何关系。）维维拉6号上有组织的宗教建筑极少，对妖精始祖的残存崇拜则在林间或随意选定的露天场所进行。就连三贤一教会，也只维持一座小礼拜堂，负责照料当地的漂流域信标；伊布拉教会则设在巴利霍姆西南方的一家小酒吧里，由一位戴着硕大牛仔帽的调酒师牧师经营。他通过讲述难以理解、据称蕴含边疆智慧的故事来敬拜宇宙。

常见典范

表达自我，坦率流露感受

常见禁忌

轻视他人的感受，扫别人的兴

体型 中型

速度 25尺

属性缺陷 感知

pages.name: 奥沙鲁人
pages.expectedContent:
Osharus hold a deep reverence for the scientific process and the acquisition of wisdom that infuses every aspect of their university-cities, which were built as sanctuaries from the harsh conditions on their home world of Pabaq. Despite their physical vulnerability, osharus protect themselves from the planet's dangers through their rigorous devotion to continual scientific and magical advancement. Osharus find higher purpose and meaning in the pursuit of knowledge.

If you want to play a character who's studious, cautious, and curious, you should play an osharu.

You Might...

  • Feel pulled between a sense of caution and scientific curiosity.

  • See science and religion as two complementary methods to understanding the universe better.

  • Devote yourself to deep academic knowledge in your field of study.

Others Probably...

  • Treat you like you're scared of everything you encounter.

  • Come to you for scientific or religious advice.

  • Expect you to be an expert on any scholarly matter.

Physical Description

Osharus stand around 4 feet tall and weigh around 140 pounds. As invertebrates, they're physically frail. Most osharus act with caution and are risk-averse in physical situations. Their sensitive soft tissues desiccate quickly in extreme heat or direct sunlight, so their cities contain many precautionary amenities, such as shaded canopies and street misters. They vary in their responses to salt; inland osharus frequently have some degree of withering salt allergy, but ocean-dwelling gengen osharus are completely immune to it.

Genetically, osharus are thousands of different species that are capable of fully hybridizing. Due to incredibly dense genetic drift over time, the color and adornment of osharu parents have no seeming connection to their children's appearance. Many osharus become fascinated with other species' hereditarily predictable traits, making xenogenetics and biotechnology some of the most popular courses of study for osharus. While their bioaugmentation practices are galaxy-renowned for their cleanliness and ethicality, osharus hesitate when considering implants themselves, taking exceptional time to investigate all potential side effects before coming to a decision.

Society

Osharu culture is steeped in the tension between their physical fragility and life on an unforgiving planet. Osharus initially evolved to survive the jungles of Jenikar, or in the case of the gengen osharus, the seawaters and beaches of the island continent of Zhast. Their pious university-cities dot these main continents and their coasts, each with its own academic departments and specialties. Much of their technological and thaumaturgical work directly supports the defense and support of these campus communities, such as developing upgrades to pacification drone fleets or optimizing the ubiquitous technomagical force bubbles surrounding most osharu cities. New development on the planet has primarily occurred on Rawara's rolling plains. There, small outposts monitor the migratory herds of burrowing reptiles indigenous to the area and support expeditions into the jagged peaks of the continent's interior. Such expeditions require heavy arms and armor to defend against the gigantic raptors that nest in the peaks and the swarms of hive scavengers that live off their scraps. The northern and southern ice caps, Nalfant and Avar, are home to small far-flung stations researching the polar environment and the deep networks of underwater caves that riddle the ocean floor. The arid deserts of Demwiq have been largely unexplored due to the dry heat's particularly deadly effect on osharus, but the city of Oasis has seen steady growth as archaeologists recruit less heat-averse species to undertake expeditions of discovery into the wind-blasted sands and the mysteries buried beneath.

Archaeological academics posit that ancient osharus survived their planet's dangerous environs through communal cooperation that allowed for advanced magical and scientific breakthroughs. According to pre-Gap records, the capital city of Jhavom was founded after a hermit traveled from the Deepmarsh to the jungles to deliver an experimental proposal given by Yaraesa to him in a vision: the unification of local clans into a community, with each clan's specialty shoring up another clan's weakness. The resulting city has remained the undisputed center of osharu academics and religion for millennia, its modern skyscrapers and spaceports rising between the stone temples and ancient aqueducts of yore.

Jhavom, and thus osharu culture, is currently experiencing both a renaissance and a culture shock after the arrival of Drift lanes over Pabaq. The Drift lane also brought newfound proximity to Swarm space, and the constant background threat of war has been thrown over the normally peaceful planet as warships gather and soldiers enlist.

For all the cosmopolitan charms of osharus' mystically scientific hubs of learning and culture, they're surprisingly divisive in terms of cuisine. The hermits of the deepest marshes subsist by eating nearly any organic matter they find, and even the most urbane city osharu has tastes to make most species nauseous. Offworlders often comment on the lack of salt and deeply fermented flavors, and a rare gourmand might be brave enough to try the highly nutritious but deeply unappetizing mold mix that most osharu households grow on kitchen scraps. Osharus don't hunt for meat, but have no compunctions about eating found carrion or raising small insect and vermin swarms as livestock. Pabaq's vegetarian cuisine has shown more success on the intergalactic stage, for the lush jungles and fertile seas provide agribusiness researchers a bounty of fresh fruit and vegetable options to innovate with and export. Many osharus traveling offworld find the process of discovering new edible flora to be a delight for both the senses and the mind.

Sample Names

Aburna, Bolvuro, Jom Yare, Narna Basse, Omsa Degum, Naspatu, Regumo

Beliefs

Osharu culture is deeply intertwined with the Yaraesan faith, with many osharus perforating the line between ecclesiastics and academics. Osharus view the sharing of knowledge as a moral and spiritual imperative and send explorers, scholars, and emissaries out into the wider universe to conduct fieldwork and exchange knowledge, though their cautious nature causes them to constantly be on guard against exploitation or danger when dealing with other species. Osharus are valued across the Pact Worlds and beyond as diplomats and negotiators; many peace talks have found surprising fire emerge from osharu speakers when they sense an opportunity to protect innovative or historical discoveries from the depravities of war.

The osharu deity Jalvari, goddess of disproved hypotheses and experiments, accidentally apotheosized through an experiment she can't replicate and is an unofficial herald of Yaraesa. Her faith provides a complementary viewpoint that even the most thoroughly believed hypothesis can be proven wrong but still enlighten and uplift the scholar who's prepared to be surprised. While worship of Jalvari remains limited to faith-minded scientists, many osharus incorporate elements of her teachings to help them overcome their fear of failure's consequences and instead embrace failure's role in progress. The secret knowledge of Eloritu attracts some osharus, but they might find their communal nature at odds with the burdens of secrecy. Those who do delve too far into dangerous knowledge could find themselves subject to investigation by the Informational Security Bureau, a branch of Jhavom's Yaraesan Glory In Knowledge Museum and Pabaq's highest intelligence organization.

Popular Edicts

cooperate for mutual benefit, discover the galaxy's knowledge, understand things to their fullest

Popular Anathema

jump to uninformed conclusions, pursue an unexamined life

Osharu Mechanics

Hit Points 6

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Intelligence, Wisdom, Free

Attribute Flaw Constitution

Languages Common, Osharu

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • humanoid

  • osharu

Senses Darkvision

Slime Squirt

pages.content:
奥沙鲁人深深敬重科学方法与智慧的获取，这种精神贯穿其大学城的每个方面。这些城市最初是为了躲避母星帕巴克的恶劣环境而建。奥沙鲁人虽然身体脆弱，却以严谨态度持续推动科学与魔法进步，借此保护自己免受行星危险的侵害。他们在追求知识中找到更高的目标与意义。

如果你希望扮演一个勤学、谨慎又好奇的角色，就应该选择奥沙鲁人。

你可能……

  • 在谨慎心理与科学好奇心之间左右为难。

  • 将科学与宗教视为两种相辅相成、能更好理解宇宙的方法。

  • 致力于深耕自己研究领域的学术知识。

他人可能……

  • 觉得你对遇到的一切都害怕。

  • 向你寻求科学或宗教方面的建议。

  • 指望你精通一切学术问题。

外貌描述

奥沙鲁人身高约4尺，体重约140磅。作为无脊椎动物，他们的身体很脆弱。大多数奥沙鲁人行事谨慎，在涉及身体安全时不愿冒险。他们敏感的软组织在酷热或直射阳光下会迅速干燥，因此城市中设有许多防护设施，例如遮阳棚和街道喷雾器。他们对盐的反应各不相同：内陆奥沙鲁人常不同程度地对盐过敏，接触后会萎缩；生活在海洋中的根根奥沙鲁人则完全不受影响。

从遗传学上看，奥沙鲁人其实是数千个能够完全杂交的不同物种。由于漫长岁月中极其密集的遗传漂变，父母的颜色和体表装饰性结构，与子女的外貌似乎毫无关联。许多奥沙鲁人对其他种族可预测的遗传特征十分着迷，因此异星遗传学和生物工程是他们最受欢迎的研究领域之一。虽然奥沙鲁人的生物殖装技术以洁净和符合伦理而享誉银河，他们自己考虑植入物时却颇为犹豫，会花费格外漫长的时间调查一切潜在副作用，然后才做决定。

社会

奥沙鲁文化深受自身身体脆弱与行星环境严酷之间矛盾的影响。奥沙鲁人最初演化出适应杰尼卡尔丛林的能力，根根奥沙鲁人则适应了扎斯特岛大陆的海水与沙滩。他们虔敬的大学城散布在这些主要大陆及海岸，每座都有自己的学术部门和专长。其科技与魔法研究大多直接服务于这些校园社群的防护与维系，例如改良镇暴无人机群，或优化大多数奥沙鲁城市周围普遍存在的科技魔法力场泡。行星上的新开发主要发生在拉瓦拉起伏的平原上。那里的小型前哨站监测本地穴居爬行动物的迁徙兽群，并为深入大陆内地嶙峋山峰的探险队提供支援。这类探险需要重型武器和护甲，以防御在峰顶筑巢的巨型猛禽，以及靠其残食为生、成群结巢的食腐生物。北方与南方的冰盖纳尔凡特和阿瓦尔，分布着彼此远隔的小型站点，研究极地环境及遍布海底的深邃水下洞穴网络。干热对奥沙鲁人格外致命，德姆维克的干旱沙漠因此大多未经探索；不过，绿洲城一直稳步发展，因为考古学家会招募不那么畏热的种族，深入风沙侵蚀的荒漠，探索埋藏在沙下的奥秘。

考古学者认为，古代奥沙鲁人依靠共同协作，在行星的危险环境中生存下来，并因此取得先进的魔法与科学突破。根据大断层前的记载，一位隐士曾从深沼来到丛林，带来亚莱纱在异象中赐予他的实验提案：将当地氏族联合为一个社群，各氏族以自身专长弥补其他氏族的弱点。首都贾沃姆便由此建立。数千年来，这座城市始终是公认的奥沙鲁学术与宗教中心；如今，摩天大楼与太空港耸立于往昔的石砌神庙和古老引水渠之间。

自漂流域航道出现在帕巴克上空之后，贾沃姆乃至整个奥沙鲁文化，正同时经历复兴与文化冲击。漂流域航道也拉近了这里与虫群疆域的距离。随着战舰集结、士兵应征，持续的战争威胁笼罩了这颗通常和平的行星。

尽管奥沙鲁人兼具神秘与科学色彩的学术文化中心富有国际都市的魅力，其饮食却令人意外地褒贬两极。最深沼泽里的隐士几乎以找到的任何有机物为食，即使最文雅的城市奥沙鲁人，其口味也足以令大多数种族反胃。外星来客常提到他们的食物缺乏盐分、发酵风味浓重；极少数勇敢的美食家，或许会尝试那种营养丰富却极不讨喜的混合霉菌，大多数奥沙鲁家庭都用厨余培养它。奥沙鲁人不猎杀动物取肉，却不介意食用捡到的腐肉，也会将小型昆虫和害兽群作为家畜饲养。帕巴克的素食在跨星系舞台上更受欢迎，因为繁茂丛林与丰饶海洋，为农业企业的研究者提供了大量新鲜果蔬，供其创新和出口。许多远赴外星的奥沙鲁人觉得，发现新的可食用植物，既是感官享受，也是心智的乐趣。

示例姓名

Aburna、Bolvuro、Jom Yare、Narna Basse、Omsa Degum、Naspatu、Regumo

信仰

奥沙鲁文化与亚莱纱信仰紧密交织，许多奥沙鲁人打破了神职与学术之间的界线。他们将分享知识视为道德与精神上的责任，派出探索者、学者和使节前往更广阔的宇宙，进行实地研究、交流知识；但谨慎的天性也令他们在与其他种族打交道时，始终提防遭人利用或遇到危险。在盟约诸界乃至更远的地方，奥沙鲁人都是备受重视的外交官与谈判者。许多和平谈判中，当他们察觉到保护创新成果或历史发现、使其免遭战争暴行破坏的机会时，奥沙鲁发言者都会展现令人意外的热忱。

奥沙鲁神祇贾尔瓦里是遭证伪假说与实验的女神。她通过一场自己无法复现的实验意外成神，也是亚莱纱的非正式神使。她的信仰提供了一种互补观点：即便最深信不疑的假说也可能被证明错误，却仍能启迪并提升愿意迎接意外的学者。虽然崇拜贾尔瓦里的人仍限于有信仰的科学家，许多奥沙鲁人也会吸取其教义，帮助自己克服对失败后果的恐惧，转而接受失败在进步中所起的作用。伊洛里图的秘密知识吸引了一些奥沙鲁人，但他们可能发现自身崇尚协作的天性，与保守秘密的负担相冲突。那些过度深究危险知识的人，可能受到信息安全局调查；该局隶属贾沃姆的亚莱纱知识荣光博物馆，也是帕巴克最高的情报机构。

常见典范

互助合作，发掘银河的知识，彻底理解事物

常见禁忌

在信息不足时贸然下结论，过不加省察的生活

奥沙鲁人规则数据

体型 中型

属性缺陷 体质

Worlanisis are intrinsically connected to luck, both bad and good. Traditionally, worlanisis leveraged their natural luck on meandering trips through the archipelagos of their native Worlan. In modern times, several populations of worlanisis dwell on other home worlds, notably the Vault of Vorlath, where they underwent paramilitary training and medical experimentation to become compact-sized super soldiers. Each worlanisi bears horn-cones on either side of their head that serve as conduits for their psychic powers, but the open nature of this amplification leaves their owners uniquely vulnerable to incoming psychic attacks. In the modern era, these horn-cones grant worlanisis only limited telepathic abilities, in contrast to their ancestors who once wielded immense psychic might. These wandering hunters have slowly reduced their dependence on these psychic abilities and instead have begun to favor their most unique innate power—the ability to wield the force of luck itself.

Many worlanisi adventurers have redirected their years-long pilgrimages into the stars. Called fortunauts because of their inherent ability to manipulate luck, worlanisi pilgrims have become a common sight on mercenary squads and starship crews, where they serve as living good luck charms. Their rare powers have made them highly sought-after adventurers and passengers for crews heading into danger.

If you want to play a character who takes impossible chances and survives by sheer luck, has a natural love of competition, and loves to entertain, you should play a worlanisi.

You Might...

  • Believe your innate luck will get you out of even the most perilous of situations.

  • Seek competition based on skill and prowess alone—never chance.

  • Fear or distrust others with psychic abilities.

Others Probably...

  • Envy your free-spirited nature.

  • Refuse to play any game of chance against you.

  • Come to you for stories of your adventures.

Physical Description

Worlanisis are small, wiry four-armed people. The vast majority of them stand less than three and a half feet tall, and their average weight ranges between 22 and 27 pounds. Though diminutive, these people are deceptively strong, and they often become excellent climbers and accomplished athletes. They have blue skin in varying hues, sometimes with subtle stripe patterns.

Worlanisis evolved on an ocean planet filled with traces of residual psychic energy. In response to this stimulus, they developed a unique set of horn- cones on the sides of their head—features that amplify incoming and outgoing psychic signals. In ancient times, worlanisi horn-cones were much larger and more powerful than they are today and were used by hunters to track psychic reverberations left behind by prey. This ability gave the diminutive people an enormous competitive advantage.

Over time, worlanisis' natural connection to the primordial forces of luck began to take precedence over their psychic abilities in their struggle for survival as they adopted advanced technology that largely replaced their reliance on psychic tracking. As a result, their horn-cones have shrunk and atrophied over generations, leaving their psychic abilities greatly diminished. These unique organs still function as psychic amplifiers, though, leaving worlanisis with a painful weakness to mental attacks. Some among their number have sought to recapture the greater psychic control of their ancestors, with varying levels of success.

In tunnels beneath Worlan's volcanic islands, small pockets of the worlanisi population evolved in drastically divergent ways. Their horn-cones atrophied earlier and are smaller now as a result, but their bodies grew larger and heartier in response to the environmental stresses of their underground world. These worlanisis, known as the luckless (though this term is a misnomer), average close to five feet in height and weigh more than 100 pounds.

Unfortunately, worlanisi traits also made them a target for unethical biotech companies. When worlanisi pilgrims landed on the Prelurian orbital, they were overpowered by scientists from the Reivolan Institute, bodiless biohackers who placed them in forced stasis, sampled their organic tissues, and cloned entire armies from a single individual's DNA.

After generations of experimentation, a group of worlanisis won control of the lab facility they were being held in at the Vault of Vorlath and took over, launching a formidable mercenary organization that gradually took over their former captors' holdings in the Preluria system. Today, the Vorlathi worlanisis operate a lucrative mercenary racket with clients as far away as the Pact Worlds.

Society

Worlan dwellers are peaceable peoples who believe in travel as a means of personal betterment. As they encounter other cultures, worlanisis are quick to adopt their favorite practices and bring them back to Worlan, though they reject customs they view as shortsighted or self-destructive, especially practices that lead to environmental destruction for short-term gains.

Different subcultures of worlanisi society emphasize their telepathic abilities to different degrees. Many smaller groups view telepathic communication as much more intimate and practical than verbal speech, and they rely largely on this silent means of conversation. Telepathy, after all, can allow a boat crew to speak no matter how loud the storm around them is and can help hunters approach prey without revealing their locations. Some groups emphasize the spoken word more heavily, but for the most part, worlanisis reserve its use for formal occasions, for musical and theatrical performances, or for the benefit of visitors to their culture.

Worlan is governed by a series of elected councils with strict term limits and staggered terms. Worlanisi politicians are expected to work for the betterment of their island, or the planet as a whole, without considering their prospects for future elections. This system doesn't completely prevent corruption and incompetence, as some families try to monopolize a council position by offering various relatives as successive candidates. For the most part, these shenanigans are only tolerated as long as the family does good work. If their protection of private interests ever creates a crisis, it isn't unheard of for corrupt political officials to suffer unlucky accidents on the job.

Worlanisis love games and competitions of all sorts, especially ones that offset or minimize the role of luck. A favorite on Worlan is a strategy-heavy game called seven suns. Sport on Worlan is similarly skill-based, and numerous competitions fill the calendar of the planet, culminating in Fortune's Regatta, a race across the entire planet that purposefully takes competitors through the worst weather and terrain Worlan has to offer. This competition draws tens of thousands of spectators and athletes from many other worlds every year. In truth, worlanisis who aren't competing tend to have little interest in the contest, believing that success in such a race greatly relies on chance and thus can't be a true competition. Worlan also hosts a casino called the Short Straw for the benefit of offworlders who wish to try their luck against the luckiest of them all. Tourists come expecting to lose, but those who manage to hold their own against the odds gain truly prized bragging rights.

Worlanisis usually have two names: a descriptive nickname earned in life and reflective of their experiences, skills, or personality, and a last name from their island or place of birth.

Sample Names

Baruzi of Vorlath, Drift-Rider of Bullama, Emuni of Worlan, Hanuli of Absalom, Jump-the-Flow of the River Between, Nurul of Nowhere, Plasters of Pulonis, Vorlathi Quickjump, Sazula In Exile, Zigzag from Verces

Beliefs

Traditional worlanisi society venerates the power of luck above all other things, and most worlanisis credit the power of luck for nearly every major event in their lives. Based on this principle, worlanisis form easygoing, trusting communities where most good outcomes are evidence of the people's luck, and tragedy and struggle are viewed as hard blessings in disguise. Many worlanisis are superstitious and practice good luck rituals.

Even the relatively cutthroat worlanisis of Vorlath, many of whom deny luck's sway over their lives, participate in rituals and craft charms carried into battle that clearly rely on the principle of luck or grace.

Worlanisis have a relatively short history of contact with the Pact Worlds, only dating back about two decades, as first contact occurred around the time when the Vorlathi faction broke free from the Reivolan Institute. Nevertheless, every worlanisi steadfastly believes that their people were the first to create the infinity deck, a commonly reproduced relic used to play dozens of different games across the galaxy.

Most worlanisis aren't religious but do practice spiritual beliefs, study philosophy, or conduct superstitious rituals personalized to suit their lifestyles.

Given her relationship with luck and her promotion of travel, Desna is the single most popular deity among worlanisis, but she's far from the only target of worship. Weydan holds the affection of many fortunauts, for they tend to sign on to research missions and journeys designed to discover new and interesting things just as often as they travel for travel's sake. Those who follow the Vorlathi faction, however, have reduced their reliance on luck and often venerate Damoritosh over all others.

Popular Edicts

have faith in people, nurture your luck like you would a muscle, trust that things will work out

Popular Anathema

cheat in a contest of chance, cheat in a contest of skill, prepare a contingency for bad luck

Worlanisi Mechanics

Size Small

Speed 20 Feet

Attribute Boosts Strength, Charisma, Free

Attribute Flaw Wisdom

Languages Common, Worlanisi

Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • worlanisi

沃拉尼西人与好运、坏运都有天生的联系。传统上，他们凭借自然的好运，在母星沃兰的群岛间漫游。现代已有数群沃拉尼西人生活在其他家园世界，最著名的是沃拉斯秘库；他们在那里接受准军事训练与医学实验，被塑造成体型小巧的超级士兵。每位沃拉尼西人的头部两侧都有角锥，作为心灵力量的导管；但这种开放式放大结构，也令主人格外容易受到外来的心灵攻击。现代沃拉尼西人的角锥只赋予有限的心灵感应能力，不比曾拥有庞大心灵力量的祖先。这些漫游猎人慢慢减少了对心灵能力的依赖，转而偏爱最独特的天生力量：直接运用运气本身。

许多沃拉尼西冒险者将持续多年的朝圣之旅转向群星。由于天生能操纵运气，这些朝圣者被称为幸运旅者；在佣兵小队与星舰船员中，他们已成为常见的活幸运符。其罕见力量，也让即将深入险境的船员争相招募他们作为冒险伙伴或乘客。

如果你希望扮演一个敢于冒不可能之险、仅凭好运生还，天生热爱竞争又喜欢娱乐他人的角色，就应该选择沃拉尼西人。

你可能……

  • 相信天生的好运能让自己脱离最危险的局面。

  • 追求只靠技巧和实力、绝不靠运气的竞争。

  • 畏惧或不信任其他拥有心灵能力的人。

他人可能……

  • 羡慕你自由自在的天性。

  • 拒绝与你进行任何拼运气的游戏。

  • 来听你讲述冒险故事。

外貌描述

沃拉尼西人体型小巧，结实精瘦，长着四条手臂。绝大多数身高不足3尺半，平均体重在22至27磅之间。他们虽小，力量却远超外表所示，常成为优秀的攀爬者和出色的运动员。他们的蓝色皮肤深浅不一，有时带有隐约条纹。

沃拉尼西人在残余心灵能量遍布的海洋行星上演化。为了回应这种刺激，他们在头部两侧长出独特的角锥，能够放大传入与传出的心灵信号。古时，角锥远比今天庞大有力，猎人可藉此追踪猎物留下的心灵回响，为这个娇小族群带来极大的竞争优势。

随着他们采用先进科技，大幅取代对心灵追踪的依赖，在生存竞争中，与原初运气力量的天然联系便逐渐压过心灵能力。因此，他们的角锥代代缩小、萎缩，心灵能力也大幅减退。不过，这些独特器官仍会放大心灵信号，令沃拉尼西人对心灵攻击有着痛苦的弱点。有些族人试图重获祖先更强的心灵掌控力，成效各不相同。

在沃兰火山岛地下的隧道中，少数沃拉尼西群体走上了截然不同的演化道路。他们的角锥更早萎缩，如今也更小；身体却为适应地下环境的压力而变得更高大强健。这些沃拉尼西人被称为“无运者”，尽管这只是个误称。他们平均身高接近5尺，体重超过100磅。

不幸的是，沃拉尼西人的特征也让他们成了不道德生物工程企业的目标。朝圣者降落在普雷卢里亚轨道设施时，被雷沃兰研究所的科学家制服。这些没有肉身的生物骇客，强迫他们陷入静滞，采集有机组织，再以单一个体的DNA克隆出整支军队。

经过数代实验后，一群沃拉尼西人夺取了位于沃拉斯秘库、用于囚禁他们的实验设施。他们接管设施，建立强大的佣兵组织，逐步吞并昔日俘虏者在普雷卢里亚星系的资产。如今，沃拉斯沃拉尼西人经营利润丰厚的佣兵生意，客户远至盟约诸界。

社会

沃兰居民爱好和平，相信旅行能提升自我。遇到其他文化时，沃拉尼西人很快便会采纳喜爱的习俗，带回沃兰，但会拒绝在他们看来短视或自毁的习俗，尤其是为短期收益破坏环境的做法。

沃拉尼西社会的不同亚文化，对心灵感应能力的重视程度各异。许多小群体认为，心灵交流比言语更亲密实用，因此主要依靠无声交谈。毕竟，无论周围风暴多吵，船员都能通过心灵感应交谈，猎人也能借此接近猎物而不暴露位置。有些群体更重视口语，但总体而言，沃拉尼西人将其留给正式场合、音乐与戏剧表演，或为了方便来访的外族。

沃兰由一系列民选议会治理，任期有严格限制，并错开交替。人们期望政客为岛屿或整颗行星谋福，而非盘算未来选举前景。这并不能彻底杜绝腐败和无能，因为有些家族会让不同亲属接连参选，试图垄断议席。大体而言，只有家族确实做得不错时，这些花招才会被容忍。若维护私利造成危机，腐败官员在工作中遭遇不幸事故，也并非闻所未闻。

沃拉尼西人喜欢各种游戏和竞赛，尤其偏爱抵消或尽量降低运气作用的项目。沃兰流行一种重策略的游戏，称为“七阳”。当地体育也以技巧为本，各种赛事排满全年，最终迎来幸运帆船赛：这场环绕整颗行星的比赛，会刻意让参赛者穿越沃兰最恶劣的天气和地形。每年，它吸引来自许多其他世界、总计数万名的观众与运动员。事实上，不参赛的沃拉尼西人往往兴趣不大，因为他们觉得这类比赛很靠运气，因此算不上真正的竞争。沃兰还设有短签赌场，方便外星来客与最幸运的族群一较运气。游客来时本已做好输的准备，但若能顶住不利胜算、与对手抗衡，就能得到真正值得夸耀的资本。

沃拉尼西人通常有两个名字：一个是在人生中获得、反映经历、技艺或个性的描述性昵称，另一个是取自出生岛屿或地点的姓。

示例姓名

沃拉斯的Baruzi（Baruzi of Vorlath）、布拉马的漂流域骑手（Drift-Rider of Bullama）、沃兰的Emuni（Emuni of Worlan）、艾巴萨罗姆的Hanuli（Hanuli of Absalom）、间河的跃流者（Jump-the-Flow of the River Between）、无乡的Nurul（Nurul of Nowhere）、普洛尼斯的补丁（Plasters of Pulonis）、沃拉斯的快跃（Vorlathi Quickjump）、流亡中的Sazula（Sazula In Exile）、威瑟斯的之字行者（Zigzag from Verces）

信仰

传统沃拉尼西社会最为尊崇运气的力量，大多数人将几乎所有人生大事都归功于它。以此为基础，他们组成随和、互相信任的社群，将多数好结果视为族群好运的证据，把悲剧与奋斗视为披着苦难外衣的祝福。许多沃拉尼西人迷信，会进行祈求好运的仪式。

就连相对冷酷的沃拉斯沃拉尼西人，许多人虽否认运气对生活的影响，也仍参与仪式，制作带入战场的护符；这些做法显然仰赖运气或恩宠的原则。

沃拉尼西人与盟约诸界接触的历史相对短暂，仅约二十年；首次接触大致发生在沃拉斯派系摆脱雷沃兰研究所的时期。尽管如此，每位沃拉尼西人都坚定相信，无限牌组最初由自己的族群创造。这种遗物的复制品十分常见，银河各处用它游玩数十种不同游戏。

大多数沃拉尼西人不信奉宗教，却会实践精神信仰、研究哲学，或进行为自身生活方式量身打造的迷信仪式。

黛丝娜与运气的联系，以及对旅行的提倡，使她成为沃拉尼西人最受欢迎的神祇，但绝非唯一的崇拜对象。韦丹深受许多幸运旅者喜爱，因为他们既常纯粹为了旅行而出发，也同样常参加研究任务，以及旨在发现新奇事物的旅程。不过，追随沃拉斯派系的人已减少对运气的依赖，往往最为敬拜戴莫力图斯。

常见典范

相信他人，像锻炼肌肉一样培育好运，相信事情终会好起来

常见禁忌

在拼运气的竞赛中作弊，在技巧竞赛中作弊，为坏运气准备后备方案

pages.name: 泛用传承
pages.expectedContent:
Versatile heritages help realize characters with special physiological or spiritual manifestations beyond what can be expressed using backgrounds and heritages. To play a character with a versatile heritage, first select your ancestry, just like you would for any character. You gain Hit Points, size, Speed, attribute boosts and attribute flaws, languages, traits, and other abilities from that ancestry. Then, instead of choosing a heritage from those normally available to that ancestry, apply your chosen versatile heritage. You gain all the features from your versatile heritage, some of which might modify or replace statistics, abilities, or traits from your ancestry.

泛用传承有助于呈现具有特殊生理或灵性表现的角色，这些特点超出了背景和传承所能表达的范围。要扮演拥有泛用传承的角色，先像创建任何角色一样选择族裔。你从该族裔获得生命值、体型、速度、属性提升与属性缺陷、语言、特征及其他能力。然后，不选择该族裔通常可用的传承，而是应用所选的泛用传承。你获得泛用传承的全部特点，其中部分可能会修改或替代族裔的数据、能力或特征。

pages.name: 拾荒蜗族
pages.expectedContent:
Known as “collectors” in their own language, gnarefuroids are intelligent aberrations who have adapted to survive in harsh climates with scarce nourishment. They began as denizens of landfills, feeding on chemical runoff and dissolved synthetics while jury-rigging shells from more durable trash. Humanoid scrappers mostly left them alone, dismissing them as symbiotic bottom feeders until xenobiologists recognized the gnarefuroids' sophisticated culture rooted in turning waste into resources. By then, several gnarefuroid colonies had already traversed the stars by discreetly attaching to the hulls of starships, spending years coexisting alongside other cultures almost completely undetected. Absalom Station has one of the largest gnarefuroid populations in the Pact Worlds clinging to Botscrap's exterior.

If you want to play an alien character who celebrates life's little joys in an utterly bizarre fashion, you should play a gnarefuroid.

You Might...

  • Be wary of strangers until you share a meal with them.

  • Value unusual smells, flavors, and textures as precious treasures.

  • Collect discarded items that might be useful later.

Others Probably...

  • Assume you grew up in a dump or stuck to a space station.

  • Only appreciate your culture and habits from a distance.

  • Get squeamish about your preferred foods or living spaces.

Physical Description

Gnarefuroids have bulbous, cartilaginous bodies resembling mushroom caps that sit atop a muscular snaillike appendage used for locomotion. Their outer skin constantly secretes a sticky resin that prevents infection and decompression in a vacuum, begins predigestion of food, and assists with adhering to surfaces. Pores in their body allow access for their cirrisensors: prehensile tentacles fitted with specialized organs for seeing, smelling, tasting, hearing, and speaking as well as reading chemical or electrical impulses for more sensitive specimens. Each gnarefuroid has two longer feather-like tendrils with numerous dexterous digits that function as arms and hands.

Gnarefuroids' bodies are soft and sensitive to touch, so they frequently attach objects from their environment to themselves as protection the way certain crustaceans don shells. Most gnarefuroids spawn in material-rich locations like junkyards, so their shells are often composed of mismatched slabs of scrap cobbled together into a haphazard mass of metal and plastic. Gnarefuroids from other environments might build shells from wood, bone, rock, or any other substances they can find. Their resin coating allows them to plaster themselves in lighter debris such as sand, glass, or mulch, filling the cracks between their shells' disparate pieces.

Each gnarefuroid is an autonomous polyp from a much larger organism called a gigafuroid, or “home mother” in their language. Gigafuroids are apex forms of scavenging life, constructing elaborate armor from discarded machinery and slithering across their domains like landslides. Being solitary creatures, gigafuroids produce gnarefuroids to propagate their species across vast distances. The gigafuroid spawns gnarefuroids by budding their own organic and cognitive matter, sending their progeny to experience new tastes and sensations inaccessible to their gargantuan form. When multiple gnarefuroids from different origins meet, they can merge into a new gigafuroid to renew their life cycle.

Gnarefuroids' stomachs can derive sustenance from almost anything, an adaptation from generations of living in landfills. The longer gnarefuroids live in cleaner environments, however, the more their ability to feed on refuse deteriorates. Despite their omnivorous diets, gnarefuroids are highly sensitive to taste, cultivating intensely specific palates of preferred flavors and fragrances.

Society

Gnarefuroids claim they can trace their ancestry back to aberrant species that inhabited sewers on Lost Golarion. Their prevalence in the trash processing units on Absalom Station combined with their instinctive ability to navigate technological infrastructure suggests a longstanding familiarity with urban survival that makes their story plausible. Unlike other species linked to the vanished planet, gnarefuroids harbor little interest in their forgotten past, placing far greater emphasis on the present. After all, interstellar travel allowed them to connect and reproduce with extraterrestrial gnarefuroids that evolved parallel to the ones native to Absalom Station, making the current age an era of discovery and expansion for their kind.

Many gnarefuroids lean toward insularity, preferring to keep their own company. Gnarefuroid siblings share curiosities and exchange delicacies in their tight-knit family groups, where the gigafuroid acts as one part parent, one part information hub, and one part community center. The aberrations avoid outsiders unless approached with offers of new flavors or encouraged by their kin to explore.

Gnarefuroids' reticence stems from generations of suffering other intelligent creatures' distaste for their appearance, tastes, and habitats. They were shunned as garbage-dwelling monsters since before the Gap, a sentiment retained by most laypeople. Ysoki were among the first to recognize gnarefuroids' complexity and open communications, earning them special status in gnarefuroid society. Goblins, with their a mainstream cultural appreciation for junk, are also quick to accept gnarefuroids among their communities in Botscrap. Gnarefuroids usually get along with astrazoans and other aberrations, who are more likely to appreciate their odd perspectives and aesthetics. Although many cultures still view gnarefuroids' habits with disgust, individual gnarefuroids who prove useful, benevolent, or hygienic can earn acceptance among other species.

Taste drives most of gnarefuroid culture. Gnarefuroids rate novel and nuanced flavors as life's highest delicacies, devotedly seeking out flavors to share with their closest companions. Their language has more words for flavors and scents than for colors and shapes. Even siblings spawned from the same gigafuroid have dramatically disparate individual preferences for flavors. Their unique tastes often extend into aesthetics and style, for they externalize their distinct preferences by building shells that serve as collages of their favorite colored, shaped, textured, and flavored scrap.

Gnarefuroids speak a language that shares numerous root words with Aklo but diverges in many ways from any other living language. The quickly evolving language lacks set pronunciation, meaning everything from the name of their species to individual names are open to interpretation.

Their sensory acuity also informs gnarefuroids' naming conventions. Each gnarefuroid spends their first few months of life discovering their preferred tastes, sounds, and textures of words so they can assemble their name. Such names blend syllables from favorite flavors and brands of favorite scrap products with syllables a gnarefuroid finds pleasant to hear or say, sometimes including musical inflections or sounds only replicable by cirrisensors. Their reproductive cycle makes gendering irrelevant, so each gnarefuroid simply chooses the pronouns they find most aesthetically stimulating. Many enjoy “silent” letters that subtly change pronunciation.

Sample Names

Abardoeng, Dysktypowary, Fvinbinbonbum, Inphoivym, MyroOoal, Nzillif, Swaltyum, UafoHVORrtini.

Beliefs

Gnarefuroids tend to focus on what's right in front of them, forgetting the past and planning their futures as far as they need to safely enjoy the present. They strive to lead lives of comfort and stimulation through food, art, and craftsmanship. They default to sedentary lifestyles, but they might be spurred to adventuring by discomforting changes to their habitats, cravings for new flavors, responsibility to reproduce with distant colonies, or accrued boredom. While some specimens find actualization in a higher purpose, such as religion, ambition, or national identity, most prefer homeostasis.

Most gnarefuroids think of divine will as just another natural force, paying as much attention to deities as they do to the weather or to the orbit of their planet or satellite. Those who do find religion are often inspired by Hylax's community spirit, Zon-Shelyn's attention to sensation and expression, Oras's celebration of adapting and evolving, or Urgathoa's indulgent hedonism. Mystical gnarefuroids who discover natural environments that turn waste into resources sometimes follow the Green Faith, the Cycle, or other primordial traditions as they embrace more primal and abstract cycles of life.

Popular Edicts

celebrate your unique interests, enjoy life's little pleasures, make the most of what comes your way, mind your own business, prioritize comfort and safety

Popular Anathema

be exactly like everyone else, discard things that still have use, hoard treasures without using them, prioritize ambition over practical comfort, refuse new sensory experiences

Gnarefuroid Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Small

Speed 20 Feet, Climb 15 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

Languages Aklo, Common, Gnarefuroid

Additional languages Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • rare

  • aberration

  • cosmic

  • gnarefuroid

Senses Low-Light Vision

拾荒蜗族在自己的语言中称为“收集者”，是适应了恶劣气候和匮乏营养的智慧异怪。他们最初栖居垃圾填埋场，以化学径流和溶解的合成材料为食，同时用较耐久的废物拼装外壳。类人拾荒者大多不理会他们，只将其视为共生的底栖食腐者，直到异星生物学家发现，拾荒蜗族拥有以变废为宝为根基的复杂文化。那时，已有数个族群悄悄依附星舰船壳，穿越群星，多年来与其他文化共同生活，几乎完全不为人察觉。艾巴萨罗姆空间站有盟约诸界最大的拾荒蜗族群之一，依附在废铁场的外壁上。

如果你希望扮演一个以极其怪异的方式，庆祝生活中小小喜悦的异星角色，就应该选择拾荒蜗族。

你可能……

  • 在与陌生人共餐之前保持警惕。

  • 将不同寻常的气味、风味和质地视为珍宝。

  • 收集可能在日后派上用场的废弃物。

他人可能……

  • 以为你在垃圾堆长大，或依附在空间站上。

  • 只愿远远欣赏你的文化与习惯。

  • 对你偏爱的食物或居所感到恶心。

外貌描述

拾荒蜗族的身体膨圆、呈软骨质，形似蘑菇菌盖，下方是肌肉发达、用于移动的蜗牛状附肢。外皮不断分泌黏性树脂，防止感染与真空减压，预先消化食物，并辅助附着表面。体表孔洞供感应纤须伸出：这些抓握触手配备视觉、嗅觉、味觉、听觉和发声的特化器官，较敏感的个体还能读取化学或电脉冲。每位拾荒蜗族都有两条较长、羽毛状的触须，上面有许多灵巧的指状结构，充当手臂与双手。

拾荒蜗族身体柔软，对触碰敏感，因此常将环境中的物品附着在身上防护，如同某些甲壳动物披上外壳。大多数拾荒蜗族诞生于废料场等材料丰富的地方，因此常用不相配的废料板拼装外壳，凑成杂乱的金属塑料团。其他环境出身者，则可能使用木头、骨骼、岩石或任何能找到的物质。树脂涂层让他们能够将沙、玻璃或覆盖碎料等较轻碎屑糊在身上，填补外壳各部件间的裂隙。

每位拾荒蜗族，都是更庞大生物“拾荒巨蜗”上的自主子体；在其语言中，后者又称“家园母亲”。拾荒巨蜗是食腐生命的顶级形态，用废弃机械搭建复杂护甲，像山崩般滑行于自己的领地。拾荒巨蜗独自生活，因此产生拾荒蜗族，将物种传播到广阔远方。它们以自身有机组织与认知物质出芽繁殖，让后代体验庞大体型无法接触的新风味和感受。多个来自不同起源的拾荒蜗族相遇时，可以融合为新的拾荒巨蜗，再次开启生命周期。

拾荒蜗族的胃几乎能从任何事物中获取营养，这是世代生活在填埋场的适应结果。不过，在干净环境中住得越久，摄食废物的能力便越退化。尽管什么都吃，拾荒蜗族对味道却极为敏感，对喜爱的风味和芬芳培养出极其具体的口味偏好。

社会

拾荒蜗族声称，祖先可追溯到失落格拉利昂下水道中的异怪种族。他们在艾巴萨罗姆空间站垃圾处理单元中十分常见，又天生懂得穿行科技基础设施，可见长期熟悉城市生存，这也使身世之说可信。与其他关联失踪行星的种族不同，拾荒蜗族不太关心被遗忘的过去，更重视当下。毕竟，星际旅行让他们能与在外星平行演化、不同于空间站本土族群的拾荒蜗族联系繁衍，使如今成为整个族群发现与扩张的时代。

许多拾荒蜗族倾向封闭，只喜欢同类相伴。同胞在紧密的家庭群体中分享新奇事物、交换美味，拾荒巨蜗则兼任家长、信息枢纽与社群中心。这些异怪回避外人，除非对方带着新风味来接近，或亲族鼓励他们外出探索。

拾荒蜗族的寡言与退缩，源于世代遭受其他智慧生物对其外貌、口味与栖地的厌恶。大断层前，他们就被排斥为住在垃圾里的怪物，多数普通人仍保有这种观感。鼠人是最先认识到其复杂心智并开启交流的种族之一，因此在拾荒蜗族社会中地位特殊。地精主流文化喜爱废物，也很快将拾荒蜗族接纳进废铁场的社群。他们通常与星蛸族及其他异怪相处融洽，后者更可能欣赏其古怪视角和审美。虽然许多文化仍厌恶拾荒蜗族的习惯，但证明自己有用、友善或讲究卫生的个体，也能获得其他种族接纳。

味觉驱动拾荒蜗族的大部分文化。他们视新颖细腻的风味为人生至高美味，专心寻找，与最亲近的同伴分享。其语言描述味道与气味的词，比颜色与形状更多。即使同出一位拾荒巨蜗的手足，口味也可能截然不同。独特口味常延伸至审美与风格，他们会将具有他们喜爱的颜色、形状、质地和风味的废料拼贴为外壳，外显个人偏好。

拾荒蜗族的语言与邪灵语有许多共同词根，却在许多方面不同于任何其他现存语言。它变化极快，没有固定发音，从种族名称到个人名字，都可以有不同解读。

敏锐感官也影响命名习惯。拾荒蜗族在出生后最初几个月，会探索自己喜爱的词语味道、声音和质感，组合自己的名字。名字混合了最爱风味、最爱废料产品品牌的音节，以及个人觉得悦耳或说起来舒服的音节，有时加入音乐性抑扬或只有感应纤须才能复现的声音。繁殖周期让性别无关紧要，因此每位拾荒蜗族只选择最能带来审美刺激的代词。许多人喜欢能微妙改变发音的“不发音”字母。

示例姓名

Abardoeng、Dysktypowary、Fvinbinbonbum、Inphoivym、MyroOoal、Nzillif、Swaltyum、UafoHVORrtini。

信仰

拾荒蜗族往往专注眼前，忘记过去，规划未来也只求足以安全享受当下。他们透过食物、艺术和工艺，追求舒适又充满刺激的生活。通常他们喜欢定居，但栖地不适的变化、渴求新风味、与远方族群繁衍的责任，或累积的无聊，都可能促使他们冒险。有些个体在宗教、抱负、国家认同等更高目标中实现自我，多数则更爱维持稳态。

多数拾荒蜗族视神明意志为另一种自然力量，关注程度就如天气或所居行星、卫星的轨道。信教者常受海拉丝的社群精神、宗-莎琳对感受与表达的重视、奥拉斯对适应演化的赞美，或厄加图娅的纵情享乐主义启发。发现自然环境能变废为宝的神秘主义拾荒蜗族，有时会追随苍翠誓约、循环或其他原初传统，拥抱更原始、抽象的生命轮回。

常见典范

赞美独特的兴趣，享受生活的小乐趣，善用一切机遇，管好自己的事，优先舒适与安全

常见禁忌

与所有人一模一样，丢弃仍有用的东西，囤积宝藏却不使用，将野心置于实际舒适之上，拒绝新感官体验

拾荒蜗族规则数据

pages.name: 牛尔人
pages.expectedContent:
When the Gap ended, most people had historical records previous to its advent to fall back on—nuars weren't so lucky. The only records of their past were the mission logs of an expedition that landed on Absalom Station in 3 ag, with no memory of where they came from. Nuars have no other history, home world, or culture to speak of, leaving them with a species-wide mystery. While unable to properly source their origins, nuar investigators nonetheless proved incredibly adept at puzzle-solving and adapting to other cultures across the Pact Worlds. They can be found within their own enclaves or living seamlessly among different species.

Nuars can live anywhere, but the largest group of their species live on Absalom Station, particularly in the labyrinthine Conduit neighborhood. Nuars with a taste for exploration work as mechanics, medics, or hunters on the frontiers of known space, filling vital roles as experts in their fields. Some find fulfilling lives on settled worlds and space stations, often holding careers as researchers, investigators, or urban planners. The combination of bulk, endurance, and spatial awareness most nuars possess make them indispensable in construction, whether it be in condensed city centers or at a pop-up installation on a desolate world. Nuar builders might decide to inhabit the city or structure they constructed, at least for a time, since many feel a deep connection to places they've created or explored.

Most nuars excel with mathematics and spatial reasoning, leading many to become mechanics, engineers, or starship crew members. These skills are sometimes used for less physical careers, such as in the computer sciences, where a nuar's talent for puzzles is advantageous. Some rely on their brawny appearance to get them gigs as laborers or muscle, then quickly navigate the maze of workplace success to rise all the way to the top—just ask Primex Kantol!

If you want to play a character who is inquisitive, can pick up skills quickly, and is something of a gentle giant, you should play a nuar.

You Might...

  • Solve puzzles compulsively or just for fun.

  • Look for answers about your ancestral origins or forge your own path.

  • Decorate your horns and hooves as part of your style.

Others Probably...

  • Wonder about the differences between you and a minotaur.

  • Envy your deep knowledge of esoteric topics.

  • Assume you're a know-it-all or weaker than a true minotaur.

Physical Description

Nuars tower over many other species at about 7 to 8 feet tall—short in stature compared to their minotaur cousins. Their multiple horns can reach up to a foot and a half long. Bipedal on strong hooves, nuars move with a deftness unusual for their size, never lumbering so much as moving with weighted purpose. Nuar fur grows in a short coat of multiple layers, creating a thick, coarse pelt with shaggier fur toward the crown of the head. Nuars living in humanoid-centric communities often cut or style their head and face fur for fashion, much in the same way humans do. Their fur is naturally colored in neutral tones, such as shades of white, cream, or tan. Nuars who treat another species as their own might dye their fur or take supplements to change it to a more unique or meaningful color, though this practice is somewhat uncommon.

By maturity, nuars grow multiple horns, with two or four horns being the most frequent. Pairs usually vary in angle from each other. The lower pair typically grows out and forward with thick bases that make them efficient in close-range combat. Higher pairs tend to point at higher angles, adorning the nuar's brow in a crown-like configuration. The greater the number of horns, the more intricate the angles become, though they somehow avoid each other as they grow. Nuars who grow an odd number of horns are uncommon but not impossible. Other nuars notice the oddity, though interpretations vary widely between enclaves if it's a sign of good or bad luck. The odd horn occasionally grows directly from the forehead, presenting an even more formidable challenge for any foe within goring distance.

Nuars possess the uncanny ability to remain comfortable at any level of gravitational intensity. Even on worlds where the gravitational pull is strong enough to pin an average humanoid in place without technological assistance to resist, nuars plow forward, albeit at a slower speed as if trudging underwater. Likewise, some nuars have shown the ability to provide themselves with quick bursts of personal gravity in a vacuum, making them ideal for spacewalks outside of ships or stations. Youths raised from birth in extreme gravity conditions never show the deficiencies in bone growth or muscle density that other humanoids might, which has led to an emerging theory that their original home planet was prone to dips and spikes in gravity that necessitated a quirk of evolution. Xenobiologists are unsure of precisely how nuars manage to flex the limitations of gravity on themselves, but they agree that all nuars seem to possess signs of this trait on an innate level.

Society

Nuars' origins remain a compelling mystery, thanks to the Gap. While they appear related to minotaurs, there's no record of their existence pre-Gap, resulting in the when, where, and how of their ancestry's genesis being lost. The character of nuar culture is as such still developing, with many of them split on how to best discover their past. About half of the nuars in the Pact Worlds attempt to raise their children in isolation and study their behaviors to discern any inherent preference or cultural milestones. This approach has had mixed results, with no conclusive evidence that the behaviors of young nuars are the product of nature rather than nurture. A growing portion of the nuar population believes that such study is pointless, choosing to look forward and build culture from scratch rather than trying to dig through time for what was. This stance has proved popular in recent years, and young nuars have left their once-secluded enclaves in droves to find their own wants and needs among the stars.

he two most prominent trends shared by virtually all nuars are the concepts of the maze of life and the personal legend. The maze of life represents the many twists and turns an individual can experience, leading to wandering, experimentation, and possibly losing one's sense of self. Nuars who have become disillusioned with their lives are said to be “lost in the maze,” searching for purpose and changing perspective frequently until they find it. By contrast, a personal legend is born when a nuar settles on their version of truth. Personal legends often bind nuars together in a community, and it's common for other nuars to accept the personal legend of another at face value, no matter how outlandish it seems. Legends become popular stories that stand in for tall tales about the history of the people, filling in the gaps in nuar culture and leaving something for other generations to expand upon.

Nuar enclaves can be found dotted about most Pact World planets, forming around small communities of elders weary of travel and new parents raising their offspring. The elders stay permanently in the enclaves, assisting with child-rearing and offering insight to younger generations. Nuars not of a venerable age stay in the enclaves only so long as they need support from the elders before departing on a new investigation or adventure. Bonded mates might travel together or separately, sometimes opting to leave their offspring at the enclave until these youths reach maturity and begin their own paths through the maze of life. Whole nuar families stick together as a traveling unit on rare occasions, but much more commonly, they separate from each other while maintaining sporadic contact. It's widely understood that pursuing different paths in life doesn't dissolve a family bond, but neither is togetherness the only definition of connection. Mates, siblings, and cousins can go years without speaking, only to be as close as ever once their paths cross again or they enter one another's errant thoughts.

Beliefs

Given their wide range of interpretations and experiences, nuars lack many unifying cultural beliefs that are common among other ancestries. Most nuars are too consumed with historical or physical puzzles, such as the events of the Gap or an unruly engine manifold, to put much focus toward metaphysical matters such as the divine. Those who do give their attention to worship tend to follow Eloritu in pursuit of knowledge and mysteries or the scattered conceptual studies of an amalgamated god or pantheon. Even religious nuars admit that their faith is aligned with their personal experiences, a marriage of coincidence and preference rather than a true calling. It's more common to find nuars who subscribe to a philosophy or general moral code than a divine source of worship.

Though they lack a cohesive culture, nuars are unified in their beliefs on a single point: that opinions and experiences are what make life real. It's exceedingly rare to find a nuar willing to invalidate or persecute the beliefs of others, instead simply accepting that what they see is their individual truth, which will vary from another's. This mindset doesn't mean that they accept outright lies, bigotry, or refrain from objective debate about the nature of others' views; rather, it's understood that such beliefs are a result of teaching and events compiled through one's life, a perception that might need its filter cleaned from time to time. In this way, nuars have become good friends with the emerging generation of vesk who seek to unlearn the harmful traditions imposed by centuries of Veskarium doctrine. It isn't uncommon to see nuars as counselors for individuals escaping from indoctrination of cults or other oppressive cultures that corrupt individual thinking.

Popular Edicts

calm those alarmed by your size, pursue truth and share it with others, seek answers to questions

Popular Anathema

dismiss the beliefs of others without proper analysis, fixate on a task or idea to the point of obsession, value brawn over brains

Nuar Mechanics

Hit Points 10

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Constitution, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

Languages Common, Two regional languages of your choice

Additional languages Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it’s positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

pages.content:
大断层结束时，多数人仍有其到来之前的历史记录可供依凭，牛尔人却没这么幸运。关于他们过去的唯一记载，是一支在3 AG降落艾巴萨罗姆空间站的远征队的任务日志；队员们不记得自己来自哪里。牛尔人没有其他可谈的历史、母星或文化，整个种族因此面临共同谜团。虽然无法确切找到起源，牛尔人调查者却极擅解谜，也善于适应盟约诸界的其他文化。他们既住在自己的聚居区，也能与不同种族融洽共居。

牛尔人可以生活在任何地方，但最大族群居住于艾巴萨罗姆空间站，尤其是迷宫般的管渠街区。喜爱探索者在已知太空边疆担任机械师、医师或猎人，作为专家发挥重要作用。有些人在已开发世界和空间站找到充实生活，常从事研究、调查或城市规划。多数牛尔人兼具体格、耐力与空间感，使其在建筑行业不可或缺，无论拥挤市中心，还是荒凉世界的临时设施。牛尔人建造者可能决定住进自己建起的城市或建筑，至少暂住，因为许多人对创造或探索过的地方有深厚感情。

多数牛尔人数学和空间推理出色，因此常成为机械师、工程师或星舰船员。这些技能有时也用于较少依靠体力的职业，例如计算机科学，牛尔人的解谜天赋在其中大有优势。有些人凭魁梧外表找到劳工或打手的工作，随后迅速穿过职场成功的迷宫，一路升到顶端；问问首席执政官康托尔就知道了！

如果你希望扮演一个好奇、学艺快，又有几分温和巨人特质的角色，就应该选择牛尔人。

你可能……

  • 不由自主地解谜，或只是为了好玩。

  • 寻找祖先起源的答案，或开辟自己的道路。

  • 装饰角与蹄，作为个人风格的一部分。

他人可能……

  • 好奇你与牛头人的差别。

  • 羡慕你对深奥主题的丰富知识。

  • 以为你自以为无所不知，或比真正的牛头人更弱。

外貌描述

牛尔人约7至8尺高，远高于许多种族，却比牛头人亲族矮小。他们的多只角可长达一尺半。他们以强健双蹄行走，灵巧得与体型不符，从不笨重蹒跚，每一步反而沉稳而有目的。毛发由多层短毛构成厚而粗糙的毛被，头顶更蓬松。住在以类人生物为主的社群中的牛尔人，常像人类一样，修剪、打理头部和脸部毛发以追求时尚。天然毛色为中性色调，例如不同深浅的白、奶油色或黄褐色。认同其他种族、视其为同族的牛尔人，可能染毛或服用补剂，变成更独特或更有意义的颜色，不过这种做法并不常见。

成熟时，牛尔人会长出多只角，最常见的是两只或四只。各对角通常朝向不同角度。较低的一对通常向外、向前伸展，基部粗壮，利于近身搏斗；较高的几对往往朝上，在额头构成冠冕般的形态。角越多，排列角度越复杂，却总能在生长时彼此避开。长奇数只角并不常见，但仍有可能。同族会注意这种特殊之处，究竟是好运还是坏运的征兆，各聚居区解读大不相同。多出的单角偶尔会直接从额头长出，让敢靠近顶刺范围的敌人面临更严峻的威胁。

牛尔人能不可思议地在任何重力强度下保持舒适。某些世界的重力强到普通类人生物若无科技辅助便会被压住，他们仍能向前，只是速度变慢，如同水中跋涉。部分牛尔人还能在真空中为自己短暂产生个人重力，极适合在飞船或空间站外太空行走。自出生便在极端重力下成长的年轻人，从不会表现出其他类人生物可能有的骨骼生长或肌肉密度缺陷。因此有新理论认为，其母星可能时有重力骤降、骤升，促成特殊演化。异星生物学家不确定牛尔人究竟如何改变自身承受的重力限制，但一致认为，每位牛尔人似乎都天生具有此特质的迹象。

社会

大断层使牛尔人的起源至今仍是引人入胜的谜。虽似乎与牛头人有关，却没有大断层前的存在记录，其族裔诞生的时间、地点与方式皆已失落。牛尔人文化的面貌仍在发展，许多人对探明过去的最佳方式意见分歧。盟约诸界约一半的牛尔人，尝试在隔离环境中抚养孩子，研究行为以辨认先天偏好或文化里程碑。成果好坏参半，尚无确凿证据说明年轻牛尔人的行为源自先天，而非后天培养。越来越多人觉得这类研究无意义，选择向前看、从零建立文化，而不挖掘旧时光。这种立场近年颇受欢迎，年轻牛尔人大批离开曾经封闭的聚居区，在群星间寻找自己的愿望与需求。

几乎所有牛尔人共同拥有的两个最显著观念，是人生迷宫和个人传说。人生迷宫代表个体可能遇到的种种曲折，带来漫游、尝试，甚至迷失自我。对生活失望的牛尔人被称为“迷失迷宫”，他们不断转换视角、寻找目标，直到找到。相对而言，当牛尔人确定了自己版本的真理，个人传说便诞生了。传说常将牛尔人团结成社群，同族往往照单接受他人的传说，无论多么离奇。传说化为流行故事，代替关于族群历史的夸张传奇，填补文化空缺，也为后世留下继续拓展的内容。

多数盟约诸界行星都散布牛尔人聚居区，由厌倦旅行的小群长者，以及养育后代的新父母形成。长者永久留下，协助育儿，为年轻一代提供见解。未至高龄者，只在需要长者支持时暂留，随后便展开新调查或冒险。结为伴侣者可同行或各自旅行，有时将孩子留在聚居区，直到成年、踏上各自的人生迷宫之路。整家作为旅行群体同行的情况少见，更多是分开，偶尔联系。大家都明白，追寻不同人生道路不会消解家庭纽带，同处一地也不是联系的唯一定义。伴侣、手足和表亲可以多年不说话，却在再次相遇或偶然想起彼此时，依旧如昔亲近。

信仰

解读与经历如此多样，让牛尔人缺少其他族裔常见的统一文化信念。多数牛尔人太专注历史或实际谜题，例如大断层事件或难缠的引擎歧管，无暇多想神明等形而上之事。投身崇拜者常追随伊洛里图，寻求知识奥秘，或零散研究融合神明、神系的概念。就连信教牛尔人也承认，信仰源于个人经历，是巧合与偏好的结合，而非真正感召。比起敬拜神明，牛尔人更常信奉哲学或一般道德准则。

虽然缺乏统一文化，牛尔人在一点上看法一致：观点与经历让生活真实。牛尔人极少愿意否定或迫害他人信仰，而是接受每人所见都是个人真理，必然有别于他人。这并非说他们接受彻底的谎言、偏执，也不代表不愿客观辩论他人观点的本质；他们理解，信念来自一生所受教导与所遇事件的累积，认知的滤镜偶尔可能需要清理。因此，牛尔人与新兴一代维斯克蜥人成为好友，后者试图摆脱数百年维斯卡里姆教义强加的有害传统。牛尔人常为逃离邪教洗脑，或其他扭曲个人思想的压迫文化的人担任顾问。

常见典范

安抚因你体型而惊恐的人，追寻真理并分享，寻找问题的答案

常见禁忌

未经充分分析便否定他人信仰，过度执着某项任务或想法，重武力而轻智慧

牛尔人规则数据

生命值 10

体型 中型

速度 25尺

属性提升 体质、智力、自选

属性缺陷 魅力

语言 通用语，以及两项自选地区语言

额外语言 数量等于智力调整值的额外语言（若为正值）。从常见语言列表及你拥有许可的其他语言中选择，例如母星通行的语言。

  • 类人

  • 牛尔人

Speaking

As long as you can act, you can also speak. You don't need to spend any type of action to speak, but because a round represents 6 seconds of time, you can usually speak at most a single sentence or so per round. Special uses of speech, such as attempting a Deception skill check to Lie, require spending actions and follow their own rules. All speech has the auditory trait. If you communicate in some way other than speech, other rules might apply. For instance, using sign language is visual instead of auditory.

pages.name: 坠落
pages.expectedContent:
When you fall more than 5 feet, take bludgeoning damage equal to half the distance you fell. If you take any damage, you land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If you fall into water or a soft substance, calculate damage as though the fall were 20 feet shorter, 30 if you intentionally dove in (up to the depth of the substance).

Falling on a Creature

If you land on a creature, that creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:15] save. Intentionally aiming yourself to land on a creature after a long fall is almost impossible.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to one-quarter the falling damage you took.

Failure The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to half the falling damage you took.

Critical Failure The creature takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage you took from the fall.

Falling Objects

A dropped object takes damage just like a falling creature. If the object lands on a creature, that creature can attempt a Reflex save using the same rules as for a creature falling on a creature. Hazards and spells that involve falling objects, such as a rock slide, have their own rules about how they interact with creatures and the damage they deal.

坠落到生物上

若你坠落到生物身上，该生物必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:15]豁免。长距离坠落时，刻意瞄准并落到生物身上几乎不可能。

大成功 该生物不受伤害。

成功 该生物受到你坠落伤害四分之一的钝击伤害。

失败 该生物受到你坠落伤害一半的钝击伤害。

大失败 该生物受到等于你坠落伤害的钝击伤害。

坠落物体

坠落的物体会像坠落的生物一样受到伤害。如果物体落在生物身上，该生物可以进行反射豁免，使用生物坠落到另一生物身上的相同规则。涉及坠物的危害与法术（如岩崩）有各自的规则，规定它们如何影响生物，以及造成的伤害。

pages.name: 反制
pages.expectedContent:
Some effects try to counteract spells, afflictions, conditions, or other effects. Counteract checks compare the power of two forces and determine which defeats the other. Successfully counteracting an effect disrupts it, preventing it from having any effect, unless noted otherwise.

When attempting a counteract check, add the relevant skill modifier or other appropriate modifier to your check against the target's DC. If you're counteracting an affliction, the DC is in the affliction's stat block. If it's a spell, use the caster's DC. The GM can also calculate a DC based on the target effect's level. For spells, the counteract check modifier is your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus, plus any bonuses and penalties that specifically apply to counteract checks.

What you can counteract depends on the check result and the target's counteract rank. If an effect is a spell, its rank is the counteract rank. Otherwise, halve its level and round up to determine its counteract rank (minimum counteract rank 0). If an effect's level is unclear and it came from a creature, halve and round up the creature's level.

 Critical Success Counteract the target if its counteract rank is no more than 3 higher than your effect's counteract rank.

 Success Counteract the target if its counteract rank is no more than 1 higher than your effect's counteract rank.

 Failure Counteract the target if its counteract rank is lower than your effect's counteract rank.

 Critical Failure You fail to counteract the target.

有些效果会尝试反制法术、苦难、状态或其他效果。反制检定比较两股力量的强弱，决定哪一方胜出。除非另有说明，成功反制一个效果会打断它，使其无法产生任何效果。

进行反制检定时，将相关技能调整值或其他适当调整值加入检定，对抗目标的DC。如果你反制的是苦难，其DC列在该苦难的数据栏中；如果是法术，则使用施法者的DC。GM也可以依据目标效果的等级计算DC。对于法术，反制检定调整值等于你的施法属性调整值加施法熟练加值，再加上专门适用于反制检定的所有加值与减值。

你能反制哪些效果，取决于检定结果和目标的反制环级。如果效果是法术，其法术环级就是反制环级。否则，将其等级减半并向上取整，得出反制环级（最低为0环）。如果效果等级不明确，且效果来自某个生物，则将该生物的等级减半并向上取整。

pages.name: 感官
pages.expectedContent:
The ways a creature can use Perception depend on what senses it has.

Precise Senses

Average vision is a precise sense—a sense that can be used to perceive the world in nuanced detail. The only way to target a creature without having drawbacks is to use a precise sense. You can usually detect a creature automatically with a precise sense unless that creature is hiding or obscured by the environment, in which case you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} basic action to better detect the creature.

Imprecise Senses

Average hearing is an imprecise sense—it can't detect the full range of detail that a precise sense can. You can usually sense a creature automatically with an imprecise sense, but it has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} condition instead of the observed condition. It might be undetected by you if it's using Stealth or is in an environment that distorts the sense, such as a noisy room in the case of hearing. In those cases, you have to use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} basic action to detect the creature. At best, an imprecise sense can be used to make an undetected creature (or one you didn't even know was there) merely hidden—it can't make the creature observed.

Vague Senses

A character also has many vague senses—ones that can alert you that something is there but aren't useful for zeroing in on it to determine exactly what it is. The most useful of these for a typical character is the sense of smell. At best, a vague sense can be used to detect the presence of an unnoticed creature, making it undetected. Even then, the vague sense isn't sufficient to make the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or observed.

Special Senses

Darkvision and Greater Darkvision

A creature with darkvision or greater darkvision can see perfectly well in areas of darkness and dim light, though such vision is in black and white only. Some forms of magical darkness, such as a 4th-rank darkness spell, block normal darkvision. A creature with greater darkvision, however, can see through even these forms of magical darkness.

Low-Light Vision

A creature with low-light vision can see in dim light as though it were bright light, so it ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition due to dim light.

Scent

Scent involves sensing creatures or objects by smell, and is usually a vague sense. The range is listed in the ability, and it functions only if the creature or object being detected emits an aroma. If a creature emits a heavy aroma or is upwind, the GM can double or even triple the range of scent abilities used to detect that creature, and the GM can reduce the range if a creature is downwind.

Tremorsense

Tremorsense allows a creature to feel the vibrations through a solid surface caused by movement. It is usually an imprecise sense with a limited range (listed in the ability). Tremorsense functions only if the detecting creature is on the same surface as the subject, and only if the subject is moving along (or burrowing through) the surface.

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 424-425
pages.content:
生物使用察觉的方式取决于其拥有的感官。

精确感官

正常视觉是一种精确感官，能感知世界的细微详情。要在不承受不利影响的情况下将生物定为目标，唯一的方法是使用精确感官。你通常可以用精确感官自动发现生物，除非该生物正在躲藏或被环境遮挡；遇到这些情况时，你可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}基本动作来更好地发现该生物。

模糊感官

正常听觉是一种模糊感官，无法像精确感官那样感知全面的细节。你通常可以用模糊感官自动感知到生物，但该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态，而非被观察状态。如果它正在使用隐秘，或身处会干扰该感官的环境（例如对听觉而言的嘈杂房间），则可能对你处于无踪状态。这些情况下，你必须使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}基本动作来发现它。模糊感官最多只能让无踪的生物（甚至是你原本完全不知道存在的生物）变为躲藏，无法让该生物变为被观察。

朦胧感官

角色还拥有许多朦胧感官，能提醒你有某种事物存在，却无法准确锁定它并判断究竟是什么。对一般角色而言，其中最有用的是嗅觉。朦胧感官最多只能发现原本未被察觉的生物的存在，使其变为无踪。即使如此，朦胧感官仍不足以使该生物变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}或被观察。

特殊感官

黑暗视觉与高等黑暗视觉

具有黑暗视觉或高等黑暗视觉的生物，能够在黑暗和昏暗光照区域中清晰视物，但只能看到黑白影像。某些魔法黑暗（例如4环黑暗术）会阻挡普通黑暗视觉，而具有高等黑暗视觉的生物甚至能看穿这些魔法黑暗。

昏暗视觉

拥有昏暗视觉的生物在昏暗光中视物如同在明亮光中一样，因此其忽略昏暗光提供的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。

嗅觉

嗅觉通过气味感知生物或物体，通常是朦胧感官。其范围列在能力中，且只有被侦测的生物或物体散发气味时才有效。如果生物气味浓烈或位于上风处，GM可以将用于侦测它的嗅觉能力范围加倍，甚至增至三倍；如果生物位于下风处，GM则可以缩短范围。

震颤感知

震颤感知让生物通过固体表面感受到移动引发的振动。它通常是范围有限的模糊感官（范围列在能力中）。只有侦测者与目标处于同一表面，且目标正沿该表面移动（或在其中掘地）时，震颤感知才有效。

It can try to guess your square by picking a square and attempting an attack. This works like targeting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} creature, but the flat check and attack roll are rolled in secret by the GM.
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9evPzg9E6muFcoSk]{Unnoticed}A creature you're unnoticed by is unaware of your presence.
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}You're undetected by everyone. You can't become observed while invisible except via special abilities or magic.

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 425
pages.content:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{可见}一个能正常观察到你的生物知道你的位置，能正常将你定为目标。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}你对其处于隐蔽状态的生物，以非区域效果将你定为目标时，必须通过@Check[flat|dc:5]。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}你对其处于躲藏状态的生物知道你所在的空间。它对你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，且必须通过@Check[flat|dc:11]才能影响你。你可以躲藏来进入躲藏状态，也可以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}来找到躲藏的生物。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}你对其处于无踪状态的生物无法看到你，也不知道你所在的方格，对你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，也无法将你定为目标。它可以试着猜测你所在的位置并尝试攻击，其处理方式与攻击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}生物相同，但纯骰检定和攻击检定都由GM秘密进行。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9evPzg9E6muFcoSk]{未发现}你对其处于未发现状态的生物完全不知道你在附近。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}你对所有人处于无踪状态。隐形期间，除非借助特殊能力或魔法，否则你不会变为被观察。

pages.expectedContent:
Give out 1 Hero Point to each PC at the start of the session. Give out roughly 1 more per hour of play, for a heroic act or a moderate or major accomplishment. Hero Points can be spent in two ways.

Spend 1 Hero Point to reroll a check and use the second result. This is a fortune effect.

花费1点英雄点，重掷一次检定并使用第二次结果。这是幸运效果。
