pages.name: 自动加值成长
pages.expectedContent:
This variant removes the item bonus to rolls and DCs usually provided by magic items (with the exception of armor's item bonus) and replaces it with a new kind of bonus—potency—to reflect a character's innate ability. In this variant, magic items, if they exist at all, can provide unique special abilities rather than numerical increases.

Special Class Features

Every character automatically gains the class features on the Automatic Bonus Progression table.

AUTOMATIC BONUS PROGRESSION

LevelBenefits
1-
2Attack potency +1
3Skill potency (one at +1)
4Devastating attacks (two dice)
5Defense potency +1
6Skill potency (two at +1 each)
7Perception potency +1
8Saving throw potency +1
9Skill potency (one at +2, one at +1)
10Attack potency +2
11Defense potency +2
12Devastating attacks (three dice)
13Perception potency +2; skill potency (two at +2 each, one at +1)
14Saving throw potency +2
15Skill potency (three at +2 each, one at +1)
16Attack potency +3
17Attribute apex; skill potency (one at +3, two at +2 each, two at +1 each)
18Defense potency +3
19Devastating attacks (four dice), Perception potency +3
20Saving throw potency +3; skill potency (two at +3 each, two at +2 each, two at +1 each)

Attack Potency2nd

Starting at 2nd level, you gain a +1 potency bonus to attack rolls with all weapons and unarmed attacks. This increases to +2 at 10th level, and +3 at 16th level.

Skill Potency3rd

At 3rd level, choose a single skill. You gain a +1 potency bonus with that skill. At 6th level, choose a second skill to gain a +1 potency bonus. At 9th level, choose one of those skills and increase its potency bonus to +2. At 13th level, increase the potency bonus of your second skill to +2 and choose a third skill to gain a +1 potency bonus. At 15th level, increase the third skill's potency bonus to +2 and choose a fourth skill to gain a +1 potency bonus. At 17th level, choose one of your three skills with a +2 potency bonus to increase to +3, and choose a fifth skill to gain a +1 potency bonus. Finally, at 20th level, choose one of the two skills with a +2 potency bonus to increase to +3, choose one of the three skills at a +1 potency bonus to increase to +2, and choose one new skill to gain a +1 potency bonus. You can spend 1 week to retrain one of these assignments at any time.

Devastating Attacks4th

At 4th level, your weapon and unarmed Strikes deal two damage dice instead of one. This increases to three at 12th level and to four at 19th level.

Defense Potency5th

At 5th level, you gain a +1 potency bonus to AC. At 11th level, this bonus increases to +2, and at 18th level, to +3.

Perception Potency7th

At 7th level, you gain a +1 potency bonus to Perception, increasing to +2 at level 13 and +3 at level 19.

Saving Throw Potency8th

At 8th level, you gain a +1 potency bonus to saves, increasing to +2 at level 14 and +3 at level 20.

Attribute Apex17th

At 17th level, choose one attribute modifier to either increase by 1 or increase to +4 (whichever grants the higher modifer).

Adjusting Items and Treasure

With this variant, you can ignore as much of the Party Treasure by Level table on page 59 as you want, though you'll usually want to provide consistent currency. The main area your choice will impact is in spellcasting items, such as scrolls and wands. Remove all potency runes, striking runes, and resilient runes. Items that normally grant an item bonus to statistics or damage dice no longer do, other than the base item bonus to AC from armor. Apex items do not increase attribute modifiers. If your world still includes magic items, a safe bet is to continue to give out consumable items. If you choose to eliminate runes entirely, this can reduce the PCs' damage since they won't have runes like flaming or holy. If you've removed nearly all treasure, challenges might become more difficult, even with automatic bonuses.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 83
pages.content:
此变体规则移除通常由魔法物品提供的检定与DC物品加值（护甲的物品加值除外），改用一种新的加值类型——潜能，以体现角色的内在能力。在此变体规则下，如果魔法物品仍然存在，它们可以提供独特的特殊能力，而非数值提升。

特殊职业能力

每个角色都自动获得自动加值成长表中的职业能力。

自动加值成长

等级好处
1-
2攻击潜能+1
3技能潜能（1项+1）
4毁灭攻击（2骰）
5防御潜能+1
6技能潜能（2项+1）
7察觉潜能+1
8豁免潜能+1
9技能潜能（1项+2，1项+1）
10攻击潜能+2
11防御潜能+2
12毁灭攻击（3骰）
13察觉潜能+2，技能潜能（2项+2，1项+1）
14豁免潜能+2
15技能潜能（3项+2，1项+1）
16攻击潜能+3
17属性巅峰，技能潜能（1项+3，2项+2，2项+1）
18防御潜能+3
19毁灭攻击（4骰），察觉潜能+3
20豁免潜能+3，技能潜能（2项+3，2项+2，2项+1）

攻击潜能2级

从2级起，你使用任何武器或徒手攻击进行的攻击检定获得+1潜能加值。10级时提高至+2，16级时提高至+3。

技能潜能3级

3级时，选择一项技能；该技能获得+1潜能加值。6级时，选择第二项技能，获得+1潜能加值。9级时，选择这两项技能之一，将其潜能加值提高至+2。13级时，将第二项技能的潜能加值提高至+2，并选择第三项技能，获得+1潜能加值。15级时，将第三项技能的潜能加值提高至+2，并选择第四项技能，获得+1潜能加值。17级时，从三项具有+2潜能加值的技能中选择一项，将加值提高至+3，并选择第五项技能，获得+1潜能加值。最后，20级时，从两项具有+2潜能加值的技能中选择一项，将加值提高至+3；从三项具有+1潜能加值的技能中选择一项，将加值提高至+2；再选择一项新技能，获得+1潜能加值。你随时可以花费1周重训其中一项分配。

毁灭攻击4级

4级时，你的武器与徒手打击造成两颗伤害骰，而非一颗。12级时提高至三颗，19级时提高至四颗。

防御潜能5级

5级起，你在AC上获得+1潜能加值。此加值在11级时成长到+2，18级时到+3。

察觉潜能7级

7级起，你在察觉上获得+1潜能加值。此加值在13级时成长到+2，19级时到+3。

豁免潜能8级

8级起，你在全部豁免上获得+1潜能加值。此加值在14级时成长到+2，20级时到+3。

属性巅峰17级

17级时，选择一项属性调整值，使其增加1或提高至+4（取最终调整值较高者）。

调整物品与宝藏

使用此变体规则时，你可以按需要忽略第59页的按等级分配团队财富表，不过通常仍应提供稳定的货币。你的选择主要会影响卷轴和魔杖等施法物品。移除所有潜能符文、强击符文与韧性符文。除护甲对AC的基础物品加值外，通常为数据或伤害骰提供物品加值的物品不再提供这些加值。巅峰物品不再提高属性调整值。如果世界中仍有魔法物品，继续提供消耗品是稳妥的做法。若你完全移除符文，PC的伤害可能降低，因为他们不再拥有炽焰或圣洁之类的符文。若你移除几乎所有宝藏，即使有自动加值，挑战也可能变得更困难。

pages.name: 自由变体
pages.expectedContent:
Sometimes the story of your game calls for a group where everyone is a pirate or an apprentice at a magic school. The free archetype variant introduces a shared aspect to every character without taking away any of that character's existing choices.

Building a Character

The only difference between a normal character and a free-archetype character is that the character receives an extra class feat at 2nd level and every even level thereafter that they can use only for archetype feats. You might restrict the free feats to those of a single archetype each character in the group has (for a shared backstory), those of archetypes fitting a certain theme (such as only ones from magical archetypes in a game set in a magic school), or entirely unrestricted if you just want a higher-powered game.

If the group all has the same archetype or draws from a limited list, you might want to ignore the free archetype's normal restriction of selecting a certain number of feats before taking a new archetype. That way a character can still pursue another archetype that also fits their character.

Playing with Free Archetypes

Free-archetype characters are a bit more versatile and powerful than normal, but usually not so much that they unbalance your game. However, due to the characters' increased access to archetype feats, you should place a limit on the number of feats that scale based on a character's number of archetype feats (mainly multiclass Resiliency feats). Allowing a character to benefit from a number of these feats equal to half their level is appropriate.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 84
pages.content:
有时冒险的故事设定会要求所有PC都是海盗，或都是某个魔法学院的学生之类的背景。此时免费变体可选规则就可在不牺牲特定角色原有能力选项的前提下，让每个PC都能有共通的能力。

创建角色

普通角色与免费变体角色之间唯一的区别是：后者在2级及此后每个偶数等级获得一个额外职业专长，只能用于选择变体专长。你可以将这些免费专长限定为全队共享的一种变体（用于共同背景故事），或符合特定主题的变体（例如魔法学校背景的游戏中只允许魔法变体）；如果只是想提高游戏中的角色实力，也可以完全不作限制。

如果全队都采用同一种变体，或只能从有限列表中选择，你可以考虑忽略免费变体通常要求选取一定数量的专长后才能选择新变体的限制。这样角色仍能选择另一种符合自身形象的变体。

使用免费变体规则

免费变体角色比通常角色稍强、也更灵活，但通常不至于破坏游戏平衡。不过，由于角色更容易取得变体专长，你应当限制那些依据角色变体专长数量而成长的专长所计算的数量（主要是兼职韧性专长）。允许角色从等于其等级一半数量的这类专长中受益，是合适的限制。

章节：子系统与变体规则《寻星者GM核心规则》第 84页

pages.name: 无等级熟练度
pages.expectedContent:
This variant removes a character's level from their proficiency bonus, scaling it differently for a style of game that's outside the norm. This is a significant change to the system. The proficiency rank progression in Player Core is designed for science-fantasy games where heroes rise from humble origins to legendary strength. For some games, this narrative arc doesn't fit. Such games are about hedging bets in an uncertain and gritty world, in which even the world's best soldier can't guarantee a win against a large group of moderately skilled mercenaries.

The initial implementation is fairly straightforward: the proficiency bonus just becomes +2 for trained, +4 for expert, +6 for master, and +8 for legendary. It's best to give an untrained character a –2 proficiency modifier instead of a +0 proficiency bonus.

Additionally, for creatures, hazards, magic items, and so on, reduce each statistic that would include a proficiency bonus by the level of the creature or other rules element. These statistics are typically modifiers and DCs for attacks, ACs, saving throws, Perception, skills, and spells.

Finally, decrease the skill DCs of most tasks. You can just subtract the level from the DC tables on page 53, or you can reference the Simple Skill DCs (No Level) table for a set of DCs that's easier to remember. The new DCs make it a little harder for high-level characters to succeed than it would be when using the default numbers, in keeping with the theme mentioned earlier. Combat outcomes will tend to flatten out, with critical successes and critical failures being less likely across the game. This is particularly notable in spells, where you're less likely to see the extreme effects of critical failures on saves.

TABLE: SIMPLE SKILL DCS (NO LEVEL)
Proficiency RankDC
Untrained10
Trained15
Expert20
Master25
Legendary30

Adjusting Encounters

Telling stories where a large group of low-level monsters can still be a significant threat to a high-level PC (and conversely, where a single higher-level monster is not much of a threat to a group of PCs) requires some significant shifts in encounter building, including shifts in the PCs' rewards.

Under the default math, two monsters of a certain level are roughly as challenging as a single monster 2 levels higher. However, with level removed from proficiency, this assumption is no longer true. The XP budget for creatures uses a different scale, as shown in the Creature XP (No Level) table. You'll still use the same XP budget for a given threat level as shown on the @UUID[.WZgFEMDSP9TvYc4u]{Encounter Budget} (80 XP for a moderate-threat encounter, 120 for a severe-threat encounter, and so on).

While the XP values in the Creature XP (No Level) table work well in most cases, sometimes they might not account for the effects of creatures' special abilities when facing a party of a drastically different level. For instance, a ghost mage could prove too much for 5th-level PCs with its incorporeality, flight, and high-rank spells, even though it's outnumbered.

Adjusting Treasure

Items on standard creatures are chosen to avoid giving out too much treasure for the level at which PCs will typically fight them. However, using this variant, PCs might defeat a creature 5 levels higher than they are, or even more! Too many encounters with higher-level foes can wind up giving the PCs more treasure than you expected, or vice versa if they're fighting weaker foes that put up more of a fight but still have poor treasure. You can make periodic adjustments if the PCs' treasure drifts too far from expectations. Making it so they can't easily sell or buy magic items will mean it's harder for them to exploit treasure they gain. To sidestep the issue entirely, you can use automatic bonus progression.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 85
pages.content:
此变体规则从角色的熟练加值中移除等级，改变其成长方式，以适应不同于通常形式的游戏风格。这是对系统的一项重大改动。《寻星者玩家核心》的熟练等级成长是为科幻奇幻游戏设计的，让英雄从平凡出身逐渐成长为传奇人物。但有些游戏不适合这种叙事轨迹。它们讲述的是在不确定而残酷的世界中权衡风险；即使世上最优秀的士兵，也无法保证战胜一大群技术尚可的佣兵。

最初的实施方式相当直接：熟练加值变为受训+2、专家+4、大师+6、传奇+8。对于未受训的角色，最好采用–2熟练调整值，而非+0熟练加值。

此外，对于生物、危害、魔法物品等，将每项包含熟练加值的数据，减去该生物或其他规则要素的等级。这些数据通常包括攻击、AC、豁免、察觉、技能和法术的调整值与DC。

最后，降低大多数任务的技能DC。你可以直接从第53页的DC表中减去等级，也可以参考基础技能DC（无等级）表，使用一组更容易记忆的DC。与默认数值相比，新DC会让高等级角色略难成功，符合前述主题。战斗结果会趋于平缓，整个游戏中的大成功和大失败都更少见。这在法术上尤其明显：你较少会看到豁免大失败带来的极端效果。

调整遭遇

要讲述一大群低等级怪物仍能对高等级PC构成重大威胁的故事（反过来，单个高等级怪物对一群PC的威胁不再那么大），就必须大幅调整遭遇设计，包括PC获得的奖励。

在默认数学模型中，同等级两只怪物挑战难度大致等于一只高他们两等级的怪物。但是，如果把等级从熟练系统中移除，那这个假设就失效了。生物的XP预算的数值区间会不同，如表：生物XP（无等级）所示。你还是可以用@UUID[.WZgFEMDSP9TvYc4u]{遭遇预算}中各等级的XP预算（中等威胁遭遇80XP、严重威胁120XP，以此类推）。

调整宝藏

通常生物携带的物品经过挑选，避免在PC一般会与其交战的等级提供过多宝藏。但使用此变体规则时，PC可能击败高出自身5级甚至更多的生物！与高等级敌人的遭遇过多，可能使PC获得超出预期的宝藏；反过来，若对手等级较低，却比通常更难对付，宝藏仍然贫乏，PC的收益也可能不足。如果PC的财富偏离预期太多，你可以定期调整。让他们不易买卖魔法物品，可以使其更难利用获得的宝藏。若想完全避开这个问题，可以采用自动加值成长。

pages.name: 研究
pages.expectedContent:
In the research subsystem, PCs accumulate Research Points and learn new information or gain other benefits upon reaching specific thresholds. This subsystem is great for granting PCs more in-depth pieces of information as they continue to explore an area at large. Here, time passes in rounds spanning anywhere from 10 or so minutes to a full day. Each round, the characters use the Research exploration activity to gain Research Points (RP). As time passes and the party earns more RP, they gain knowledge and rewards, but also might face consequences or events. Some of these events might interrupt the round with a different kind of encounter (disrupting the Research activity), such as a social encounter with a lonely artificial intelligence or a combat encounter against a malfunctioning security robot.

Research challenges work best when the PCs face a time constraint, rival research group, or other form of external condition that presents additional pressures—if the PCs have all the time in the world to safely investigate a database or ruin, you can usually simplify things to a simple skill check since the PCs are free to keep rolling until they uncover everything there is to find.

Building a Research Challenge

A research challenge has two components: the library, which is an area containing the various research checks PCs need to attempt to learn about the topic (as well as obstacles that the PCs face while doing so); and a research stat block, which details the topic being researched and contains the information, rewards, and additional complications that happen when the PCs reach certain thresholds of RP.

Designing The Library

"Library" is the general term to designate the setting of the PCs' research. Despite the name, it doesn't necessarily consist of a collection of books. It could be a computer database, astral memory palace, a club where the party questions the other guests, or even an infosphere. In many ways, designing a library is similar to designing any other adventure locale, with various rooms or other areas, each with its own complications for the PCs to overcome. If your library has a tactical map, these are likely hazards or encounters with hostile creatures; if your library is cinematic, especially if it's a virtual space, these might instead be skill-based or social encounters with NPCs. The PCs might even need a skill check or the Hacking subsystem to gain access to the library.

Throughout the library, you'll place research checks. These describe the task that the party is doing to Research—asking in a chat room, skimming books, chemically testing samples, or talking to a stubborn administrator—and a number of skills and DCs the party can use with the Research activity, in order from the lowest DC (the skill that works best) to the highest DC.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research}

  • CONCENTRATE

  • EXPLORATION

@Embed[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK inline]

If a skill isn't listed but a player provides a strong explanation for using it, you can add it at an appropriate DC (usually the highest listed DC). Computers and Infosphere Lore will often be listed in these entries when researching virtually, and Society is often used to navigate and decipher libraries of physical media, but it's good to know the party's skill repertoires in advance so every member has a chance to participate; perhaps the data is stored in an open-world survival vidgame, requiring a round of Survival or Vidgame Lore checks. A variety of skills and decisions, along with vivid descriptions, are key to an engaging and memorable research challenge, rather than just a string of die rolls by the technomancer or witchwarper.

Each research check also has a maximum RP value. After reaching this value, the PCs can't gain any more RP from that research check, so they'll need to find more locations for further research. You can use this to guide your PCs through your library by placing research checks where you want them to explore—an easy check near the entrance to introduce them to the topic is usually helpful! Be sure that your library provides enough RP for players to meet all the research thresholds in the stat block.

Designing The Stat Block

Once you've decided how your library and its research options are structured, it's time to build the stat block and set research thresholds for each topic. Thresholds are your opportunity to reward your PCs with intriguing new information (like the history of the planet they're on), tactical intel (such as a prototype robot's only weakness), uncommon or rare options (like item formulas of lost technology), or anything else. A mix of rewards is best! Backstory can be interesting but isn't much of a reward on its own, so it should appear only at the lowest thresholds.

Reaching thresholds can also change the state of the library, in the PCs' favor or otherwise. In a poorly managed database, the first threshold might simply be cable management to help subsequent checks, but in a haunted database, necrolinked undead might appear to check their feeds. Reaching a research threshold can do just about anything, but it should have impact.

You don't need to evenly space thresholds—you could require very few Research Points for crucial clues you want to ensure the PCs receive and a much larger number to reach the final threshold that grants a special reward.

Published adventures use stat blocks like the one below.

RESEARCH TOPIC'S NAME RESEARCH (LEVEL)

  • traits

Research Checks The checks PCs can attempt to conduct research listed alongside their locations, tagged with area codes or page references when appropriate.

Research Thresholds Each threshold lists the number of RP required to reach it, followed by the effects for meeting that threshold. Thresholds are listed in order from first (requiring the fewest RP) to last (the highest threshold).

Beneath the stat block, you can list any events that occur based on timing rather than the PCs' RP total (such as a threatening message arriving on the third day), as well as any other important details.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 212-213
pages.content:
在研究子系统中，PC积累研究点，并在达到特定阈值时获得新信息或其他益处。这个子系统很适合让PC随着对一片区域的持续探索，逐渐掌握更深入的信息。这里的时间以轮计算，每轮可从约10分钟到一整天不等。每轮，角色使用研究探索活动获得研究点（RP）。随着时间流逝、队伍积累更多RP，他们会获得知识和奖励，但也可能面对后果或事件。有些事件会以另一类遭遇打断当前轮次（中断研究活动），例如与孤独人工智能的社交遭遇，或与失控安保机器人的战斗遭遇。

研究挑战在PC面临时间限制、竞争研究团队，或其他带来额外压力的外部条件时效果最佳。如果PC有无限时间安全地调查数据库或遗迹，通常可以将过程简化为一次技能检定，因为他们本就可以不断重试，直到发现所有信息。

构建研究挑战

研究挑战包含两部分：资料库，即包含PC为了解主题而需要尝试的各种研究检定，以及研究时所面临障碍的区域；研究数据栏，详述研究主题，并列出PC达到特定RP阈值时获得的信息、奖励，以及发生的额外困难。

设计资料库

“资料库”是PC开展研究之场所的统称。尽管如此称呼，它不一定是藏书之地，也可以是计算机数据库、星界记忆宫殿、供队伍询问其他宾客的俱乐部，甚至整个信息圈。在许多方面，设计资料库与设计其他冒险地点相似：其中有不同房间或区域，各自包含PC需要克服的困难。如果资料库有战术地图，这些困难很可能是危害或与敌对生物的遭遇；如果采用叙事化呈现，尤其是虚拟空间，则可能改为基于技能的遭遇或与NPC的社交遭遇。PC甚至可能需要通过技能检定或骇入子系统，才能取得资料库的访问权。

你需要在资料库各处安排研究检定。它们描述队伍开展研究的具体任务，例如在聊天室提问、翻阅书籍、对样本作化学分析，或与固执的管理员交谈，并列出可用于研究活动的技能与DC，按DC从低到高排列，最低DC对应最适合的技能。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{研究}

  • 专注

  • 探索

@Embed[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK inline]

如果某项技能未列出，但玩家提出充分理由说明为何能使用它，你可以加入该技能并设定适当DC（通常为已列出的最高DC）。开展虚拟研究时，计算机和信息圈学识经常出现在这些条目中；社群则常用于查找和解读实体媒介资料库。不过，最好提前了解队伍的技能配置，让每名成员都有机会参与；例如，数据可能藏在开放世界生存电子游戏中，需要进行一轮生存或电子游戏学识检定。丰富的技能与决策选择，加上生动描述，是让研究挑战引人入胜、令人难忘的关键，而不只是让科技法师或织维巫师接连掷骰。

每项研究检定还具有RP上限。达到上限后，PC无法再从该项研究检定获得RP，因此必须寻找其他地点继续研究。你可以将研究检定设置在希望PC探索的地方，引导他们穿过资料库；在入口附近安排一个简单检定来介绍主题，通常很有帮助！务必确保资料库提供的RP足以让玩家达到数据栏中的所有研究阈值。

设计数据栏

确定资料库及其研究选项的结构后，就该构建数据栏，为每个主题设置研究阈值。阈值让你有机会奖励PC引人入胜的新信息（如当前行星的历史）、战术情报（如原型机器人的唯一弱点）、罕见或稀有选项（如失落科技的物品配方），或其他任何事物。奖励最好有所混合！背景故事虽然有趣，但单独而言不算多少奖励，因此只应放在最低的阈值中。

达到阈值也可以改变资料库的状态，这种变化可能对PC有利，也可能不利。在管理混乱的数据库中，第一个阈值或许只是整理线缆，以帮助后续检定；而在闹鬼的数据库中，死链亡灵可能会现身查看自己的动态。达到研究阈值几乎可以引发任何事，但应当带来实际影响。

阈值不必等距设置。对于你希望确保PC获得的关键线索，可以只要求很少的研究点；而提供特殊奖励的最终阈值，则可以要求多得多的点数。

已出版的冒险采用如下所示的数据栏。

研究主题名称 研究（等级）

  • 特征

研究检定 PC们进行研究时可以尝试的检定，旁边列出其地点，并在恰当时标记有区域编号或引用页码。

研究阈值 各阈值会列出抵达此阈值所需的RP，以及抵达阈值后的效果。阈值的顺序会从第一个（所需RP最少）到最后一个（所需RP最多）。

在数据栏下方，你可以列出按时间而非PC的RP总数触发的事件（例如第三天收到一条威胁信息），以及其他重要细节。

章节：子系统与变体规则《寻星者GM核心规则》第 212-213页

Obstacles in Play

On a character's turn, the character describes what they do to get past the obstacle. They then attempt any required check (or perform the required action, if their choice doesn't require a check). The result of the check determines how many Infiltration Points the character gains toward overcoming that obstacle—or whether they instead raise suspicions and accrue Awareness Points!

Critical Success The PC gains 2 Infiltration Points.

Success The PC gains 1 Infiltration Point.

Failure The PCs accrue 1 Awareness Point.

Critical Failure The PCs accrue 2 Awareness Points.

If the character's actions automatically help without requiring a check, like using a spell, they usually gain 1 IP, but you can award 2 for particularly helpful actions.

pages.content:
游戏中的障碍

在角色的回合中，玩家描述自己如何越过障碍，然后进行所需检定（若选择无需检定的方法，则执行所需动作）。检定结果决定角色获得多少潜入点来克服障碍，或是否反而引起怀疑、积累警觉点！

大成功 该PC获得2点潜入点。

成功 该PC获得1点潜入点。

失败 PC积累1点警觉点。

大失败 PC积累2点警觉点。

如果角色的行为无需检定就能自动提供帮助，例如使用法术，通常获得1点潜入点（IP）；但对于帮助格外大的行为，你可以奖励2点。

pages.name: 休息
pages.expectedContent:
Characters require 8 hours of sleep each day. Though resting typically happens at night, a group gains the same benefits for resting during the day. Either way, they can gain the benefits of resting only once every 24 hours. A character who rests for 8 hours recovers in the following ways.

  • The character regains Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) multiplied by their level. If they rest without any shelter or comfort, you might reduce this healing by half (to a minimum of 1 HP).
  • The character loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition.
  • The character reduces the severity of the doomed and drained conditions by 1.
  • Most spellcasters need to rest before they regain their spells for the day.

A group in exploration mode can attempt to rest, but they aren't entirely safe from danger, and their rest might be interrupted. The 8 hours of rest do not need to be consecutive, however, and after an interruption, characters can go back to sleep.

Sleeping in armor results in poor rest and causes a character to wake up @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. If a character would have recovered from fatigue, sleeping in armor prevents it.

If a character goes more than 16 hours without going to sleep, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Taking long-term rest for faster recovery is part of downtime and can't be done during exploration. See page 50 for these rules.

Section: Running the GameStarfinder GM Core pg. 42-43
pages.content:
角色每天都需要8小时的睡眠。虽然一般都是晚上睡觉，但白天睡觉的效果跟晚上一样。不管哪个时段睡，24小时内靠休息获得的好处只有一次。休息8小时的角色其恢复的方式如下：

  • 角色恢复等于体质调整值（最低为1）乘以等级的生命值。如果休息时既无庇护也不舒适，你可以将恢复量减半（最低恢复1点生命值）。
  • 角色失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}状态。
  • 角色毁灭状态值和流失状态值减1。
  • 大部分的施法者想要恢复每日的法术都需要先休息。

处于探索模式的队伍可以尝试休息，但并非完全没有危险，而他们的休息也可能被打断。但8小时的休息不需要连续不断，就算在被打断后，角色也可以回去继续睡觉。

着甲睡眠会让休息品质降低，会导致角色醒来时承受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}状态。如果有角色会在这次休息时从疲乏状态中恢复，着甲睡眠将无法恢复。

如果有角色超过16个小时没有睡觉，他会承受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}状态。

通过长期休息加快恢复，属于休整活动，不能在探索期间进行。相关规则见第50页。

pages.name: 特殊战斗
pages.expectedContent:
Mounted Combat

You can ride some creatures into combat. As noted in the Mount specialty basic action, your mount needs to be willing and at least one size larger than you. Your mount acts on your initiative. You must use the Command an Animal action to get your mount to spend its actions. If you don't, the animal wastes its actions. If you have the Ride general feat, you succeed automatically when you Command an Animal that's your mount.

For example, if you're mounted on an animal and you make three attacks, your mount would remain stationary since you didn't command it. If you instead spent your first action to Command an Animal and succeeded, you could get your mount to Stride. You could spend your next action to attack or to command the mount to attack, but not both.

Mounted Attacks

You and your mount fight as a unit. Consequently, you share a multiple attack penalty. For example, if you Strike and then Command an Animal to have your mount Strike, your mount's attack takes a –5 multiple attack penalty.

You occupy every square of your mount's space for the purpose of making attacks. If you were a Medium creature on a Large mount, you could attack a creature on one side of your mount, then attack on the opposite side. On a Medium or smaller mount, use the normal reach of an attack. On a Large or Huge mount, you can attack any square adjacent to the mount if you have 5- or 10-foot reach, or any square within 10 feet of the mount (including diagonally) if you have 15-foot reach. Use the adjusted reach for determining flanking and other rules that depend on reach.

Mounted Defenses

Attackers can target either you or your mount. An area effect affects both of you as long as you're both in the area. You're in an attacker's reach or range if any square of your mount is within reach or range. Because your mount is larger than you and you share its space, you have lesser cover against attacks targeting you when you're mounted if the mount would be in the way (as determined by the GM).

Because you can't move your body as freely while you're riding a mount, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted. Additionally, the only move action you can use is the Mount action to dismount.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.9c93NfZpENofiGUp]{Effect: Mounted}

Aerial Combat

Many monsters can fly, and PCs can use spells and items to gain the ability to fly. Flying creatures have to use the Fly action to move through the air. Performing an especially tricky maneuver might require using Acrobatics to Maneuver in Flight. Creatures might fall from the sky, using the falling rules found on page 421. At the GM's discretion, some ground-based actions might not work in the air. For instance, a flying creature couldn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}.

Aquatic Combat

Use these rules for battles in water or underwater:

  • You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} unless you have a swim Speed.
  • You gain resistance 5 to acid and fire.
  • You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your attack roll for bludgeoning or slashing attacks that pass through water.
  • Ranged attacks made by an underwater creature or against an underwater target have their range increments halved.
  • You can't cast fire spells or use actions with the fire trait underwater. As normal for how traits work, any part of the effect that's unrelated to fire still works. For example, an attack with a flaming battleaxe could still deal its physical damage, just not its fire damage.
  • At the GM's discretion, some ground-based actions might not work underwater or while floating.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.TPbr1kErAAJKBi3V]{Effect: Aquatic Combat}

Drowning and Suffocating

You can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier. Reduce your remaining air by 1 round at the end of each of your turns, or by 2 if you attacked or cast any spells that turn. You also lose 1 round worth of air each time you are critically hit or critically fail a save against a damaging effect. If you speak (including Casting a Spell) you lose all remaining air.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.2u26bmArDPuoCljc]{Effect: Remaining Air}

When you run out of air, you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and start suffocating. You can't recover from being unconscious and must attempt a DC 20 @Check[fortitude] save at the end of each of your turns. On a failure, you take @Damage[1d10[untyped]] damage, and on a critical failure, you die. On each check after the first, the DC increases by 5 and the damage by 1d10; these increases are cumulative. Once your access to air is restored, you stop suffocating and are no longer unconscious (unless you're at 0 Hit Points).

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 429
pages.content:
骑乘战斗

你可以骑乘某些生物投入战斗。如骑乘这一特殊基本动作所述，坐骑必须自愿，且至少比你大一个体型。坐骑在你的先攻行动。你必须使用指挥动物动作，才能让坐骑花费动作；否则，动物会浪费自己的动作。如果你拥有骑术通用专长，对自己的动物坐骑指挥动物时会自动成功。

例如，你骑在动物上并作出三次攻击，坐骑会停在原地，因为你没有命令它。如果你先花费第一个动作指挥动物并成功，就可以让坐骑行走。下一个动作可以用来自己攻击，或命令坐骑攻击，但不能同时做两者。

骑乘攻击

你与坐骑作为一个整体战斗，因此共享多重攻击减值。例如，你先打击，再指挥动物让坐骑打击，则坐骑的攻击承受–5多重攻击减值。

在进行攻击时，视为你占据坐骑空间中的每个方格。例如，中型生物骑在大型坐骑上，可以先攻击坐骑一侧的生物，再攻击另一侧。骑乘中型或更小坐骑时，使用攻击的通常触及。骑乘大型或巨型坐骑时，若你的触及为5或10尺，则可以攻击与坐骑邻接的任何方格；若触及为15尺，则可以攻击坐骑周围10尺内的任何方格（包括对角线方向）。判定夹击及其他依赖触及的规则时，使用调整后的触及。

骑乘防御

攻击者可以选择你或坐骑作为目标。只要你们都在区域内，区域效果就会同时影响你们。坐骑的任一方格位于攻击者触及或射程内，就视为你也在其触及或射程内。由于坐骑比你大，且你与其共享空间，骑乘时若坐骑会挡住针对你的攻击（由GM判断），你便对该攻击具有次等掩蔽。

骑乘坐骑时，你的身体无法自由移动，因此反射豁免承受–2环境减值。此外，你唯一可以使用的移动动作，是用骑乘动作下马。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.9c93NfZpENofiGUp]{效果：骑乘}

空中战斗

许多怪物能够飞行，PC也可以借助法术和物品获得飞行能力。飞行生物必须使用飞行动作在空中移动。进行格外棘手的机动，可能需要用杂技进行空中机动。生物可能从空中坠落，使用第421页的坠落规则。由GM决定，某些依赖地面的动作可能无法在空中使用。例如，飞行生物不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}。

水中战斗

在水中或水下战斗时，使用以下规则：

  • 除非拥有游泳速度，否则你处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。
  • 你获得酸蚀抗力5和火焰抗力5。
  • 穿过水体的钝击或挥砍攻击，其攻击检定承受–2环境减值。
  • 水下生物作出的远程攻击，或针对水下目标的远程攻击，其射程增量减半。
  • 你不能在水下施放火焰法术或使用具有火焰特征的动作。按特征通常的运作方式，效果中与火焰无关的部分仍然有效。例如，用炽焰战斧攻击仍能造成物理伤害，只是不能造成火焰伤害。
  • 由GM决定，某些依赖地面的动作可能无法在水下或漂浮时使用。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.TPbr1kErAAJKBi3V]{效果：水中战斗}

溺水与窒息

你可以屏息等于5+体质调整值的轮数。每个自己的回合结束时，剩余空气减少1轮；若该回合攻击或施放过任何法术，则减少2轮。每次受到重击，或对抗伤害效果的豁免大失败时，还会失去1轮空气。如果你说话（包括施法），就失去所有剩余空气。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.2u26bmArDPuoCljc]{效果：剩余空气}

空气耗尽时，你会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}并开始窒息。你无法从失去意识中恢复，且必须在每个自己的回合结束时进行DC 20的@Check[fortitude]豁免。失败时受到@Damage[1d10[untyped]]伤害，大失败时死亡。第一次之后，每次检定的DC增加5、伤害增加1d10；这些增加可以累积。一旦重新获得空气，你就停止窒息，并不再失去意识（除非生命值为0）。

pages.name: 族裔楷模
pages.expectedContent:
Many characters have some elements that connect them to their ancestry but identify more strongly with their class or unique personality. Sometimes, though, a character is the embodiment of their ancestry to the point that it's of equal importance to their class. For a game where an ancestral background is a major theme and such characters are the norm, your group might consider using the ancestry paragon variant.

Building an Ancestry Paragon character

When creating an ancestry paragon character, instead of starting with one ancestry feat and gaining another at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels, the character starts with two ancestry feats and gains another at every odd level thereafter (3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and so on) for a total of 11 ancestry feats.

Playing with Ancestry Paragon characters

Ancestry paragon characters have more versatility and power than other characters, though their extra abilities are usually limited to themes the ancestry already was suited for. It's unlikely to affect the game balance of combat encounters, but it might make exploration and social challenges easier for the heroes.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 86
pages.content:
许多角色虽然具有与族裔相关的特点，但其职业或独特个性更为鲜明。不过，有时一个角色会充分体现其族裔的特质，使族裔与职业同等重要。如果游戏以族裔背景为重要主题，且此类角色十分常见，你们可以考虑使用族裔楷模变体规则。

创建族裔楷模角色

创建族裔楷模角色时，角色不再于初始获得一项族裔专长，并在5、9、13和17级各获得另一项；而是在初始获得两项族裔专长，此后每个奇数等级（3、5、7、9级，以此类推）各获得另一项，共计11项族裔专长。

使用族裔楷模角色进行游戏

族裔楷模角色比其他角色更灵活、更强大，但额外能力通常局限于该族裔本就擅长的领域。这不太可能影响战斗遭遇的平衡，但可能让英雄更容易应对探索和社交挑战。

章节：子系统与变体规则《寻星者主持人核心规则》第86页

pages.name: 银河英雄点
pages.expectedContent:
Hero Points are a powerful resource that can change the course of a scene via a key reroll. However, sometimes the use of Hero Points can become underwhelming when the reroll result is worse than the initial result—it might even feel worse if the reroll result is the same result as the original roll! This simple variant rule is intended to make Hero Points more of a heroic resource in your campaign, allowing you to reroll low results into something better. Using this rule will increase the overall power of Hero Points and, like some other variant rules, is something you'll want to heavily consider the ramifications of before including in your game.

Heroic Rerolls

When using this variant rule to reroll a d20 result using a Hero Point, if the result on the dice is less than a 10, increase the dice result to become a 10. This means that a result of a 9 would become a 10, a result of a 2 would become a 10, and a result of 17 would remain as 17.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 87
pages.content:
英雄点是一种强大的资源，一次关键重掷就可能改变场景的发展。然而，重掷结果若比初次结果还差，使用英雄点也可能令人失望；若重掷结果与原本一样，甚至可能更令人沮丧！这条简单的变体规则旨在让英雄点在战役中更能体现英雄气概，让你将较低的结果重掷成更好的结果。这条规则会提升英雄点的整体效力；如同其他一些变体规则，在纳入游戏之前，你应仔细考虑其影响。

英雄重掷

使用这条变体规则时，若你以英雄点重掷d20，且骰面结果小于10，就将骰面结果提高至10。也就是说，9会变成10，2会变成10，而17仍为17。

章节：子系统与变体规则《寻星者主持人核心规则》第87页

pages.name: 技能楷模
pages.expectedContent:
Skill feats allow characters to gain thematic feats that can help them in exploration, downtime, and social interactions. But given the high stakes of encounter mode, many players feel pressured to select skill feats that improve their efficacy in combat at the expense of selecting feats that better represent their character's abilities. This can be especially frustrating if a character wants to specialize in a skill like Diplomacy or Piloting that includes skill feats that might only see use in one or two sessions.

Building a Skill Paragon character

When creating a skill paragon character, after selecting the character's class, choose a specific skill. The character becomes trained in it. If they were already trained in it, they become trained in another skill instead of their chosen skill. At 3rd, 7th, and 15th levels, they gain an additional skill increase they can apply only to their chosen skill. They automatically gain all common general skill feats that specifically requires proficiency in the chosen skill as a prerequisite as soon as they qualify for those feats. If they already gain one of those feats (such as from a background or heritage), they instead gain Assurance for the chosen skill or, if they already have Assurance for that skill, a related Lore skill.

Not all skills have the same number of feats, and some skill choices will end up granting more bonus feats than others. Characters with two or more fewer bonus Skill Paragon feats than any other character in the party gain their choice of the Additional Lore skill feat in a category related to their chosen skill, or the Assurance, Automatic Knowledge, or Experienced Professional skill feat in their chosen skill or a related Lore skill.

Campaign Specific Skills

You can limit the skills characters can select based on the nature of the campaign. For example, in a campaign where characters play as crew members of a starship, you can designate specific roles on the ship that use specific skills, like captain (Diplomacy), doctor (Medicine), engineer (Crafting), and pilot (Piloting). You can delay the benefits of the variant rule until after campaign roles are formally assigned, especially when using the variant rules in tandem with the Level 0 Character rules.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 87
pages.content:
技能专长能赋予角色符合其主题的能力，帮助他们进行探索、休整和社交互动。但遭遇模式往往事关重大，许多玩家因此感到有必要选择能提高战斗效能的技能专长，牺牲了那些更能体现角色能力的选项。如果角色想专精交涉或驾驶等技能，而相关技能专长可能只在一两次游戏中派上用场，这种情况尤其令人沮丧。

创建技能楷模角色

创建技能楷模角色时，在选择职业后，选择一项特定技能。角色在该技能上受训。如果已经受训，则改为在另一项技能上受训。在3、7和15级，角色获得一次额外技能提升，只能用于最初选择的技能。对于明确以该技能的熟练度为先决条件的所有常见通用技能专长，角色一旦满足条件，就自动获得。如果已经通过其他途径（例如背景或传承）获得其中某项专长，则改为获得所选技能的驾轻就熟；如果已有该技能的驾轻就熟，则改为获得一项相关学识技能。

不同技能的专长数量并不相同，有些技能选择最终会带来更多奖励专长。如果一名角色通过技能楷模获得的奖励专长，比队伍中任何另一名角色少至少两项，则可选择获得以下之一：与所选技能相关类别的额外学识技能专长；或针对所选技能或一项相关学识技能的驾轻就熟、耳熟能详或熟练工技能专长。

战役特定技能

你可以根据战役性质，限制角色可选的技能。例如，在角色扮演星舰船员的战役中，可以指定船上的不同职位使用特定技能，如舰长（交涉）、医生（医疗）、工程师（手艺）和驾驶员（驾驶）。你可以等到战役中的职位正式分配后，再让角色获得这条变体规则的益处，尤其是在与0级角色规则一同使用时。

章节：子系统与变体规则《寻星者主持人核心规则》第87页

pages.name: 0级角色
pages.expectedContent:
Before they were heroes, every PC came from somewhere, whether they poured coffee in a dusty, sun-scoured village like Chk Chk or performed in a busy spaceport like Dae. Sometimes, it can be a lot of fun to play a prequel game set years before the PCs' first adventure as heroes, or you might have an idea for a low-powered adventure. The rules below provide ways to build and use level 0 PCs.

Building Characters

Building a level 0 character is similar to building a 1st-level character, but you stop after choosing your ancestry and background. A level 0 character still gets the four free attribute boosts from Step 6 of the normal character creation process, but not the class attribute boost.

Initial Proficiencies

A level 0 character is trained in Perception, all saving throws, unarmed attacks, unarmored defense, and one simple weapon of their choice. Additionally, they're trained in a number of skills equal to 2 + their Intelligence modifier. The proficiency bonus for a level 0 character works the same way as normal, but since the level is 0, the total proficiency bonus for being trained is +2.

Hit Points

A level 0 character adds their Constitution modifier to their ancestry Hit Points to determine their starting Hit Points.

Starting Money

A level 0 character starts with 50 credits for equipment.

Apprentice Option

If the story you want to tell is about characters who have started training to become a particular class, you can grant them a small number of additional abilities. An apprentice character is trained in the skill or skills specified for their chosen class (such as Athletics and Intimidation for a soldier) in addition to the skills they gain through their initial proficiencies. They also gain benefits based on the class.

Solarian: An apprentice solarian gains a solar flare, solar nimbus, or solar weapon (but not all three). They can only select one trait for their solar weapon and don't gain attunement, so they don't gain the additional benefits of being attuned.

Other Martial Class: An apprentice of another martial class (envoy, operative, and soldier, for example) is trained in light armor, all simple weapons, and one martial weapon listed in the class's initial proficiencies. If a martial class not listed here lacks light armor or martial weapon training, give it a different ability as well.

Spellcaster: An apprentice spellcaster is trained in the appropriate magic tradition and gains two cantrips from their class. A prepared caster can't change these cantrips each day.

Gameplay

Combat can be especially dangerous for level 0 characters. For safety's sake, you might treat the characters as level –1 when determining what combat encounters are appropriate. For skill checks, they can still accomplish tasks with a simple trained DC using their trained skills, but success is less certain. Since they have fewer skills, the party might not have anyone trained for a given task. If you're playing these characters for more than a few sessions, consider advancing them to 1st level using the fast advancement speed (800 XP). If your group wants a longer experience at level 0, start the group without the apprentice benefits, then level up to apprentice (gaining those benefits and the apprentice adjustments for their class), and then level up to 1st level.

Treasure

As the characters start with 50 credits, their adventures up to 1st level should account for the rest of a 1st-level character's starting money. That means you'll distribute treasure worth 100 credits × the number of PCs, a large percentage of which should be in credits.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 84
pages.content:
成为英雄之前，每名PC都有自己的来处：也许像奇克奇克一样，在尘土飞扬、烈日炙烤的村庄里倒咖啡；也许像黛一样，在繁忙的太空港表演。有时，在PC首次踏上英雄冒险的数年前展开一场前传游戏会十分有趣；或者，你也许构思了一个角色实力较低的冒险。以下规则提供了创建和使用0级PC的方法。

创建角色

创建0级角色与创建1级角色相似，但在选择族裔和背景后就停止。0级角色仍会获得正常角色创建流程第6步中的四次自由属性提升，但没有职业属性提升。

初始熟练度

0级角色在察觉、所有豁免、无武装攻击、无甲防御和自选一种简易武器上受训。此外，他们在等于2+智力调整值项技能上受训。0级角色的熟练度加值计算方式与通常相同，但由于等级为0，受训的总熟练度加值为+2。

生命值

0级角色的初始生命值为族裔生命值加上体质调整值。

初始资金

0级角色初始拥有50信用点，用于购买装备。

学徒选项

如果你想讲述角色已经开始接受某个职业训练的故事，可以给予他们少量额外能力。除初始熟练度提供的技能外，学徒角色还会在所选职业指定的技能上受训，例如士兵的运动和威吓。他们还会根据职业获得以下益处。

恒星武士：恒星武士学徒获得恒星耀斑、恒星光晕或恒星武器之一，而非三者全部。他们只能为恒星武器选择一项特征，且不会获得调谐，因此也不享有调谐带来的额外益处。

其他武技职业：其他武技职业（如使节、特工和士兵）的学徒，在轻甲、所有简易武器，以及该职业初始熟练度列出的一种军用武器上受训。如果此处未列出的某个武技职业没有轻甲或军用武器训练，也应改为给予其另一种能力。

施法者：施法者学徒在对应的魔法源流上受训，并从职业获得两个戏法。准备施法者不能每天更换这些戏法。

进行游戏

对0级角色来说，战斗可能格外危险。为安全起见，在确定合适的战斗遭遇时，你可以将角色视为–1级。在技能检定方面，他们仍能用受训技能完成采用受训简易DC的任务，但成功的把握较小。由于技能较少，队伍可能没有任何人在某项任务所需的技能上受训。如果你打算使用这些角色进行多次游戏，可以考虑采用快速升级进度（800 XP），让他们升到1级。如果团队希望在0级停留更久，可以让角色起初不享有学徒益处，之后先升为学徒（获得相关益处和职业的学徒调整），再升到1级。

宝藏

角色初始拥有50信用点，因此升到1级之前的冒险，应补足1级角色初始资金的其余部分。这意味着，你需要分配价值为100信用点×PC人数的宝藏，其中大部分应为信用点。

pages.name: 加值与减值
pages.expectedContent:
Bonuses

If you have different types of bonuses that would apply to the same roll, you'll add them all. But if you have multiple bonuses of the same type, you can use only the highest bonus on a given roll—they aren't cumulative.

Proficiency bonus

Proficiency RankProficiency Bonus
Untrained0
TrainedYour level + 2
ExpertYour level + 4
MasterYour level + 6
LegendaryYour level + 8

Circumstance bonuses

Involve the situation you find yourself in when attempting a check.

Item bonuses

Are granted by some item that you are wearing or using, either mundane or magical.

Status bonuses

Typically come from spells, other magical effects, or something applying a helpful, often temporary, condition to you.

Penalties

Penalties work very much like bonuses. You can have circumstance penalties, status penalties, and sometimes even item penalties. Like bonuses of the same type, you take only the worst all of various penalties of a given type.

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 392
pages.content:
加值

如果有不同类型的加值适用同一检定，则将其全部相加。但是如果同类型的加值存在多个，那么你就只能在检定中使用最高的一项加值——因为它们无法叠加。

熟练加值

熟练度熟练加值
未受训0
受训你的等级+2
专家你的等级+4
大师你的等级+6
传奇你的等级+8

环境加值

代表进行检定时你所处的环境。

物品加值

由你穿戴或使用的某些物品提供，有常规物品也有魔法物品。

状态加值

通常来自法术、其他魔法效果或某事物提供给你的有益状态（通常为临时状态）。

减值

减值的运作方式与加值十分相似。你可能承受环境减值、状态减值，有时甚至还有物品减值。与同类型加值类似，同一类型的多项减值只取最严重的一项。

pages.name: 死亡、濒死与失去意识
pages.expectedContent:
Death and Dying

Knocked OutWhen reduced to 0 HP, move your initiative to directly before the creature or effect that reduced you to 0 HP. Gain dying 1, or dying 2 if the damage came from a critical hit or your critical failure on a save. A nonlethal effect makes you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 HP and doesn't give you the dying condition.
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If you ever reach dying 4, you die. Attempt a recovery check at the start of your turn to determine whether you get better or worse. If you ever have 1 HP or more, you lose the dying condition. Any time you lose the dying condition, increase your wounded value by 1. If you take damage while dying, increase the dying value by 1 (or 2 on an enemy's critical success or your critical failure).

Recovery Checks

At the start of your turn when you're dying, attempt a flat check (DC 10 + your dying value).

Critical Success Your dying value is reduced by 2.

Success Your dying value is reduced by 1.

Failure Your dying value increases by 1.

Critical Failure Your dying value increases by 2

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded}If you gain the dying condition while you have the wounded condition, add your wounded value to your dying value. Wounded ends if you receive HP from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, or if you're restored to full HP and rest for 10 minutes.
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}The maximum dying value at which you die is reduced by your doomed value. If your maximum dying value is reduced to 0, you instantly die. Your doomed value decreases by 1 each time you get a full night's rest.

Unconscious

You can't wake up from Unconsciousness while you have 0 Hit Points. If you're unconscious and have 1 or more Hit Points, you wake up in one of five ways.

  • You take damage, provided the damage doesn't drop you to 0 HP.
  • You receive healing, other than natural healing from resting.
  • Someone nudges or shakes you awake with an Interact action.
  • If there's loud noise, at the start of your turn attempt a Perception check against the noise's DC, waking up if you succeed. If creatures are attempting to stay quiet, this uses their Stealth DC.

  • The GM decides you wake up either because you have had a restful night's sleep or something disrupted that restful sleep.

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 435-441
pages.content:
死亡与濒死

失去意识生命值降至0时，将你的先攻位置移到使你生命值降至0的生物或效果之前。你获得濒死1；若伤害来自重击，或来自你豁免大失败，则获得濒死2。非致命效果会使你在0生命值时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，但不会赋予你濒死状态。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死}

你处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态。濒死值达到4时，你死亡。在你的回合开始时进行复苏检定，以确定情况改善还是恶化。生命值达到1或更高时，你失去濒死状态。每次失去濒死状态，你的受伤值增加1。濒死期间受到伤害时，濒死值增加1（若来自敌人的大成功或你的大失败，则增加2）。

复苏检定

当你濒死时，在自己每个回合开始时进行复苏检定。进行一次DC为10+当前濒死值的纯骰检定。

大成功 你的濒死值减少2。

成功 你的濒死值减少1。

失败 你的濒死值增加1。

大失败 你的濒死值增加2。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{受伤}如果你在受伤状态下获得濒死状态，将受伤值加到濒死值上。当你通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}恢复生命值，或恢复至满生命值并休息10分钟时，受伤状态结束。
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭}你死亡时可积累的最大濒死值会减少等同毁灭值的数额。若你最大濒死值被降至0，你立刻死亡。每当你进行一次完整的夜晚休息后，你的毁灭值减少1。

失去意识

生命值为0时，你无法从失去意识中醒来。如果你失去意识且生命值为1或更高，可以通过以下五种方式之一醒来。

  • 你受到伤害，但前提是该伤害不会使你HP降至0。
  • 你获得休息带来的自然恢复之外的治疗。
  • 有人用交互动作轻推或摇晃，将你唤醒。
  • 如果有巨大的噪音，在你的回合开始时进行察觉检定，对抗噪音的DC；成功则醒来。如果生物试图保持安静，则使用其隐秘DC。

  • GM决定你因为一夜安眠，或某事打断了安稳睡眠而醒来。

pages.name: 光照
pages.expectedContent:
Levels of LightDescription
Bright LightIn bright light, such as sunlight, creatures and objects can be observed clearly by anyone with average vision or better.
Dim LightAreas in shadow or lit by weak light sources are in dim light. Creatures and objects in dim light have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, unless the seeker has darkvision or low-light vision, or a precise sense other than vision.
DarknessA creature or object within darkness is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or undetected unless the seeker has darkvision or a precise sense other than vision. A creature without darkvision or another means of perceiving in darkness has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} condition while in darkness, though it might be able to see illuminated areas beyond the darkness. If a creature can see into an illuminated area, it can observe creatures within that illuminated area normally. After being in darkness, sudden exposure to bright light might make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for a short time, as determined by the GM.

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 424
pages.content:
光照级别描述
明亮光照在阳光等明亮光照下，任何视力正常或更佳的生物都可以清晰地观察到生物和物体。
昏暗光照处于阴影中或由弱光源照明的区域属于昏暗光照。除非观察者拥有黑暗视觉、昏暗视觉或非视觉的精确感官，否则昏暗光照中的生物和物体拥有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。
黑暗除非观察者拥有黑暗视觉或非视觉的精确感官，否则黑暗中的生物或物体拥有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}或无踪状态。没有黑暗视觉或其他感知手段的生物处于黑暗中时会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}状态，虽然它可能还能看到黑暗之外的光亮部分。若黑暗中的生物能看到黑暗外的光亮区域，它就能正常观察光亮区域内的生物。若在黑暗中突然暴露于明亮光照下，可能使你短时间内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，具体由GM决定。

pages.expectedName: Detecting and Stealth with Other Senses
pages.name: 以其他感官侦测与隐秘
pages.expectedContent:
Detecting with Other Senses

Most abilities that designate "a creature you can see" or the like function just as well if the user can precisely sense the subject with a different sense. If a monster uses a sense other than vision, the GM can adapt ways of avoiding detection that work with the monster's senses. For example, a creature that has echolocation might use hearing as a primary sense. This could mean its quarry is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in a noisy chamber, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} in a great enough din, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} under a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} spell.

Using Stealth with Other Senses

The Stealth skill is designed to use Hide for avoiding visual detection and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} to avoid being both seen and heard. For many special senses, a player can describe how they're avoiding detection by that special sense and use the most applicable Stealth action. For instance, a creature stepping lightly to avoid being detected via tremorsense would be using Sneak.

In some cases, rolling a Dexterity-based Stealth skill check to Sneak doesn't make the most sense. For example, a PC trying to avoid being detected by a creature that senses heartbeats might meditate to slow their heart rate, using Wisdom instead of Dexterity for their Stealth check. When a creature could detect you using multiple different senses, use your lowest applicable attribute modifier.

Section: Playing the GameStarfinder Player Core pg. 425
pages.content:
用其他感官侦测

大多数指定“一个你能看见的生物”或类似目标的能力，如果使用者能用另一种感官精确感知目标，也同样有效。如果怪物使用非视觉感官，GM可以据此调整避免被发现的方法。例如，拥有回声定位的生物可能以听觉作为主要感官。这意味着，它的猎物在嘈杂房间中可能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，在足够喧嚣的环境中可能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态，而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态则可能由@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{沉默术}法术造成。

使用隐秘对抗其他感官

隐秘技能的设计意图是使用躲藏动作来避免视觉侦测，使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{避人耳目}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}同时避免被看到和听到。对许多特殊感官来说，玩家可以描述如何避免被这种特殊感官察觉到，并使用最合适的隐秘动作。例如，可以使用潜行动作轻手轻脚地移动来避免被震颤感知侦测。

有些情况下，用基于敏捷的隐秘技能检定来潜行并不是最合理的做法。例如，一名PC试图避开能感知心跳的生物时，可能通过冥想减缓心率，改用感知而非敏捷进行隐秘检定。如果生物能用多种不同感官发现你，则使用所有适用属性调整值中最低的一项。

pages.expectedContent:
Bulk

Carrying especially heavy or unwieldy items can make it more difficult for you to move, as can overloading yourself with too much gear. The Bulk value of an item reflects how difficult the item is to handle, representing its size, weight, and general awkwardness. If you have a high Strength modifier, you usually don't need to worry about Bulk unless you're carrying numerous substantial items.

Bulk Conversions for Different Sizes

As shown in the table below, Large or larger creatures are less encumbered by bulky items than Small or Medium creatures, while Tiny creatures become overburdened more quickly. A Large creature treats 10 items of 1 Bulk as 1 Bulk, a Huge creature treats 10 items of 2 Bulk as 1 Bulk, and so on. A Tiny creature treats 10 items of negligible Bulk as 1 Bulk. Negligible items work in a similar way—a Huge creature treats items of 1 Bulk as negligible, so it can carry any number of items of 1 Bulk. A Tiny creature doesn't treat any items as having negligible Bulk.

负载

携带特别沉重或难以搬运的物品，会使你更难移动，携带过多装备导致超载也是如此。物品的负载值体现了处理它的难度，综合表示其大小、重量和笨重程度。如果你的力量调整值很高，除非携带许多大件物品，否则通常无需担心负载。

不同体型的负载换算

如下表所示，与小型或中型生物相比，大型或更大的生物较少受到高负载物品的拖累，而超小型生物则更容易超载。大型生物将10件各为1负载的物品合计视为1负载；巨型生物将10件各为2负载的物品合计视为1负载，依此类推。超小型生物将10件负载可忽略的物品合计视为1负载。可忽略负载的物品也采用类似方式处理：巨型生物将1负载的物品视为负载可忽略，因此可以携带任意数量的1负载物品。超小型生物不将任何物品视为负载可忽略。

pages.name: 怪物调整
pages.expectedContent:
Elite Adjustment

  • Increase the creature's level by 1; if the creature is level –1 or 0, instead increase its level by 2.
  • Add 2 to AC, attack bonus, DCs, saves, Perception, and skills.
  • Add 2 to damage for Strikes and offensive abilities, or 4 for abilities that can be used only a limited number of times.

  • Increase HP based on the creature's starting level: 1 or lower, add 10 HP; 2 to 4, add 15 HP; 5 to 19, add 20 HP; and 20+ add 30 HP.

Weak Adjustment

  • Decrease the creature's level by 1; if the creature is level 1, instead decrease its level by 2.
  • Subtract 2 from AC, attack bonus, DCs, saves, Perception, and skills.
  • Subtract 2 from damage for Strikes and offensive abilities, or 4 for abilities that can be used only a limited number of times.

  • Decrease HP based on the creature's starting level: 1 or 2, subtract 10 HP; 3 to 5, subtract 15 HP; 6 to 20, subtract 20 HP; and 21+ subtract 30 HP.

Section: Running the GameStarfinder Alien Core pg. 204, 207
pages.content:
精英调整

  • 生物的等级提高1；若生物原为–1级或0级，则改为提高2级。
  • 生物的AC、攻击调整值、DC、豁免、察觉、技能调整值+2。
  • 打击和进攻能力的伤害增加2；若能力的可用次数有限，则增加4。

  • 基于生物的起始等级，上调生物的血量：1级或更低增加10点；2-4级增加15点；5-19级增加20点；20级及以上增加30点。

弱化调整

  • 生物等级降低1级，如果生物为1级，则降低2级。
  • 生物的AC、攻击调整值、DC、豁免、察觉、技能调整值-2。
  • 打击和进攻能力的伤害减少2；若能力的可用次数有限，则减少4。

  • 基于生物的起始等级，下调生物的血量：1-2级减少10点；3-5级，减少15点；6-20级减少20点；21级及以上减少30点。

pages.name: 渐进属性提升
pages.expectedContent:
In this variant, a character gains attribute boosts more gradually as they level up, rather than receiving four attribute boosts at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels. Each character gains one attribute boost when they reach each of 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th levels. These are collectively a single set of attribute boosts, so a character can't boost the same attribute score more than once per set; players can put a dot next to each boosted attribute score or otherwise mark it to keep track. PCs also receive an attribute boost at 7th, 8th, 9th, and 10th level (a second set); at 12th, 13th, 14th, and 15th level (a third set); and at 17th, 18th, 19th, and 20th level (the fourth and final set).

This spreads out the attribute boosts, and using them earlier means a character can increase their most important attribute modifiers at a lower level. This makes characters slightly more powerful on average, but it makes levels 5, 10, 15, and 20 less important since characters usually choose the least important attribute boost of the set at those levels.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesPathfinder Gamemastery Guide pg. 182
pages.content:
在此变体规则下，角色随着升级更逐步地获得属性提升，而非在5、10、15和20级时各一次获得四项属性提升。每个角色在2、3、4和5级时各获得一项属性提升。这四项共同构成一组，因此同一组中不能提升同一属性超过一次；玩家可以在已提升的属性旁画点或作其他标记，以便记录。PC还会在7、8、9和10级获得第二组属性提升，在12、13、14和15级获得第三组，在17、18、19和20级获得第四组，也是最后一组。

这使属性提升分散到各个等级，而更早使用它们，意味着角色能够在较低等级提高最重要的属性调整值。角色平均而言会稍强一些，但5、10、15和20级的重要性会下降，因为角色通常会在这些等级选择该组中最不重要的属性提升。

pages.name: 追逐
pages.expectedContent:
Chases are a special type of encounter. Each round, the pursued character or characters act first, then the pursuing characters act. Typically, to reduce variance, the PCs roll checks to progress while their opponents proceed at a steady pace, but if you want to emphasize the back-and-forth nature of a particular chase, you could have both sides roll instead. Characters in the same group can act in whatever order they prefer, each taking a turn. A character must act on their turn. If they pass their turn or are unable to act, they're unable to help the group and automatically cause the group to lose 1 Chase Point.

Obstacles

During a chase, all the characters must overcome a series of obstacles that represent challenges—from security check points to quicksand—during the different legs of the pursuit. These obstacles aren't separated by specific distances; rather, the distance is narrative and can vary between obstacles as needed for the story you're telling. Travel times between obstacles can vary, too. The time scale you choose determines how PCs can act when dealing with an obstacle.

Each obstacle requires a certain number of Chase Points to overcome. Typically, half the obstacles require 1 point fewer than the number of party members, and half require 2 points fewer (with a minimum of 1 Chase Point per obstacle). Particularly challenging obstacles might require more. Typically, there are multiple ways to overcome an obstacle; for example, characters could evade a security officer or give a bribe to ignore them. Each approach usually requires a skill check or Perception check, but sometimes a saving throw, an attack roll, or something even more unusual, like casting a certain spell.

On a character's turn, they describe what they do to help the group get past the obstacle. They then attempt any required roll, or perform the required action for a choice without a check. If they attempt a roll, the result determines how many Chase Points the character gains.

Critical Success The PCs gain 2 Chase Points.

Success The PCs gain 1 Chase Point.

Critical Failure The PCs lose 1 Chase Point.

Building a Chase

When building a chase, first build your obstacles, and then decide how far ahead the pursued character or characters begin and at what pace the NPCs will move. Having the NPCs clear one obstacle per round is a good rule of thumb, but it could vary depending on the situation and should especially be slower against obstacles that require more than the typical number of Chase Points to overcome.

Select or build obstacles highlighting a variety of different skills and other options so everyone in the party has a moment to shine. When choosing what skills can bypass a given obstacle, ensure a variety of approaches can work. If you've already decided that an obstacle uses Stealth, selecting Thievery as the other option doesn't really offer opportunities for different types of characters since those who are good at Thievery are very likely the same ones who are good at Stealth. On the other hand, offering Athletics as an alternative gives a soldier who's terrible at Stealth a way to help. The group can help cover for a character who's less capable at a particular obstacle, but it's more fun for players when you present substantially different options for each obstacle.

Use the following guidelines to determine how many obstacles you need for your chase. These numbers assume that the pursued party can reach a certain location to end the chase (as described in Ending Chases). If there's no such escape, you might need more obstacles.

Short: 6 obstacles, about 10–20 minutes of game time

Medium: 8 obstacles, about 15–25 minutes of game time

Long: 10 obstacles, about 20–30 minutes of game time

Running a Chase

When running a chase, narrate the scene and give vivid descriptions of the obstacles the PCs face, rather than just reading off a list of skills and immediately having the players start rolling dice and attempting checks. A chase is a framework for roleplaying, not just a dice game. Encourage the PCs to describe what they're doing and how they're helping their comrades overcome each obstacle.

Typically, it's best to tell the players the DCs of the default options, so they can make informed decisions. At the very least, you should indicate the relative difficulty of the clear paths.

Try to make it feel like the PCs are really part of a chase scene, like in a movie. As each side makes progress, describe how they pull ahead or close the gap. PCs far from their foes might hear shouts in the distance. As they get closer, they catch glimpses, and then finally see their quarry in full view once they're on the enemies' heels. Think about how the events of the chase affect the environment as well. For instance, if a colossus is chasing after the PCs, after the PCs overcome an obstacle consisting of a cluttered construction site, you could describe how the colossus flattens the structure beneath its feet as it stomps after them.

If the PCs get stuck

Sometimes, despite their best efforts, an obstacle will stymie the PCs over and over again. In most cases, after 3 rounds of the PCs struggling with an obstacle that requires the standard number of Chase Points, it's a good idea to just say they found another way around it. If presenting another way around the obstacle just doesn't make sense, such as if the PCs can't hot-wire an abandoned vehicle, you might introduce an NPC or other outside force that can help them bypass it, but at a high cost.

Underground Obstacles

Crumbling Corridor (1st)

@Check[acrobatics|dc:13] to avoid disturbing the walls, @Check[crafting|dc:15] to shore up the walls;

@Check[athletics|dc:20] to dig through, @Check[perception|dc:18] to find another path;

Convention Crowd (4th) @Check[athletics|dc:20], @Check[society|dc:18]

@Check[crafting|dc:13] or @Check[piloting|dc:13] to cut the brakes, @Check[intimidation|dc:15] to make the owner move it;

Food Truck (5th) @Check[crafting|dc:20] or @Check[piloting|dc:20], @Check[intimidation|dc:22]

@Check[acrobatics|dc:15] to slide down, @Check[athletics|dc:13] to swing from landing to landing;

Steep Fire Escape (5th) @Check[acrobatics|dc:18], @Check[athletics|dc:20]

Security Drone (1st)

@Check[computers|dc:14] to reprogram, @Check[stealth|dc:16] to sneak past;

Security Robot (9th) @Check[computers|dc:26], @Check[stealth|dc:28]

Viral Flash Mob (2nd)

@Check[performance|dc:15] to join in, @Check[thievery|dc:13] to disable the sound system;

Viral Surprise Concert (12th) @Check[performance|dc:30], @Check[thievery|dc:28]

Vehicle Obstacles

Confusing Side Streets (1st)

@Check[society|dc:13] to recall the street layout, @Check[survival|dc:15] to navigate through the tangle;

Twisting Back Alleys (5th) @Check[society|dc:18], @Check[survival|dc:20]

Demonstration (1st)

@Check[intimidation|dc:15] to part the crowd, @Check[performance|dc:13] to sway the masses;

Parade (5th) @Check[intimidation|dc:20], @Check[performance|dc:18]

@Check[computers|dc:13] to hack the lights, @Check[piloting|dc:15] to drive through oncoming traffic;

@Check[acrobatics|dc:15] to cross carefully, @Check[crafting|dc:13] to make repairs;

Rushing River (1st)

@Check[athletics|dc:15] to swim or hop across stones, @Check[survival|dc:13] to find a ford nearby;

Flash Flood (5th) @Check[athletics|dc:20], @Check[survival|dc:18]

Tangled Forest (2nd)

@Check[perception|dc:17] to find the way, @Check[survival|dc:13] to plot a path;

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 217
pages.content:
追逐是一种特殊遭遇。每轮，被追逐的角色先行动，然后追逐者行动。通常，为了减少波动，由PC进行检定来推进，而对手以稳定速度前进；但如果你希望强调某场追逐的来回拉锯，也可以让双方都掷骰。同一组内的角色可以按任意顺序各进行一个回合。角色必须在自己的回合行动。如果跳过回合或无法行动，就不能帮助队伍，并自动使队伍失去1点追逐点。

障碍

追逐期间，所有角色都必须克服一系列障碍，代表追逐不同阶段中的挑战，例如安检关卡或流沙。障碍之间不以固定距离分隔；距离由叙事决定，可以根据故事需要在不同障碍之间变化。障碍间的旅行时间也可以不同。你选择的时间尺度决定了PC在应对障碍时能如何行动。

每个障碍都需要一定数量的追逐点才能克服。通常，一半障碍所需点数比队伍人数少1，另一半少2（每个障碍最低需要1点追逐点）。格外困难的障碍可能需要更多。一般有多种方式可以克服障碍；例如，角色可以躲开安保人员，也可以贿赂对方让其不加理会。每种方法通常需要技能检定或察觉检定，但有时也可能需要豁免、攻击检定，或更特殊的做法，如施放特定法术。

在角色的回合中，玩家描述自己如何帮助队伍越过障碍，然后进行所需检定；若选择无需检定的方法，则执行所需动作。如果进行了检定，其结果决定该角色获得多少追逐点。

大成功 PC获得2点追逐点。

成功 PC获得1点追逐点。

大失败 PC失去1点追逐点。

构建追逐

构建追逐时，先设计障碍，再决定被追逐者起始领先多远，以及NPC以何种速度移动。通常让NPC每轮越过一个障碍是不错的经验准则，但也可随情况调整；尤其是面对所需追逐点高于通常数量的障碍时，应当放慢。

选择或设计能突出多种技能及其他选项的障碍，让队伍中的每个人都有表现机会。决定哪些技能能绕过某个障碍时，确保多种方法都能奏效。如果已经决定障碍可用隐秘克服，再将贼活列为另一选项，并不能真正给不同类型的角色提供机会，因为擅长贼活的人很可能也擅长隐秘。相反，将运动列为备选，就能让不善隐秘的士兵也有所贡献。队伍可以弥补某个角色在特定障碍上的不足，但为每个障碍提供明显不同的选项，会让玩家更有乐趣。

使用以下指引确定追逐需要多少个障碍。这些数量假定被追逐者能够抵达某个地点，从而结束追逐（见“结束追逐”）。如果没有这样的脱身地点，可能需要更多障碍。

短： 6个障碍，约10–20分钟游戏时间

中： 8个障碍，约15–25分钟游戏时间

长： 10个障碍，约20–30分钟游戏时间

主持追逐

主持追逐时，应叙述场景，生动描述PC面临的障碍，而不是只读出一串技能，立刻让玩家掷骰检定。追逐是角色扮演的框架，不只是掷骰游戏。鼓励PC描述自己的做法，以及如何帮助伙伴克服每个障碍。

通常，最好将默认选项的DC告诉玩家，让他们能够充分了解情况后作出决定。至少也应说明明显路径的相对难度。

努力让PC感觉自己确实置身电影般的追逐场景。随着双方推进，描述他们如何拉开距离或缩小差距。远离敌人时，PC可能听见远处的呼喊；靠近后，先偶尔瞥见目标，直到紧追敌人身后，才终于将猎物看得一清二楚。也要考虑追逐事件如何影响环境。例如，如果一头巨兽追赶PC，在PC越过杂乱工地构成的障碍后，你可以描述巨兽如何迈着重步追来，将建筑踩平。

如果PC受阻

有时，尽管PC竭尽全力，仍会反复被某个障碍难住。多数情况下，如果PC已在一个需要标准数量追逐点的障碍上挣扎了3轮，最好直接说明他们找到了其他绕行方法。如果绕行实在说不通，例如PC无法短接启动一辆废弃载具，你可以引入NPC或其他外力，帮助他们越过障碍，但要求付出高昂代价。

地下障碍

坍塌中的走廊（1级）

@Check[acrobatics|dc:13]以避免扰动墙壁，@Check[crafting|dc:15]以支撑墙壁；

震动走廊（11级） @Check[acrobatics|dc:25]、@Check[crafting|dc:30]

真菌洞窟（1级）

@Check[fortitude|dc:15]以承受有毒孢子，@Check[survival|dc:13]以避开蘑菇；

坍塌隧道（5级）

古老坍塌（12级） @Check[athletics|dc:30]、@Check[perception|dc:28]

城市障碍

铁丝网围栏 （1级）

@Check[athletics|dc:13] 以攀爬翻越、@Check[thievery|dc:15] 以打开门锁；

人群 （1级）

@Check[acrobatics|dc:15]或@Check[athletics|dc:15] 以穿行或挤开人群、@Check[society|dc:13] 以顺着人流前进；

展会人群 （4级） @Check[athletics|dc:20]、@Check[society|dc:18]

违停载具 （1级）

@Check[crafting|dc:13]或@Check[piloting|dc:13] 以破坏制动装置、@Check[intimidation|dc:15] 以让车主移走载具；

餐车 （5级） @Check[crafting|dc:20]或@Check[piloting|dc:20]、@Check[intimidation|dc:22]

摇摇欲坠的消防梯 （1级）

@Check[acrobatics|dc:15] 以滑下、@Check[athletics|dc:13] 以从一个平台荡到另一个平台；

陡峭消防梯 （5级） @Check[acrobatics|dc:18]、@Check[athletics|dc:20]

安保无人机 （1级）

@Check[computers|dc:14] 以重新编程、@Check[stealth|dc:16] 以潜行绕过；

安保机器人 （9级） @Check[computers|dc:26]、@Check[stealth|dc:28]

爆红快闪活动 （2级）

@Check[performance|dc:15] 以加入其中、@Check[thievery|dc:13] 以停用音响系统；

爆红突袭演唱会 （12级） @Check[performance|dc:30]、@Check[thievery|dc:28]

载具障碍

令人迷惑的支路 （1级）

@Check[society|dc:13] 以回忆街道布局、@Check[survival|dc:15] 以穿过错综复杂的街道；

曲折后巷 （5级） @Check[society|dc:18]、@Check[survival|dc:20]

示威游行 （1级）

@Check[intimidation|dc:15] 以分开人群、@Check[performance|dc:13] 以说动群众；

庆典游行 （5级） @Check[intimidation|dc:20]、@Check[performance|dc:18]

红灯 （1级）

@Check[computers|dc:13] 以骇入交通灯、@Check[piloting|dc:15] 以驾车穿过迎面车流；

繁忙路口红灯 （11级） @Check[computers|dc:25]、@Check[piloting|dc:30]

带刺栏杆 （1级）

@Check[athletics|dc:15]或@Check[crafting|dc:15] 以搭建临时坡道、@Check[perception|dc:13] 以寻找绕行路线；

封锁街道 （5级） @Check[athletics|dc:20]或@Check[crafting|dc:20]、@Check[perception|dc:18]

交通堵塞 （1级）

@Check[perception|dc:13] 以发现空隙、@Check[piloting|dc:15] 以转向穿过车流；

交通高峰 （5级） @Check[perception|dc:18]、@Check[piloting|dc:20]

施工工地 （2级）

@Check[piloting|dc:17] 以转向穿过工地、@Check[society|dc:13] 以了解工地的组织与布局；

拆除工地 （5级） @Check[piloting|dc:20]、@Check[society|dc:18]

pages.name: 骇入
pages.expectedContent:
The hacking subsystem enables PCs to gain access to and control secure computers. PCs work together to discover and exploit a computer's vulnerabilities in order to help bypass the system's security without triggering its countermeasures. Using the hacking subsystem, characters who are untrained in Computers can help using magic, social skills, and more. There are two kinds of hacking encounters: simple and complex.

Simple hacking is quick, streamlined, and functions like a simple hazard. Simple computers have one access point and no vulnerabilities. Hacking a simple computer or Disabling the computer's countermeasures is a two-action activity. If the PCs have the time to gain access to a simple computer without the pressure of an accompanying encounter, you can allow the PCs up to two additional failures before triggering the computer's countermeasures. Alternatively, you can use the guidelines for building a computer to introduce a custom vulnerability or otherwise modify a simple computer, but adding more than one vulnerability runs the risk of making it a complex encounter that takes much more time to hack!

Complex hacking occurs over multiple rounds that might last a variable amount of time. During each round of a complex hacking encounter, each PC can act once, attempting to either exploit vulnerabilities, notice and disable countermeasures, or Hack one of the computer's points of access. Each time a character successfully exploits an access point's vulnerability, the DC to Hack the associated access point is lowered by the indicated value. If a character fails to Disable the access point's countermeasures or fails to Hack an access point, they accrue one failure (two on a critical failure) for that access point. Each access point has one or more countermeasures that trigger when a group accrues enough failures. Characters in the same group can act in whatever order they prefer, each taking a turn. Usually, the character attempting to Hack the computer will go last, giving the rest of the party an opportunity to disable the computer's countermeasures and lower the DC by exploiting vulnerabilities. While a group of hackers might be tempted to take their time and explore every avenue before attempting to Hack a computer, doing so is risky! During each round the PCs attempt to exploit one or more vulnerabilities, but don't attempt to Hack an access point or disable a countermeasure, they accrue one failure for an associated access point.

Building a Computer

Every hacker needs a computer to hack! The form a computer takes can vary greatly, from a secure technological database accessed via a holographic interface to an interdimensional tree that grows across realities and stores its data inside colorful, intangible fruits accessible only through lucid dreaming. While incredibly different and bound to sport unique vulnerabilities and countermeasures, both are computers for the purpose of the hacking subsystem.

Concept

The first step to building a computer is to develop an initial concept. What does accessing the computer allow your players to accomplish? What level is it? Is it simple or complex? Is it magical, technological, or hybrid? Does it have a virtual intelligence, or is it a living creature? Does it use remote access points, or does it require direct physical access? You should brainstorm the computer's name and description, as that can help you plan its vulnerabilities and countermeasures.

Computer Types

Most computers have the tech trait and can be hacked using skills like Computers, Crafting, and Thievery. Magic computers might incorporate programmable aeon stones or bound machine spirits that command ancient constructs and are usually Hacked using Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. Hybrid computers have the tech and magic traits, such as a password-protected spell chip or an arcane barrier controlled by a console. Hybrid computers often have different access points for their magical and technological components, but Hacking either should grant access to the computer. A computer's stat block will never be able to list every possible skill a character might use during a hacking encounter. You can use the values listed in a computer's stat block as a guideline to resolve creative, unlisted solutions to a hacking encounter.

Setting the Statistics

Use a hazard's Stealth and Disable DCs to determine the computer's DCs. Successfully exploiting vulnerabilities with a low DC should reduce the DC to Hack by 1, those with a high DC should reduce it by 2, and those with an elite DC by 3. Penalties to the Hacking DC incurred while exploiting a vulnerability are cumulative and should never be enough to reduce the DC below the low DC. The DC to notice a countermeasure is usually lower than the DC to disable it, which is always high or elite.

Simplified Quick Hacking

For a simplified quick hacking encounter, you can ask each of your players to roll appropriate skill checks to support the character(s) attempting the Hacking check. Each successful skill check lowers the Hacking DC by 1, or 2 on a critical success; a critical failure raises the Hacking DC by 1 instead.

Section: Subsystem and Variant RulesStarfinder GM Core pg. 222-223
pages.content:
骇入子系统让PC能够访问并控制受保护的计算机。PC共同寻找并利用计算机的漏洞，在不触发反制措施的情况下绕过系统安保。使用这个子系统时，未受训于计算机的角色也能通过魔法、社交技能等方式提供帮助。骇入遭遇分为简单与复杂两类。

简单骇入迅速、精简，运作方式类似简单危害。简单计算机只有一个接入点，没有漏洞。骇入简单计算机或解除其反制措施，都是双动作活动。如果PC有时间取得简单计算机的访问权，且没有同时发生的遭遇带来压力，你可以允许他们在触发反制措施前额外失败至多两次。也可以依据构建计算机的指引，添加自定义漏洞，或以其他方式修改简单计算机；但添加超过一个漏洞，就可能使它变成需要花费更多时间骇入的复杂遭遇！

复杂骇入会持续多轮，每轮的时长可以不同。在复杂骇入遭遇的每一轮中，每个PC可以行动一次，尝试利用漏洞、察觉并解除反制措施，或骇入计算机的一个接入点。每当角色成功利用某个接入点的漏洞，骇入该接入点的DC就降低指定数值。如果角色未能解除接入点的反制措施，或未能骇入接入点，就为该接入点积累一次失败（大失败为两次）。每个接入点都有一项或多项反制措施，在队伍积累足够失败次数时触发。同组角色可以按任意顺序各进行一个回合。通常，尝试骇入计算机的角色最后行动，让其他队员有机会先解除反制措施，并利用漏洞降低DC。虽然黑客团队可能想在尝试骇入前慢慢探索所有途径，但这样做存在风险！在任何一轮中，如果PC尝试利用一个或多个漏洞，却没有尝试骇入接入点或解除反制措施，就会为相关接入点积累一次失败。

构建计算机

每个黑客都需要一台可以骇入的计算机！计算机的形式千差万别，可以是通过全息界面访问的安全科技数据库，也可以是一棵跨越多个现实生长的跨维度树，将数据储存在五彩缤纷、无实体的果实中，只有通过清醒梦才能访问。虽然两者差异巨大，必然拥有各自独特的漏洞和反制措施，但在骇入子系统中，它们都属于计算机。

概念

构建计算机的第一步，是形成初步概念。访问它能让玩家完成什么？它是几级？属于简单还是复杂？是魔法、科技还是混合类型？它拥有虚拟智能，还是本身就是活着的生物？它使用远程接入点，还是需要直接物理接入？构思计算机的名称和外观描述，有助于规划其漏洞与反制措施。

计算机类型

大多数计算机具有科技特征，可以使用计算机、手艺和贼活等技能骇入。魔法计算机可能包含可编程的万古石，或被束缚、用于指挥古老构装体的机魂，通常使用奥法、自然、神秘或宗教来骇入。混合计算机同时具有科技和魔法特征，例如有密码保护的法术芯片，或由控制台操纵的奥术屏障。混合计算机的魔法与科技部分往往各有接入点，但骇入任一部分，都应能获得计算机的访问权。计算机的数据栏不可能列出角色在骇入遭遇中能够使用的所有技能。对于富有创意、未列出的解决方法，你可以参考数据栏中的数值作出裁定。

设置数据

使用危害的隐秘与解除DC来确定计算机的DC。成功利用低DC漏洞应使骇入DC降低1，高DC漏洞降低2，精英DC漏洞降低3。利用漏洞造成的骇入DC减值可以累积，但绝不应将DC降至低DC以下。察觉反制措施的DC通常低于解除它的DC；后者始终为高或精英DC。

简化快速骇入

若要进行简化的快速骇入遭遇，你可以让每位玩家进行适当的技能检定，支援尝试骇入检定的角色。每次成功的技能检定使骇入DC降低1，大成功则降低2；大失败则改为使骇入DC提高1。
